content.original: This variant was introduced during the torrent fighting of the Jihad in 3072. The principal improvement of the design is the installation of eight Improved Jump Jets. The 'Mech's long-range abilities have been considerably reduced, due to the removal of larger weapons. The original design's number of Double Heat Sinks have been increased, while the two Medium Pulse Lasers have been retained, while adding a single SRM-6 Launcher & a pair of Heavy Small Lasers. A ton of ammunition has been given to the SRM launcher, and additional armor was added. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: After obtaining the husk of an Inner Sphere Tarantula, Clan Cloud Cobra scientists decided to use it as the basis for a quadruped BattleMech. The 'Mech received the name Stalking Spider because it mounts enough jump jets in the legs to rocket it to 150 meters in one jump. Because the MechWarrior must move the legs during the jump, it appears that the design is crawling through the air like a spider, making it very impressive during drops. The Stalking Spider also uses MASC to move up to 119 km/h in short bursts.

content.original: Clan Hell's Horses originally conceived of the Thunder Stallion as a totem 'Mech, along the lines of the Mandrill. After the poor performance of other totem designs, however, that aspect was downplayed to the point that only the rear legs retain any of the equine aesthetic styling that was supposed to be such an important aspect of the 'Mech. True to the emphasis on combined arms warfare that the Horses value, the Thunder Stallion is an assault 'Mech that is designed to support what would be considered secondary forces in any other Clan. Since it was designed to work with infantry, the Thunder Stallion's top speed of 54 km/h is roughly equivalent to the speed that an Elemental Battle Armor can move.

content.original: The Vindicator is one of the most well-known Capellan Confederation BattleMechs. This workhorse of the CCAF was originally built in 2826 between the First and Second Succession War to maximize the effectiveness of the Confederation's surviving production capabilities and fulfill as many roles as possible. Designed by committee, the Vindicator's 'jack-of-all-trades' nature means it does not excel in any one role but fulfills them adequately. With almost all of its components produced on Capella, the Vindicator is also cheap, easy to mass produce, and quick to repair with a ready supply of spare parts.

content.original: The 2G is a variant developed to overcome the production bottleneck the off-world construction of chassis represented as disruptions of interstellar shipping increased. While El Dorado lacked the orbital facilities to produce Endo Steel, they readily produced the advanced crystalline polymers shared by double heat sinks and XL engines. Saving weight on the power plant allowed a switch to a standard chassis, with the six ER lasers replaced with 12 standard medium lasers mounted in a two over, three under configuration. Two medium lasers cover the rear of the 'Mech. An additional ton of armor is the token recognition of the increased fragility of an XL engine. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

This gives it the ability to operate far from supply for extended periods, but the damage rate is rather low when compared to other 'Mechs of a similar size. Its strength is undoubtedly its speed, which it can use to harass enemies and keep from taking too many hits. The -3B is as protected by its jump jets that can propel it up to 150 meters as by its fifteen tons of armor. A C3i Computer allows it to share targeting telemetry with other similarly equipped units. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The 9K Wolverine introduced in 3074 uses a Light Engine for power. The resulting decrease in tonnage necessitated a complete revision of the weapon systems. Its main gun is the Snub-Nose PPC mounted in the right arm. An SRM-4 is the only other heat-building weapon mounted on the 'Mech. A trio of Light Machine Guns are also in the arm, linked to a Machine Gun Array to deter infantry. To counteract battle armor, the 9K carries a pair of B-Pods. This Wolverine variant carries a Sword in its left hand and a C3 Slave in the head to feed targeting telemetry back to lance-mates. Triple Strength Myomers make the sword more powerful and the design faster when they heat up, but a MechWarrior must disengage some of the ten double heat sinks in order to build the necessary heat. In light of the heavier engine, the inclusion of a Compact Gyro seems unhelpful at best. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Wolverine 9M introduced in 3073 is powered by a Nissan XL Engine that allows the 'Mech to move at speeds of up to 86.4 km/h while sacrificing durability. The 9M can also jump up to one hundred and fifty meters, as with most other variants. The 9M is armed with a Fusigon Strongtooth Heavy PPC as its primary weapon, which has a similar damage profile to a Clan ER PPC, but at reduced ranges. This is backed up by a Diverse Optics ER medium laser and a Guided Technologies Second Generation Streak SRM-6 launcher for close combat. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Xanthos was first introduced by the Capellan Confederation in 2564, designed by a young engineer named Dr. David Harrison. Working for Hollis Inc., he pioneered the technology to create four-legged BattleMechs. This technological advancement that later allowed the research into the Scorpion and Goliath enabled the Xanthos to get on the field. It was presented to the Terran Hegemony for review after the cancellation of the Catapult. Hollis pushed to have this 'Mech presented against Dr. Harrison's wishes in a bid to maintain financial solvency. Clumsy and stiff, the 'Mech failed to win the contract from the Star League purchasing committee.

The only real difference to the original design was replacing the Vehicle Flamers with normal 'Mech Flamers, as they former caused too many issues in the original design. content.original: The Ymir was the Lyran Commonwealth's first homegrown BattleMech, designed during the Age of War. Named for the frost giants of Scandinavian mythology, the Ymir was developed by Coventry Defense Conglomerate by taking the basic frame of the Mackie, shaving ten tons from it and then modifying it to form a sleeker design, that offered greater stability and the ability to maneuver more easily.

content.original: This version is used in conjunction with the Maxim C3 Master. Removing the machine guns and ammunition, it expands the infantry bay to four tons, allowing it to carry a squad of battle armor. It also carries a C3 slave and keeps the TAG system. Originally produced by Maxim Transport Industries, before a series of scandals led to its closure in 3039, the fast and heavily armed Maxim quickly became the model example of a transport throughout the Inner Sphere. Still produced via different companies, the Maxim is still heavily used by many units as their principal APC. It has proven itself popular both to unit commanders, who respect its firepower, speed and ability to carry a full platoon of infantry, and to the troops it carries, who respect its roomy, comfortable infantry bay. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 125 25 Left 115 25 Right 115 25 Rear 90 25 Turret 100 25 Total 545 125 Quirk: Rugged Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.

content.original: Introduced after the Jihad, the Balac Strike VTOL was an extremely fast and versatile VTOL. Intended for anti-vehicle support, the Balac carries a pair of Type 6 ATM-6 launchers as its primary weapons. With a four ton capacity ammo bay allowing the craft to carry any combination of ATM missile loads, the Balac boasted lengthy field endurance. In case the ATMs did run dry, a nose mounted Mk.3 ER Medium Laser provided a degree of non-ammo reliant firepower. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 95 15 Left 65 15 Right 65 15 Rear 45 15 Total 285 75 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles

content.original: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by Clan Hell's Horses. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: Renna Palmira, from New Samarkand Metals on Xinyang designed the Nike as an alternative to the expensive Partisan. This armored vehicle focuses on firepower rather than the command and coordination abilities of later Partisan models. By using less-expensive technology, customers who couldn't afford a Partisan still get a solid anti-aircraft platform. Built on a modified support vehicle chassis, a fuel cell engine provides a top speed of 54 km/h while thirteen tons of BAR 9 armor provides protection against most weaponry. Offensively, the Nike carries a pair of Light AC/2 and a pair of LBX/5 AC. Due to the bulkier nature of some components the Nike weighs 90 tons - ten tons heavier than its inspiration. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: The Banzai's weapon loadout is intended to compensate and benefit its incredible speeds by assault 'Mech standards. While originally intended to carry a Capacitor-enhanced ER PPC in arm, the finished design instead mounts two Clan-tech Large Pulse Lasers in its right arm supported by two torso-mounted Clan Medium Pulse Lasers. The use of Pulse Lasers allows the pilot to maintain accuracy while running, considerably improving the design's performance. A head-mounted Clan-tech ER Small Laser is added almost as an afterthought. At melee combat range the Banzai is equipped with a Large Vibroblade in its left arm and advanced actuators to enhance its melee weapon attacks. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

content.original: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Elemental Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.875 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Корона» — это проект боевой брони, созданный кланом Звёздного Ужа после серии испытаний, определивших, какие кланы получат право на участие в операции «Возрождение». Идея заключалась в том, чтобы создать боекостюм с оружием, способным поражать мехи на расстоянии. Масса, необходимая для установки столь тяжёлого оружия, привела к снижению брони на 20% и удалению прыжкового ранца, несмотря на общее увеличение массы на 50%. Особенность: Elemental Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.875 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential. Quirk: Elemental Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Elemental, являющаяся стандартом, по которому измеряется вся боевая броня, была впервые представлена в 2868 году кланом Волка в ходе испытания владения против Нова Котов. Это было чудо инженерной мысли Кланов, позволившее небольшой группе воинов в броне уничтожить большие мехи и выжить. Хотя боевая броня может использоваться и людьми нормального роста, их конструкция разработана специально для гигантских воинов-элементалей Кланов, и только они могут раскрыть их потенциал в полной мере. Особенность: Elemental Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.87 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Flamberge C вооружен Arrow IV, парными средними импульсными лазерами, средним ER-лазером и большим ER-лазером с TAG, повышающим точность расчетов, и 6 дополнительными DHS, компенсирующими возросшую тепловую нагрузку. Особенность: Улучшенное наведение - Medium Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: Developed in the later years of the Jihad by the Jade Falcons, the Flamberge was based on an older experiment involving Partial Wing technology. A 70 ton OmniMech, the Flamberge is built around a 280-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel chassis with 13.5 tons of armor. 11 DHS are installed as standard, as are a pair of SRM-6's with 35 tons of podspace rounding out the design. The Flamberge Prime is armed with 2 ATM-6's and 4 Medium Pulse Lasers with 6 Improved Jump Jets boosting the designs mobility. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The Gnome battle armor was created by Clan Hell's Horses in response to Inner Sphere responses to the ubiquitous Elemental battle armor. Since its introduction the Gnome has been eclipsed in size by other assault-weight suits but still serves as the mainstay in most Hell's Horses' front-line Clusters and found its way into the toumans of other Clans through various Trials. Quirk: Elemental Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.875 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The 5W variant of the Goliath is armed with two Plasma Rifles which not only inflict damage on their targets but heat as well. The 5W is also armed with three Medium Lasers for close combat. The 'Mech has a Guardian ECM Suite which is needed to properly use its sixteen and a half tons of Stealth Armor. Additionally, the 'Mech has a Small Cockpit that is cramped and makes the 'Mech harder to pilot but saves valuable weight. The 'Mech also has an Improved C3 computer, allowing it to share targeting telemetry with similarly equipped units. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

The pair of LRM-10s are still present, along with a two-ton, CASE-protected ammunition bin. content.original: Produced at the Luthien Armor Works plant on Nykvarn shortly after its opening in 3071, the 9KC was created for DCMS commanders who wanted to use a C3 network composed entirely of Grand Dragons. Though the 9KC is designed as a stand-off 'Mech, it is incredibly effective at close range. The 5K is used as a base, though the 9KC does not incorporate CASE. One rear-facing laser is removed and the missile launcher is replaced with an MML-5. The PPC is swapped out for a Snub-Nose PPC and the armor is now a more efficient Light Ferro-Fibrous weave with an additional one and a half tons added. All of these weight-savings enable the inclusion of a C3 Master Computer. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Gray Death Standard battle armor was developed by the technicians of the Gray Death Legion after the New Avalon Institute of Science sent them prototype battle armor suits, the progenitors of what eventually became the Inner Sphere Standard, for field testing. Using what was learned from these tests, the Legion decided to remove the suits' jump jets to make room for dedicated anti-infantry firepower, superior sensor systems, and reinforced myomer bundles to improve ground speed. While losing the ability to leap over obstacles, these changes made the suit easier to maintain and cheaper to build than the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Advanced Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Используя результаты этих испытаний, Легион решил убрать прыжковые двигатели, чтобы освободить место для вооружения конкретно против пехоты, усовершенствованных сенсорных систем и усиленных пучков миомеров для повышения скорости движения. Несмотря на потерю способности перепрыгивать через препятствия, эти изменения сделали доспех более простым в обслуживании и более дешевым в производстве, чем «Стандарт Внутренней Сферы». Особенность: Продвинутый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

The GTR-1's main armament is its Large X-Pulse Laser, which is backed up by three Medium X-Pulse Lasers, all of which are linked to a Targeting Computer. To provide additional mobility, the Great Turtle is equipped with three torso-mounted Jump Jets. These allow the Great Turtle to get out of sticky situations relatively quickly. content.original: Produced by Irian Technologies in 3068, the 6WB is an upgrade similar in some ways to the 8D. A Small Cockpit and Ferro-Fibrous armor make room for an Improved C3 CPU, allowing the 'Mech to share targeting data with other units. The large laser has been replaced with a Heavy PPC, while the missile launcher has been swapped out for an LRM-15, though it only has one ton of ammunition. Eleven double heat sinks are barely adequate to keep waste heat from crippling the 'Mech thanks to its four ER Medium Lasers. A Compact Gyro allows the LRM-15 to be mounted in the center torso. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Right Lower, Left Upper

content.original: Wanting to improve on the Raven but finding themselves constrained by the core equipment loadout, House Liao engineers looked at radical changes. Most promising of these attempts was the Gui Guisui, so named because it "flew in like a stealthed spirit". Being a 25t LAM version of the Raven, the Gui Guisui carries a similar EWAR loadout including stealth armor, as well as a pair of built in Medium lasers and a wing-mounted pulse laser, as well as a weapon bay of Chaff. The versatility of the wing mount and bay have allowed alternative loadouts to be utilized; several operations consisting of Gui Guisui stealthily dropping support equipment to resistance fighters have been reported. Aside from the sensor interference caused by firing its signature Heavy Lasers, a number of battlefield reports indicate the heavy laser tubes can violently rupture in the heat of battle. content.original: The Hellion is a product of Clan Ice Hellion and their philosophy that espouses speed above all else. Based on the Mist Lynx, the Hellion is a fast OmniMech that has respectable firepower. This light 'Mech is rather difficult to kill, incorporating five and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. To save weight, the Hellion also uses an Endo Steel chassis. While it is not especially fast for its size, the Hellion does use MASC to allow for bursts of additional speed. The Hellion sports no fixed weapons on its chassis. The D variant carries an LRM-15, an ER Large Laser, and two Heavy Medium Lasers. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

Этот лёгкий мех довольно сложно уничтожить, так как он оснащён пятью с половиной тоннами ферроволоконной брони. Для снижения веса «Хеллион» также использует эндостальной каркас. Хотя он не особенно быстр для своих размеров, «Хеллион» использует систему MASC, позволяющую ему резко увеличивать скорость. Borrowing a page from the Clan Jenner, the C2 is armed with three MML 5s, making the 'Mech effective at all ranges with three tons of ammunition. Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor was added as well, while in order to make room for this an XL Engine, XL Gyro, and Small Cockpit were used. A C3 Slave Unit allows it to share targeting data with other members of its lance. Finally, the jump capacity is increased to 180 meters. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: This modification of the 5003-C unveiled in 3071 increases the jumping capacity to 150 meters through the inclusion of improved jump jets. Room is made for them by swapping out the lasers for paired Light PPCs and ER Medium Lasers. In addition, the heat dissipation system is upgraded to fifteen double heat sinks, allowing the CJ to handle the heat load of the weapons with no difficulty. The design still suffers from lack of CASE to protect its vulnerable ammunition bins, a fact that is especially important given the use of a standard fusion engine. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: This simple field refit of the 005, a result of the Jihad and efforts to upgrade old designs with what was available, was introduced in 3071. By removing the large laser, one of the Streak launchers, and a half-ton of armor, engineers were able to cram a Heavy PPC into the torso and upgrade the AC/20s to LB-X versions, each with three tons of ammunition. The remaining Streak system was reduced to a 4-tube launcher. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: Эта простая полевая модификация 005, ставшая результатом Джихада и попыток усовершенствовать старые конструкции с помощью имеющихся возможностей, была представлена ​​в 3071 году. Удалив большой лазер, одну из пусковых Streak установок и полтонны брони, инженеры смогли втиснуть в торс Heavy PPC и модернизировать автопушки AC/20 до версии LB-X с боезапасом в три тонны каждая. Оставшаяся Streak установка была сокращена до четырёхтрубной. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.18 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Seemingly unaware that the Federated Commonwealth was merely a memory, StarCorps Industries combined technologies from the two halves of that sundered realm to create a new variant in 3071. The 007 hearkens back to the 005 with its use of a standard engine. Primarily a medium range powerhouse, this design carries twin Rotary Autocannon/5s and Light PPCs. The Plasma Rifle can cause massive heat buildup in enemies, while the Streak SRM-6 is adept at finding and exploiting holes in an opponent's armor. The inclusion of Light Ferro-Fibrous armor allows this variant to be the most heavily-armored variant of the King Crab, albeit not by much. That armor is needed, as the autocannons and missile launcher are fed from the same place, where those ammunition bins are the only critical systems, leaving them open to damage and explosion. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Produced by Cosara Weaponries for the Word of Blake following their capture of the facility in 3069, the 008 uses the latest technologies available at the time. The autocannons have been upgraded to Heavy PPCs. The powerful weapons are backed up by paired Light Autocannon/2s, sharing one-ton of ammo in CASE-protected ammunition bin. Two ER Medium Lasers back up these guns. Like other Blakist units, a C3i Computer is included.A Guardian ECM Suite is also included. With seventeen double heat sinks and Jump Jets, this unit can jump and fire both of its main guns even with some heat to spare. Luckily this variant can be visually distinguished from others based on its more streamlined chassis, giving opponents some measure of warning. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: Произведенный компанией Cosara Weaponries для Слова Блейка после захвата ими их объекта в 3069 году, 008 использует новейшие технологии, доступные на тот момент. Автопушки были модернизированы до Heavy PPCs. Мощное оружие дополняется парными лёгкими автопушками/2, которые совместно используют тонну боеприпасов в защищённом CASE боеукладчике. Два средних ER-лазера идут как запасные. Как и другие блейкистские юниты, в комплект входит компьютер C3i. Также присутствует комплект Guardian ECM. Благодаря семнадцати двойным охладителям и прыжковым двигателям этот юнит может прыгать и стрелять из обоих своих основных орудий даже при небольшом перегреве. К счастью для противников, этот вариант можно визуально отличить от других по более обтекаемому шасси, что даёт некоторое предупреждение. Особенность: Командирский мех Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.18 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Kobold is a battle armor design that was collaborated on by the Free Rasalhague Republic, ComStar, and the second Star League. Originaly a project for a battlesuit that could mimic the capabilities of the Draconis' Kage, later the concept of shifted somewhat to a light armor that can still hold its own in battle. The Kobold can only jump up to ninety meters at a time, but it does boast enough armor to stop a Medium Laser. This armor is of the basic stealth variety, making it more difficult to target far away. Quirk: Stealth Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Кобольд» — это проект боевой брони, разработанный совместно Свободной Республикой Расальхаг, КомСтаром и Второй Звёздной Лигой. Изначально это был проект боевого костюма, способного имитировать возможности «Каге» Синдиката, но позже концепция несколько сместилась в сторону лёгкой брони, способной пережить бой. «Кобольд» может прыгать только на девяносто метров за раз, но его брони достаточно, чтобы остановить средний лазер. Эта броня обладает базовым стелсом, что затрудняет прицеливание на большом расстоянии. Особенность: Стэлс Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Like its brothers the -12DC and -12DCb, the PNT-12DC-I is a proposed upgrade of the classic Panther line by the Draconis Combine based on an Endo Steel chassis. It retains the Hermes 140 Fusion engine from earlier generations and carries an impressive seven and a half tons of standard armor. Tough and well-protected, it enjoys the typical Panther movement profile – a 120 meter jump and a top speed of nearly 65 km/h. With a right-arm mounted Heavy PPC, this Panther wields the equivalent of a Gauss Rifle with unlimited ammunition. While the range is similar to an ER Large Laser, the damage is more than double with only a slight increase in heat. Even if this was all it could do, the -12DC-I would still be an asset to any regiment. But it also carries twin Medium Lasers, backed by a Small Laser, suggesting this ‘Mech is meant to deal with city-based infantry as well as opposing BattleMechs. Quirk: Aerial Assault Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

content.original: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production. Quirk: Stealth Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Разработанный как быстрый пеший разведчик для юнитов бронепехоты, «Ротвейлер» выходит за рамки наземных скоростных возможностей обычной боевой брони. Облачённый в стелс-броню для экзокостюмов и оснащённый системой РЭБ, «Ротвейлер» представляет собой серьёзную цель. Однако эта скорость и уклончивость имеют свою цену: «Ротвейлер» легко вооружён. Каждый костюм оснащён малым лазером в качестве основного оружия и зажигательным игольником Firedrake в качестве запасного. Несмотря на невысокую огневую мощь, броня была признана приемлемой Лиранским Альянсом, и он был запущен в производство. Особенность: Стэлс Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: A strange and uncommon variant, the -11Q was an attempt to create a close quarters engagement QuadMech. A supercharger and Actuator Enhancement System was added, making to goal to get in close as fast as possible, and then unleashing its double SRM-6 launchers and bolton Tandem Rockets. Two Small Lasers were also mounted for once the ammunition ran out. The largest weakness of the design, which also led to it not seeing much use, was its 385 XXL engine which was both prone to failure and made the Quad very vulnerable for fire aimed at the side torsos. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

The original design's number of Double Heat Sinks have been increased, while the two Medium Pulse Lasers have been retained, while adding a single SRM-6 Launcher & a pair of Heavy Small Lasers. A ton of ammunition has been given to the SRM launcher, and additional armor was added. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.content: «Бездна» — это боевая броня, разработанная Синдикатом Дракона. «Войд» защищён стелс броней и представляет собой довольно мобильную боевую броню, способную совершать прыжки. Многие члены Нова Котов посчитали оригинальную PPC слишком громоздкой и заменили её своей версией винтовки Magshot Gauss. Особенность: Void Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.89 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The 2G is a variant developed to overcome the production bottleneck the off-world construction of chassis represented as disruptions of interstellar shipping increased. While El Dorado lacked the orbital facilities to produce Endo Steel, they readily produced the advanced crystalline polymers shared by double heat sinks and XL engines. Saving weight on the power plant allowed a switch to a standard chassis, with the six ER lasers replaced with 12 standard medium lasers mounted in a two over, three under configuration. Two medium lasers cover the rear of the 'Mech. An additional ton of armor is the token recognition of the increased fragility of an XL engine. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

This gives it the ability to operate far from supply for extended periods, but the damage rate is rather low when compared to other 'Mechs of a similar size. Its strength is undoubtedly its speed, which it can use to harass enemies and keep from taking too many hits. The -3B is as protected by its jump jets that can propel it up to 150 meters as by its fifteen tons of armor. A C3i Computer allows it to share targeting telemetry with other similarly equipped units. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The 9K Wolverine introduced in 3074 uses a Light Engine for power. The resulting decrease in tonnage necessitated a complete revision of the weapon systems. Its main gun is the Snub-Nose PPC mounted in the right arm. An SRM-4 is the only other heat-building weapon mounted on the 'Mech. A trio of Light Machine Guns are also in the arm, linked to a Machine Gun Array to deter infantry. To counteract battle armor, the 9K carries a pair of B-Pods. This Wolverine variant carries a Sword in its left hand and a C3 Slave in the head to feed targeting telemetry back to lance-mates. Triple Strength Myomers make the sword more powerful and the design faster when they heat up, but a MechWarrior must disengage some of the ten double heat sinks in order to build the necessary heat. In light of the heavier engine, the inclusion of a Compact Gyro seems unhelpful at best. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

The 9M can also jump up to one hundred and fifty meters, as with most other variants. The 9M is armed with a Fusigon Strongtooth Heavy PPC as its primary weapon, which has a similar damage profile to a Clan ER PPC, but at reduced ranges. content.original: This version is used in conjunction with the Maxim C3 Master. Removing the machine guns and ammunition, it expands the infantry bay to four tons, allowing it to carry a squad of battle armor. It also carries a C3 slave and keeps the TAG system. Originally produced by Maxim Transport Industries, before a series of scandals led to its closure in 3039, the fast and heavily armed Maxim quickly became the model example of a transport throughout the Inner Sphere. Still produced via different companies, the Maxim is still heavily used by many units as their principal APC. It has proven itself popular both to unit commanders, who respect its firepower, speed and ability to carry a full platoon of infantry, and to the troops it carries, who respect its roomy, comfortable infantry bay. content.original: Introduced after the Jihad, the Balac Strike VTOL was an extremely fast and versatile VTOL. Intended for anti-vehicle support, the Balac carries a pair of Type 6 ATM-6 launchers as its primary weapons. With a four ton capacity ammo bay allowing the craft to carry any combination of ATM missile loads, the Balac boasted lengthy field endurance. In case the ATMs did run dry, a nose mounted Mk.3 ER Medium Laser provided a degree of non-ammo reliant firepower. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. content.original: The Crow Scout VTOL is a military-grade, scout combat vehicle that is based upon the civilian Soar. Yan Manufacturing designed the Crow to replace the many scout BattleMechs the Draconis Combine lost during the Combine-Ghost Bear War. The Yan team kept many of the strengths of the search-and-rescue vehicle the Crow is descended from, though they improved it using military-grade technologies. Yan initially had trouble selling the Crow to the DCMS. Finally, Yan agreed to give the unit to them as long as the Combine supplied the electronics. In exchange, Yan is free to sell the unit to mercenary units. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. Поначалу у Yan возникли трудности с продажей Crow Синдикату. Но, в конце концов, Yan согласились передать им машину при условии, что Синдикат снабдит их электроникой. Взамен Yan может свободно продавать машину наёмникам. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунных биомах. Передвижение: 13/20 гексов / 390/600 метров. content.original: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by Clan Hell's Horses. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 180 30 Left 170 30 Right 170 30 Rear 125 30 Turret 150 30 Total 795 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank

content.original: Ubiquitous across the Inner Sphere, the Igor is a name given to a generic super heavy lift platform. Originally developed to rapidly relocate heavy armor under battlefield conditions, the design has since spawned a host of imitators and copy cats with almost every developed world in the Inner Sphere and the Periphery possessing at least one Igor or Igor derived clone. An FWL combat model of the 60 ton VTOL, the Igor (L-Gauss) mounts a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a C3 Slave unit, complemented by three tons of additional ordnance on the wings. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. content.original: The Musketeer hover tank is a combat vehicle designed to deliver concentrated firepower quickly and cheaply. The hovertank is as difficult to kill as a hover vehicle can be, with seven tons of ferro-fibrous armor protecting it, and CASE protecting its four-person crew from internal explosions. An ICE is inexpensive and can still maintain speeds up to 119 km/h. This version introduced in 3080 uses a fusion engine to provide power. This increases the Musketeer's top speed to 120 km/h. The Streak launchers have been removed and a four ton infantry compartment has been added, as has some armor. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. content.original: Renna Palmira, from New Samarkand Metals on Xinyang designed the Nike as an alternative to the expensive Partisan. This armored vehicle focuses on firepower rather than the command and coordination abilities of later Partisan models. By using less-expensive technology, customers who couldn't afford a Partisan still get a solid anti-aircraft platform. Built on a modified support vehicle chassis, a fuel cell engine provides a top speed of 54 km/h while thirteen tons of BAR 9 armor provides protection against most weaponry. Offensively, the Nike carries a pair of Light AC/2 and a pair of LBX/5 AC. Due to the bulkier nature of some components the Nike weighs 90 tons - ten tons heavier than its inspiration. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. content.original: First appearing in 3056, the Palisade Defense Tank is a 60-ton defensive tank found throughout the wealthier parts of the Periphery. Based on an older tank design dating back to the Succession Wars, the Palisade is designed as a multi-role tank capable of engaging Mechs or Vehicles. Capable of speeds of 60 km/h, the Palisade (Upgrade) is powered by a 240-rated Fuel Cell and carries 11.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The main gun is an LB-10X, with an LRM-15 supporting this at longer ranges. An MG provides some limited anti-infantry capabilities and CASE mitigates crew danger should an ammo explosion happen. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. content.original: The Saracen is a well-designed hovercraft: it is fast and decently armored. Its weapons are designed for maximum effect against other vehicles, using a mix of long and short-range missiles mounted in its turret. It has endeared itself to its crews due to its reliability and ruggedness and forms the backbone of many striker units. The Saracen was developed towards the end of the Third Succession War by Scarborough Limited. Shortly afterward Scarborough created two other vehicles based on the Saracen, the Scimitar and the Saladin. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. content.original: This variant trades the Beagle probe for a Guardian ECM suite, allowing Coalition forces to disrupt Word of Blake communication networks and targeting systems. The Sprint scout helicopter is a nimble fast scout platform popular within the Inner Sphere. It was first released in 3052 with much success to the beleaguered units along the Clan invasion corridor, where it was able to keep tabs on the swift deployments of the Clans and call in artillery from afar. Such was its success that it quickly became a favored unit within scout and recon detachments throughout the Inner Sphere where it continues to see widespread use. However the nature of battlefields within the Inner Sphere often highlight the one flaw of the design, its mediocre armor. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. content.content: «Йеллоу Жакет» был построен на базе Poland Model C пушки Гаусса. Последующие версии оснащались другими системами, но в целом он по-прежнему представлял собой технику с одним тяжёлым стволом. Хотя «Yellow Jacket» и не так быстр, как большинство VTOL, он всё же превосходит большинство боевых мехов и омнимехов по скорости. Дальнобойное вооружение, приличная скорость и относительно тяжёлая броня делают эту машину более безопасной, чем многие её аналоги. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунных биомах. content.original: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by Clan Hell's Horses. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. Developed by the Maxwell Planetary Defense Consortium, this Galleon variant uses some Experimental Technology to improve battlefield performance. Inclusion of a four-ton infantry bay allows the Galleon to carry a squad of battle armor equipped troopers. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. content.original: First fielded in 2765, the Atlas II was designed by the Hegemony Research and Development Department, Weapons Division of the original Star League to maintain the technological edge over the other Great Houses. It was exclusively for the SLDF's Royal Regiments. In 2785, when General Aleksandr Kerensky put out his call for loyal forces to join him in his Exodus, every Atlas II pilot responded and left with him. The Atlas II is armed with an array of weaponry, including an LB-X Autocannon/10, a pair of ER Large Lasers, and a 20-tube Long Range Missile Launcher for long range attacks. For close range combat, the 'Mech is equipped with a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers and a Holly Six Pack. In addition, the 'Mech has been given CASEfor both sides of the torso in order to keep an ammunition cook-off from consuming the 'Mech.

Мех был эксклюзивом королевских войск СОЗЛ. Спустя 20 лет, когда генерал Александр Керенский, во время Исхода, отдал приказ лояльным ему соединениям присоединиться к нему, ни один пилот этой грозной машины не осмелился ему воспротивиться. Atlas II несет массу разнообразного вооружения, такого как LB 10-X, пара ER Large Lasers и одна LRM-20 для атак на дальние расстояния. Для ближнего боя он может похвастаться двумя Medium Pulse Laser и Holly SRM-6. Также в оба борта был установлен CASE для защиты от детонации боекомплекта.

content.original: Limited to three chassis, this Banshee model was a thought experiment by Defiance Industries engineers at Kwangjong-ni. Seeking to maximize protection, these engineers installed Armored Shoulder and Armored Hip actuators to prevent the 'Mech from losing a limb. The MechWarrior is protected by an Armored Cockpit. They also maximized protection by adding a ton of Modular Armor to each arm, leg, and forward torso. To make room for this equipment, they used an Endo Steel chassis and a Clan-spec XL Engine. For weapons, the engineers installed a Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle and a pair of Bombast Lasers, while an ER Small Laser fills the head as an afterthought. Though not particularly quick (max speed 54 km/h) this Banshee variant can take massive amounts of damage before it falls. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: Limited to three chassis, this Banshee model was a thought experiment by Defiance Industries engineers at Kwangjong-ni. Seeking to maximize protection, these engineers installed Armored Shoulder and Armored Hip actuators to prevent the 'Mech from losing a limb. The MechWarrior is protected by an Armored Cockpit. They also maximized protection by adding a ton of Modular Armor to each arm, leg, and forward torso. To make room for this equipment, they used an Endo Steel chassis and a Clan-spec XL Engine. For weapons, the engineers installed a Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle and a pair of Bombast Lasers, while an ER Small Laser fills the head as an afterthought. Though not particularly quick (max speed 54 km/h) this Banshee variant can take massive amounts of damage before it falls.

content.original: Using an Improved Heavy Gauss Rifle as its main armament, this version of the Barghest also uses experimental systems to maximize protection and combat effectiveness. The Endo Steel structure and Small Cockpit save enough room to allow the 'Mech to carry two Light PPCs with PPC Capacitors in a Quad BattleMech Turret. This device allows the Barghest pilot to put accurate fire in a 360 degree arc around the 'Mech. To protect it from an exploding Gauss Rifle, the 'Mech also carries a CASE II system. Finally the LCAF installed a C3 Slave unit in the head. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12

content.original: Katherine Steiner-Davion decided during her reign over the Lyran Alliance that she wanted a four legged BattleMech that would evoke fear in its enemies in a similar vein to the classic Atlas and Banshee designs. To do this, the Barghest is built on an Earthwerk GRF Quad chassis that supports a Magna 350 XL engine that saves weight and allows the 'Mech to carry a heavy weapons payload. The Barghest is protected by thirteen tons of Durallex Heavy armor that protects it from all but the heaviest enemy fire. To handle the 'Mech's heat buildup from its weapons, the Barghest has ten double heat sinks.

content.original: Captured during the destruction of the Broadsword Legion in 3070, Calvin Magdaleno's BattleMaster was refitted by the Word of Blake on Hall to the BLR-4S standard but with a unique new weapons array. Carrying a Rotary AC/5 in its right arm and a pair of Light PPCs in its left, the torso mounted weapons consisted of two ER medium lasers and a single standard medium laser on each side supported by a left torso mounted Streak SRM-6 launcher. Two tons of autocannon reloads and a single ton for Streak Missile Launcher are supported by two extra double heat sinks. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: Versatile and powerful, the BattleMaster is one of the best known 'Mechs in existence. Originally designed to be the largest and most powerful 'Mech for the Star League armies in the 27th century, the sheer size of the BattleMaster, combined with the cost and resources needed to build one, meant the 'Mech can only be manufactured on a few planets. Still, those lucky enough to pilot a BattleMaster can attest to some of the stories surrounding the 'Mech. With good reliability, firepower and armoring, the BattleMaster is equally adept anchoring an assault lance or serving as a command vehicle.

content.content: Универсальный и мощный, BattleMaster — один из самых известных мехов. Изначально разработанный как самый большой и мощный мех для армий Звёздной Лиги в 27 веке, BattleMaster в сочетании с его огромными размерами, стоимостью и необходимыми ресурсами для его постройки, означал, что этот мех можно производить лишь на нескольких планетах. Тем не менее, те, кому посчастливилось его пилотировать, могут подтвердить некоторые мифы, связанные с этим мехом. Благодаря высокой надёжности, огневой мощи и бронированию, BattleMaster одинаково хорошо подходит как для поддержки штурмового копья, так и в качестве командирской машины.

Dropping the standard mediums for a pair of Coventry Light Autoguns and half ton of machine gun ammo, his 'Mech's armor was replaced with fourteen tons of Lexington Ltd. 'Glazed' Laser Reflective plating, making it extremely resistant to the Word of Blake's new Variable-Speed Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: This experimental model was a heavily modified CGR-1A, with almost every system given a cutting-edge makeover. The ancient and massive 400-rated engine has been replaced with an XL model. A supercharger combined with MASC gives the 'Mech an astounding top speed. The old weaponry has been replaced with an ER Large Laser and a Medium X-Pulse Laser. Chaff pods and Laser Anti-Missile Systems supplement ferro-fibrous armor, and the 'Mech carries an advanced suite of electronics. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: Because the designers of the Charger wanted to discourage any activities that would put the 'Mech in danger, the engineers at Wells Technologies equipped the Charger with five Magna Mk I Small Lasers, mounted in its arms, torso and head. As these leave the 'Mech dangerously undergunned, arguably its most potent weapons are its fists; if the Charger is able to close the distance and get within hand-to-hand combat, it is more than capable of pounding to pieces other 'Mechs, especially lightweight ones.

content.original: This variant is apparently an attempt by the Jade Falcons to use experimental technology in a combat unit. Originally mistaken for a LAM, the Cougar-XR uses a Partial Wing to extend its jump range to 210 meters. An LRM-15 launcher equipped with Artemis V FCS is located in each side torso, while an ER Medium Pulse Laser provides direct fire. It appears that the Cougar-XR is a standard BattleMech instead of being an OmniMech like its progenitor design. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Lightbringer is a heavily customized 'Mech designed for close combat in the Solaris arenas. A deadly close-in fighter, the Lightbringer has recently been seen fighting in grudge matches across the Free Worlds League. After removing the standard armament and jump jets from a DV-8D, Nikos Matapoulous installed eight improved jump jets in the legs and torso, and each arm is now equipped with a pair of ER medium lasers and a snub-nose PPC. A helmet of spikes, arranged in a crown, protects the 'Mech's head from melee attacks, and a pair of coolant pods helps shed the massive heat load from the Lightbringer's arsenal. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Dervish carries as its main weapons two Federated 10-Shot LRM launchers. These missile launchers give the Dervish the long-range capability needed to provide fire support to friendly units and are safely embedded in the torso as opposed to the exposed launchers on other 'Mechs. A ton of ammunition per launcher provides sufficient endurance for any but the most prolonged battles. For close combat, the Dervish carries two Federated 2-Shot SRM launchers and two ChisComp 39 Medium Lasers. The SRM launchers are completely self-contained within the forearms, allowing them to be aimed quickly, and fed by a ton of ammunition each. The lasers are placed just above the launchers and ensure the 'Mech is still capable of fighting should it run out of missiles. The Dervish is capable of jumping 150 meters and is protected by seven and a half tons of armor.

content.original: Developed on New Avalon during the Word of Blake attacks, the MUSE COMPACT project was an attempt to study ways of returning battlefield salvage to action. Their test-bed configuration was the ENF-7X. This Enforcer III variant uses several Clan-produced components, including the Endo Steel skeleton, Ferro-Fibrous armor, XL Engine, and double heat sinks. All the existing armament was removed and replaced by an experimental Binary Laser Cannon in each arm. The Enforcer III MUSE COMPACT retains the standard ground performance of the Enforcer III but adds Improved Jump Jets to improve jumping abilities. An XL Gyro provides the weight savings needed to mount this equipment. During the Jihad, the House Davion's Department of Military Communications and Research was trying to find a way to create a production version of this prototype. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Their test-bed configuration was the ENF-7X. This Enforcer III variant uses several Clan-produced components, including the Endo Steel skeleton, Ferro-Fibrous armor, XL Engine, and double heat sinks. All the existing armament was removed and replaced by an experimental Binary Laser Cannon in each arm. The Enforcer III MUSE COMPACT retains the standard ground performance of the Enforcer III but adds Improved Jump Jets to improve jumping abilities. An XL Gyro provides the weight savings needed to mount this equipment. During the Jihad, the House Davion's Department of Military Communications and Research was trying to find a way to create a production version of this prototype. content.original: An experimental 'Mech ahead of its time, the HER-7S is the brainchild of Baron Roderick Axel of Lopez, who long believed he knew better than the military industrial complex how to develop an advanced upgrade of the Hermes II. Unfortunately, he was short on practical understanding of the true cost involved. Built on a composite internal structure, powered by a massive 320-rated XXL engine and clad in relatively low seven an half tons of armor, the HER-7S had a top speed of over 120 km/h and a 240 meter jump distance. Mounting 10 double heat sinks, an ER flamer, a Clan-spec large pulse laser, and a light PPC linked to a Clan-grade targeting computer, the 'Mech is a deadly combatant. However, due to the absurd expense and extreme fragility of the design, only three prototypes were manufactured, and in fact the whole proceedings seem to have been just a way for IBMU to use the Baron's money to gain more hands-on experience with the technologies involved. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Hermes II was first produced in 2798, based on the original Hermes BattleMech that had been used by the Star League. A heavy scout, the Hermes II boasted respectable weaponry, armoring, and speed, allowing it to easily brawl with lighter 'Mechs or survive an encounter with heavier 'Mechs and retreat. Out of all medium-weight 'Mechs at the time the Hermes II was the easiest to perform field maintenance on, leading to its nickname 'old reliable.' As combination scout and light strike platforms, Hermes II 'Mechs often operated alone, employed for missions for which lighter 'Mechs were too fragile and heavier 'Mechs too clumsy. The Hermes II was in its element when operating in a restrictive environment like a forest or city, where it could employ a most unusual tactic of setting its surroundings on fire to escape pursuit. Since most 'Mech pilots would naturally avoid a fire to prevent overheating and the flames interfered with most thermal scanners, starting a blaze allowed the Hermes II to more easily slip away.

content.original: The Mech of the 2nd Dieron Regulars' commander, Tai-sa Cale Schultz-Tanaka, the Kodiak 'Cale' was recovered from a battlefield on Dieron and re-equipped with Inner Sphere and Clan technologies. Keeping the standard Clan Endo-Steel chassis and double heat sinks, techs replaced the XL engine with a standard unit. This reduced the 'Mech's top speed to 54 km/h, but increased survivability. Most of the Clan weaponry was also removed: Only a trio of Clan ER Medium Lasers in the left arm and a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in the left torso remain. The Kodiak Cale uses an Autocannon/10 and Heavy PPC for its main hitting power. These are backed up by the Clan weapons and a pair of Inner Sphere ER Medium Lasers and a pair of Inner Sphere Medium Lasers. The most important addition to the Cale version is the electronics suite: A Beagle Active Probe in the right torso spots enemy forces, while a C3 Master computer in the left torso allows the Kodiak Cale to feed targeting data to supporting units. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: This experimental Orion 3100 variant was introduced in 3075 as 'a BattleMech for the thirty-second century'; although its flaws prevented any immediate production it gave Kali Yama valuable experience and a few prototypes were sold. It is equipped with an experimental Extended LRM-10 and Improved Heavy Gauss Rifle. Three tons of ammunition feeds the LRM launcher while the iHGR gets four tons of ammunition. For close in work, this Orion variant has an ER Medium Laser in each arm. To provide room for these weapons, the 'Mech has an XL Engine, standard armor, and standard internal structure, and only the ELRM ammo is protected by CASE. content.original: The largest BattleMech ever built by HildCo Interplanetary, the Pillager is built as a larger version of the Victor, and is intended for assaulting urban centers and hardened fortifications. These design parameters were paramount as the SLDF mobilized to wage the Reunification War. Later Pillagers were upgraded with more cutting-edge Star League technology. Production of the Pillager halted not because its facility was destroyed, but the advanced Gauss rifle and XL engine production lines had been obliterated by the end of the Second Succession War. Curiously, HildCo did not restart production of the original PLG-1N, rather the Pillager lines only began production again in 3058 when advanced components were once again available for the PLG-3Z.

Curiously, HildCo did not restart production of the original PLG-1N, rather the Pillager lines only began production again in 3058 when advanced components were once again available for the PLG-3Z.

content.original: The Shogun began production before the Star League fell and eventually was thought to be lost to the Succession Wars. The 'Mech suddenly reappeared when Wolf's Dragoons showed up in 3005, bringing a sizable number of Shoguns with them. The 'Mech was intended to be used as an urban combat 'Mech where its jumping distance and slow speed makes it able to easily traverse the close confines of a city. Though the Dragoons brought Shoguns with them from the Clan Homeworlds, they could not reach a deal with any manufacturer that met their desires, so by 3068 the total count of the 'Mech in the Inner Sphere was reduced to two, both of which were in the hands of Wannamaker's Widowmakers, taken as salvage from the Dragoons.

content.content: Производство «Сёгуна» началось ещё до падения Звёздной Лиги, и в конечном итоге все посчитали, что мех был утерян в Наследных войнах. Мех внезапно появился вновь с появлением Волчьих Драгун в 3005 году, приведя с собой значительное количество «Сёгунов». Мех предназначался для использования в качестве городского боевого меха, где его дальность прыжка и низкая скорость позволяли ему легко пересекать тесные городские границы. Хотя Драгуны привезли с собой «Сёгунов» из родных миров Кланов, им не удалось заключить сделку ни с одним производителем, который бы отвечал их требованиям, поэтому к 3068 году общее количество этих мехов во Внутренней Сфере сократилось до двух, оба из которых оказались в руках Wannamaker's Widowmakers, отнятых у Драгун.

content.original: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by Clan Hell's Horses. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None. content.original: A light combat vehicle that first saw production in 2692 the Galleon proved to be an economical means of supporting infantry and BattleMechs. With a top speed faster than most 'Mechs, the Galleon was mobile but generally lacked protection, early models carrying only three and a half tons of armor. After the Exodus, these tracked vehicles mostly fell into the possession of the Draconis Combine and the Free Worlds League. The Galleon is often paired with the Harasser Missile Platform. Developed by the Maxwell Planetary Defense Consortium, this Galleon variant uses some Experimental Technology to improve battlefield performance. Inclusion of a four-ton infantry bay allows the Galleon to carry a squad of battle armor equipped troopers. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. content.original: Limited to three chassis, this Banshee model was a thought experiment by Defiance Industries engineers at Kwangjong-ni. Seeking to maximize protection, these engineers installed Armored Shoulder and Armored Hip actuators to prevent the 'Mech from losing a limb. The MechWarrior is protected by an Armored Cockpit. They also maximized protection by adding a ton of Modular Armor to each arm, leg, and forward torso. To make room for this equipment, they used an Endo Steel chassis and a Clan-spec XL Engine. For weapons, the engineers installed a Silver Bullet Gauss Rifle and a pair of Bombast Lasers, while an ER Small Laser fills the head as an afterthought. Though not particularly quick (max speed 54 km/h) this Banshee variant can take massive amounts of damage before it falls. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19

content.original: The Lightbringer is a heavily customized 'Mech designed for close combat in the Solaris arenas. A deadly close-in fighter, the Lightbringer has recently been seen fighting in grudge matches across the Free Worlds League. After removing the standard armament and jump jets from a DV-8D, Nikos Matapoulous installed eight improved jump jets in the legs and torso, and each arm is now equipped with a pair of ER medium lasers and a snub-nose PPC. A helmet of spikes, arranged in a crown, protects the 'Mech's head from melee attacks, and a pair of coolant pods helps shed the massive heat load from the Lightbringer's arsenal. content.original: Developed on New Avalon during the Word of Blake attacks, the MUSE COMPACT project was an attempt to study ways of returning battlefield salvage to action. Their test-bed configuration was the ENF-7X. This Enforcer III variant uses several Clan-produced components, including the Endo Steel skeleton, Ferro-Fibrous armor, XL Engine, and double heat sinks. All the existing armament was removed and replaced by an experimental Binary Laser Cannon in each arm. The Enforcer III MUSE COMPACT retains the standard ground performance of the Enforcer III but adds Improved Jump Jets to improve jumping abilities. An XL Gyro provides the weight savings needed to mount this equipment. During the Jihad, the House Davion's Department of Military Communications and Research was trying to find a way to create a production version of this prototype. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: An experimental 'Mech ahead of its time, the HER-7S is the brainchild of Baron Roderick Axel of Lopez, who long believed he knew better than the military industrial complex how to develop an advanced upgrade of the Hermes II. Unfortunately, he was short on practical understanding of the true cost involved. Built on a composite internal structure, powered by a massive 320-rated XXL engine and clad in relatively low seven an half tons of armor, the HER-7S had a top speed of over 120 km/h and a 240 meter jump distance. Mounting 10 double heat sinks, an ER flamer, a Clan-spec large pulse laser, and a light PPC linked to a Clan-grade targeting computer, the 'Mech is a deadly combatant. However, due to the absurd expense and extreme fragility of the design, only three prototypes were manufactured, and in fact the whole proceedings seem to have been just a way for IBMU to use the Baron's money to gain more hands-on experience with the technologies involved. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Mech of the 2nd Dieron Regulars' commander, Tai-sa Cale Schultz-Tanaka, the Kodiak 'Cale' was recovered from a battlefield on Dieron and re-equipped with Inner Sphere and Clan technologies. Keeping the standard Clan Endo-Steel chassis and double heat sinks, techs replaced the XL engine with a standard unit. This reduced the 'Mech's top speed to 54 km/h, but increased survivability. Most of the Clan weaponry was also removed: Only a trio of Clan ER Medium Lasers in the left arm and a pair of Streak SRM-6 launchers in the left torso remain. The Kodiak Cale uses an Autocannon/10 and Heavy PPC for its main hitting power. These are backed up by the Clan weapons and a pair of Inner Sphere ER Medium Lasers and a pair of Inner Sphere Medium Lasers. The most important addition to the Cale version is the electronics suite: A Beagle Active Probe in the right torso spots enemy forces, while a C3 Master computer in the left torso allows the Kodiak Cale to feed targeting data to supporting units. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.content: The Mech of the 2nd Dieron Regulars' commander, Tai-sa Cale Schultz-Tanaka, the Kodiak 'Cale' was recovered from a battlefield on Dieron and re-equipped with Inner Sphere and Clan technologies. Keeping the standard Clan Endo-Steel chassis and double heat sinks, techs replaced the XL engine with a standard unit. This reduced the 'Mech's top speed to 54 km/h, but increased survivability. content.original: With 'Mechs having begun their rule of the open battlefields the Gallant was intended as a niche product for the specific role of urban warfare and infantry support. Developed by Freeport Armorworks on Helm (production was later taken over by Kallon Industries on Loyalty) the design was nearly killed by budget issues which forced downgrades to the planned fusion power plant and other modern features, though eventually it was equipped at least with CASE. To fulfill its urban combat role the vehicle featured a low, very heavily armored chassis with self-inflating tires, a necessity to keep the heavy six-wheeler mobile under fire. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 35 Left 260 35 Right 260 35 Rear 215 35 Turret 260 35 Total 1315 175 Quirk: Main Battle Tank

Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 35 Left 260 35 Right 260 35 Rear 215 35 Turret 260 35 Total 1315 175 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
content.content: С началом господства мехов на полях сражений Gallant задумывался как нишевый продукт, предназначенный для ведения боевых действий в городских условиях и поддержки пехоты. Разработанный компанией Freeport Armorworks на Хельме (производство впоследствии перешло к Kallon Industries на Лоялти), проект едва не был загублен из-за бюджетных ограничений, которые привели к отказу от запрашиваемого термоядерного двигателя и других современных функций, хотя в конечном итоге он был оснащён хотя бы системой CASE. Для выполнения своих функций в городских условиях машина имела низкое и очень прочное бронированное шасси с самонадувающимися шинами, что было необходимо для обеспечения мобильности тяжёлого шестиколёсного автомобиля под обстрелом. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 3/5 гексов / 90/150 метров. Броня: Ferro-Fibrous Структура: Structure Знач-я Б С Перед 320 35 Лево 260 35 Право 260 35 Зад 215 35 Турель 260 35 Итого 1315 175 Особенность: Основной боевой танк

The weapons have been reworked as well, with the 'Mech mounting three ER medium lasers and two medium X-Pulse lasers, all tied into a targeting computer. The armor, engine, and chassis remain identical to a standard 11D. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

The ALB-5W was built at the behest of the Word of Blake during the Jihad, serving most infamously as the basis for Precentor Dantalion’s custom command 'Mech. Carrying one ER PPC, one Large VSP Laser and six other assorted lasers lead to a very heat producing but high output firing profile. To improve it further, the ER PPC had a PPC Capacitor connected. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Albatross does not specialize in one role and is more of a workhorse design than anything else. The 'Mech carries an Irian Weapons Works V7 LRM-15 launcher which gives it long range and indirect fire support capabilities. This is backed up by an Oriente Model O LB-X Autocannon/10 and a Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser which give the 'Mech a powerful long-range punch. The 'Mech carries a Tronel PPL-20 Large Pulse Laser which allows the 'Mech to engage an enemy at the edge of the medium to long-range envelope. Finally, for close combat, the 'Mech has an Irian Weapons Works 60mm SRM-6 and two Irian Weapons Works Super 6 Medium Lasers.

content.original: Newly developed by Clan Jade Falcon for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere, the Black Lanner is a fast medium OmniMech that can take on a variety of roles. Intended as a front-line 'Mech, the Black Lanner makes use of all weight-saving technology available to the Clan Jade Falcon scientists who designed it, including an XL engine, endo steel, and eight tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Black Lanner also includes a MASC system on the base chassis that enables it to run up to 151 km/h in bursts, allowing it to outrun many 'Mechs half its size. The design sacrifices pod space for that speed however, with an engine almost half the Black Lanner's weight leaving a mere 13 tons for offensive weaponry.

content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth. content.original: Conceived as a long-range infantry support Mech, the ill-fated Jackrabbit entered prototyping mere weeks before the Amaris Coup. Mass produced without regard for its design flaws, the 25 ton Jackrabbit suffered from anaemic firepower and poor armor; resulting in a bad reputation and the eventual extinction of the design. Powered by a 150-rated Fusion Engine, the Jackrabbit carries 3.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-9W to carry a Light AC/5 and a Streak SRM-2, both with a single ton of ammo. An ER Medium Laser rounds out the weapons. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Like other IIC designs, visual similarities between it and its predecessor initially led ComStar to incorrectly label the design as a mere refit of the original.

content.original: Manufactured by the Jade Falcons from 3077 onward on a Sudeten-based production line adjacent to that of the Turkina, the IIC 5 is similar to the original, its arms carrying paired ER PPCs for anti-'Mech duty but with underslung AP Gauss Rifles to keep infantry at bay. Reminiscent of Star League Marauders GM Whirlwind, a HAG 20 sits in the dorsal assembly along with two tons of ammunition. The IIC 5 maintains the 11.5 tons of ferro fibrous armor used for the original, though some is shifted from the arms and side torsos to the legs and center torso. Nineteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech's heat levels totally under control. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

The weapons are all linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, making the 5T incredibly accurate. Finally, the 5T is protected by fourteen tons of armor. content.original: This unusual configuration appears to be used to support boarding actions against enemy spacecraft. Two torso mounted liquid storage tanks provide additional reaction mass for the jump jets. Eight machine guns can rapidly destroy enemy battle armor, while three heavy medium lasers and three micro pulse lasers scour the armor off of hardened targets. To keep track of enemy units, the U configuration carries a light active probe, and a Clan ECM suite interferes with enemy targeting systems. The right arm carries a spot welder presumably to seal hull breaches. Strangely, this configuration carries a sword, marking the first time a Clan unit has carried a dedicated melee weapon. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

The right arm carries a spot welder presumably to seal hull breaches. Strangely, this configuration carries a sword, marking the first time a Clan unit has carried a dedicated melee weapon. Особенность: Боевой компьютер Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: Intended to operate at a longer range than most other Stinger variants, House Steiner began manufacturing the 6S in 3067. It used a light fusion engine to push the 'Mech up to speeds of 118.8 km/h and was capable of reaching speeds of 151.2 km/h through the use of a MASC system. The 'Mech could also jump up to two hundred and ten meters. An additional weight saving measure on this variant was the use of a small cockpit. The 'Mech was armed with two light machine guns for anti-infantry and crowd control use, and to defend itself against 'Mechs and vehicles, the 6S had a single ER medium laser. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.content: Основанная на варианте STG-3P и представленная в 3076 году, эта модель тоже использует шасси из эндостали. An anti-missile system is carried in the right torso. Three ER medium lasers are mounted in the left torso, and this is supplemented by an SRM-6. Main firepower comes from an ER PPC in the right arm. Fifteen double heat sinks are fitted and a Heavy-Duty Gyro is also present. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Thunderbolt started production in 2491 as a planetary-assault 'Mech, and in fact was one of the heaviest 'Mechs that could be produced at that time. Since then the 'Mech, known affectionately as the T-Bolt, has had its classification changed as larger 'Mechs were built but thanks to periodic updates it is still feared and respected by many. With its varied arsenal, the Thunderbolt remains one of the best-armed 'Mechs, making it capable of serving in many roles. It is also an incredibly well-armored 'Mech, rivaling or exceeding the amount of armor carried by some assault 'Mechs. One downside to the Thunderbolt though is poor heat management.

С тех пор классификация меха, ласково называемого T-Bolt, менялась по мере строительства более крупных мехов, но благодаря периодическим обновлениям его по-прежнему боятся и уважают многие. Благодаря своему разнообразному арсеналу Thunderbolt остаётся одним из наиболее вооруженных мехов, что делает его способным выполнять множество ролей. Кроме того, это невероятно хорошо бронированный мех, соперничающий или превосходящий по количеству брони некоторые штурмовые мехи. Однако одним из недостатков Thunderbolt является плохое управление теплом.

content.original: A newer variant of the Thunderbolt first built in 3069, the 11SE uses some of the newest technologies available in the Inner Sphere thanks to the modern Earthwerks facilities on Keystone. The 'Mech is armed with a new Snub-Nose PPC that is excellent for close range combat. The 'Mech also has a MML-7 launcher which is capable of firing both LRM and SRM ammunition. For close combat, the 11SE has three ER medium lasers. This variant has added mobility by adding improved jump jets that allow it to jump up to one hundred and eighty meters. The lasers and PPCs are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer and the 'Mech has a Guardian ECM Suite to defend it against enemy electronic warfare systems. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Apparently a variant on the 9NAIS, the 60-RLA was first spotted in 3072 and adds enough jump jets to vault up to 150 meters at a time. Like the 17S, the RLA also uses eleven and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor and Triple Strength Myomer. Both arms have hands and lack weapons, but are able to take off an enemy's head with the TSM activated. In order to build up this heat, it mounts a pair of Snub-Nose PPCs, three ER medium lasers, two medium pulse lasers, two small lasers, and a small pulse laser. Twelve double heat sinks dissipate some of the heat these weapons build. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: This field expedient refit emerged during the Jihad in 3072. It uses an experimental Bloodhound Active Probe to find enemy forces, a Guardian ECM Suite to blind them, and a Light PPC, Large VSP Laser, three ER medium lasers, and a Streak SRM-6 to destroy them. Two leg-mounted B-Pods prevent battle armor infantry from getting too close, and a C3 slave allows this T-Bolt to coordinate its fire. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: This variant uses an XL engine on an endo steel frame to propel the Wasp up to 129 km/h. It also mounts enough jump jets to match, with a maximum range of 240 meters per jump. It has to use this speed to good effect, as it is only protected by three tons of armor. The right arm medium laser was upgraded to an ER medium laser, and the design uses 10 double heat sinks to dissipate waste heat. Finally, a MML-5 with two tons of ammunition gives it a decent punch at all ranges. In order to make room for these upgrades, a small cockpit and XL gyro are also used. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.
