content.content: Названный в честь демонического волка из германских мифов, «Фенрир» представлял собой скорее мобильную платформу огневой поддержки, чем традиционный боевой костюм. Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Conceived as a long-range infantry support Mech, the ill-fated Jackrabbit entered prototyping mere weeks before the Amaris Coup. Mass produced without regard for its design flaws, the 25 ton Jackrabbit suffered from anaemic firepower and poor armor; resulting in a bad reputation and the eventual extinction of the design. Powered by a 150-rated Fusion Engine, the Jackrabbit carries 3.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-9W to carry a Light AC/5 and a Streak SRM-2, both with a single ton of ammo. An ER Medium Laser rounds out the weapons. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

Ten tons of ammunition supply these mammoth guns, while fifteen tons of armor protect the 'Mech. content.original: Manufactured by the Jade Falcons from 3077 onward on a Sudeten-based production line adjacent to that of the Turkina, the IIC 5 is similar to the original, its arms carrying paired ER PPCs for anti-'Mech duty but with underslung AP Gauss Rifles to keep infantry at bay. Reminiscent of Star League Marauders GM Whirlwind, a HAG 20 sits in the dorsal assembly along with two tons of ammunition. The IIC 5 maintains the 11.5 tons of ferro fibrous armor used for the original, though some is shifted from the arms and side torsos to the legs and center torso. Nineteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech's heat levels totally under control. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.21 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: This unusual configuration appears to be used to support boarding actions against enemy spacecraft. Two torso mounted liquid storage tanks provide additional reaction mass for the jump jets. Eight machine guns can rapidly destroy enemy battle armor, while three heavy medium lasers and three micro pulse lasers scour the armor off of hardened targets. To keep track of enemy units, the U configuration carries a light active probe, and a Clan ECM suite interferes with enemy targeting systems. The right arm carries a spot welder presumably to seal hull breaches. Strangely, this configuration carries a sword, marking the first time a Clan unit has carried a dedicated melee weapon. content.original: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

content.content: Многоцелевой боевой мех, разработанный в 2550 году во время Золотого века, Shadow Hawk представляет собой мощное сочетание маневренности и огневой мощи. Благодаря сочетанию оружия дальнего и ближнего боя, хорошей маневренности благодаря прыжковым двигателям и отличной выносливости, Shadow Hawk долгое время считался одним из лучших мехов в своей весовой категории. Shadow Hawk одинаково хорош как в роли командира развед роты, так и в качестве засветчика для тяжелых и штурмовых отрядов.

content.original: Piloted by Francis Indigo, this custom version used Experimental Technology to make a fearsome arena fighter. Using a Endo Steel Internal Structure and light ferro-fibrous armor for baseline protection, The Lich also uses Armored Sensors, an Armored Engine and a Heavy-Duty Gyro to stay in the fight a lot longer. The arm-mounted weapons were replaced with a Snub-Nose PPC with PPC Capacitor and an ER medium laser. The standard SRM-6 was replaced with a Clan-tech Streak SRM-6 and the medium lasers upgraded to ER models. The small lasers were removed, along with the machine guns and their ammunition, while CASE II protected the Streak ammunition. Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Clan Diamond Shark began fielding a variant armed with the newest in Gauss rifle technology in 3069. While some intelligence suggests that the Star Adders were the original developers of this variant, Variant 5 has been seen commonly with the Diamond Sharks and sold to other Inner Sphere Clans such the Ghost Bears. In later years some have been reported with Inner Sphere units as well. It mounts two HAG 20s and four AP Gauss Rifles. The resemblance to the original is uncanny, though the HAGs must make the best of four tons of ammunition between them. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: Created in 3058 in response to a call from Kurita to build more cost-effective BattleMechs with which to combat the Clans, the Akuma was designed by Independence Weaponry as a low-cost alternative to their Atlas variant. The Akuma actually shares several components with the Atlas and, much like that design, also features a head design intended to evoke fear in its enemies. The Akuma is built on a Foundation AKU Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a rugged and reliable GM 270 fusion engine that allows the 'Mech to reach a top speed of 54.0 km/h. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks to dissipate waste heat and carries seventeen and a half tons of Durallex Special Heavy armor for protection from enemy fire.

content.original: This variant of the Buccaneer is almost completely a new 'Mech, with the exception of the hatchet and XL engine. The 5W is a vicious city fighter that uses a plasma rifle to damage enemies and force heat buildup in enemy 'Mechs, complemented by a trio of heavy machine guns linked together in a Hellespont Machine Gun Array. The 5W also includes a C3i computer that allows it to share targeting data with other Blakist units. In order to make room for all of these enhancements, the 5W's engine has been downgraded to a 275-rated, giving it a top speed of 86.4 km/h, but it adds seven improved jump jets that allow it to jump 210 meters at a time. The standard complement of double heat sinks keeps the Buccaneer cool, but space constraints necessitated the downgrading of the armor to 10 tons of light ferro-fibrous. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Buccaneer is a product of the Word of Blake's voracious appetite for military equipment in its first few years, as the order had far more MechWarriors than they had 'Mechs. The Buccaneer was originally designed to be used by ComStar, but had not begun production. When the schism that created the Word of Blake occurred, the design was modified to accommodate equipment available to the Word of Blake in their temporary home of the Free Worlds League. The Buccaneer is built with a lightweight VOX 330 XL engine giving the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. It also carries an impressive ten tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the maximum amount of protection the chassis can carry, and mounts 10 double heat sinks as standard.

content.original: The Arbalest was first used during the Word of Blake Jihad by Clan Nova Cat as they sought to improve their second-line forces. The Arbalest's long range firepower makes up for its relatively slow speed when compared to other clan 'Mechs of a similar size. To make production easier and faster, Clan Nova Cat engineers used less expensive components that were readily available in the Inner Sphere. content.original: Following the move of Clan Ghost Bear to the Inner Sphere, Khan Bjorn Jorgensson ordered the creation of a new BattleMech. The Arcas was designed as a symbol to mark the beginning of a new era, so Loremaster Laurie Tseng named it after a character in the mythology of the Greeks who eventually became the constellation known as Ursa Minor. First produced in 3061, the Arcas is expensive for a second-line 'Mech. It utilizes an XL engine that enables it to move up to 86 km/h and jump jets for a maximum jump capacity of one hundred fifty meters at a time. The Arcas mounts thirteen and a half tons of standard armor, the most a 'Mech of its size can carry.

content.original: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.

Массивная огневая мощь Awesome также позволяет использовать его в оборонительных действиях, при необходимости выступая в роли мобильной турели. Благодаря использованию PPC, Awesome способен действовать автономно в течение длительного времени. Эта особенность также полезна в осадных ситуациях, когда мехи могут вести постоянный обстрел, позволяя выигрывать битвы на истощение за счет обескровливания противника. Единственным недостатком Awesome является низкая маневренность и отсутствие заднего оружия, что делает его уязвимым для захода и обстрела в спину более легкими мехами, хотя хорошая разведка и хорошо развернутые силы прикрытия могут смягчить эту проблему.

content.original: The Balius is a quadrupedal, front-line OmniMech produced by Clan Hell's Horses. It is a totem 'Mech, resembling a horse, that is meant to improve morale as much as to be an effective combat unit. There is apparently no factory producing this design. Instead, it is hand-crafted by a crew of technicians specifically selected for the task by the Khan. This has led to few Balius' being produced, so the 'Mech is only in the hands of select Bloodnamed warriors. Truly a frontline Omni, the Balius makes use of weight-saving technologies in the form of an Endo Steel chassis, eleven tons of ferro-fibrous armor, and an XL engine. However, on a quad, this leaves little room for other components. It does allow for great speed, though, and the Balius maxes out at 97 km/h, quite fast for a 'Mech its size.

content.content: «Балиус» — четвероногий омнимех первой линии, производимый кланом Адских Лошадей. Это тотемный мех, напоминающий лошадь, призванный не только повышать боевой дух, но и быть эффективной боевой единицей. По-видимому, завода, выпускающего этого меха не существует. Вместо этого он собирается вручную бригадой техов, специально отобранных для этой задачи ханом. Это привело к тому, что на свет вышло мало Balius, поэтому мех находится только в руках избранных воинов с кровным именем. Будучи истинно омнисом первой линии, Balius использует технологии экономии веса в виде эндостального шасси, одиннадцати тонн ферроволоконной брони и двигателя XL. Однако на кваде это оставляет мало места для других компонентов. Тем не менее, он весьма быстр, Balius развивает максимальную скорость 97 км/ч, что довольно быстро для меха его размера.

content.original: The Balius is a quadrupedal, front-line OmniMech produced by Clan Hell's Horses. However, on a quad, this leaves little room for other components. It does allow for great speed, though, and the Balius maxes out at 97 km/h, quite fast for a 'Mech its size.

content.original: An advanced tech variant of the Beowulf introduced during the Jihad that has its weapon systems revised with the era's newest weaponry. The large pulse laser and one ER medium laser were dropped for a pair of medium variable speed pulse lasers in the left arm and a pair of ER small lasers, one standard small laser, and a 'Mech sword in the right arm. Triple Strength Myomer replaces the MASC to give a slightly slower, but less risky means of achieving higher speeds and deal heavier melee damage. To aid in reaching the heat levels needed for the TSM to activate, a pair of double heat sinks were removed. The Beowulf also features a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: Built with the intention of showing solidarity in the spirit of the new Star League, the Black Watch is the culmination of the efforts of Cosara Weaponries, the Northwind Highlanders, and Captain Neil Campbell of the Royal Black Watch. The Black Watch is built on the same chassis as the classic Crockett which served with distinction in the old Star League Defense Force. The 'Mech is powered by the rugged and durable Strand 255 fusion engine, giving the Black Watch a top speed of 54.0 km/h. For added mobility, the Black Watch has three Rawlings 54 jump jets that allow the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters. The Black Watch has ten double heat sinks that are more than adequate for the needs of the 'mech and has fifteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor with CASE to protect itself from ammunition explosions.

content.original: The Blood Reaper was built around a pair of ATM-6 Launchers, one per torso, which provided it with flexible multirange firepower. At long range they were supported by a hard-hitting ER PPC in each arm, while a pair of Heavy Medium Lasers offered enhanced close-range punch. A three ton ammo bay for each ATM launcher allowed the MechWarrior to carry two tons of each of three of the ATM missile types, ensuring maximum tactical flexibility in the field. Sharing a similar reverse-canted leg, energy weapon arm and missile launcher torso layout as the iconic Timber Wolf, the Blood Reaper was built on an Endo Steel frame and uses an XL engine to save weight for a heavy weapon and armor load. Slower than most front-line OmniMechs, the Blood Reaper featured a 120 meter jump capacity to help overcome this. Eighteen Double Heat Sinks provided the design adequate endurance. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Paying tribute to other highly successful Clan Wolf designs, the Blood Reaper is a symbolic and straightforward second-line BattleMech in heavy use in the post-Jihad Clan Wolf touman. Seeking to standardize his forces and weed out non-Wolf designs, Khan Vlad Ward ordered his scientists to develop a rugged yet symbolic 'Mech for warriors of Clan Wolf to rally around. A standard BattleMech in the mold of the successful Tundra Wolf, the Blood Reaper first entered service in 3079 and went on to form a large part of the Wolves' post-Jihad touman. Khan Ward overcame the stigma of a second-line machine with classic Clan posturing; by insisting that warriors truly worthy of the spirit of the Wolf would win even while being hobbled by such a design.

content.original: Introduced during the Jihad, this variant of the Bowman replaces the Arrow IV with a HAG/20 supplied with three tons of ammunition. The LRM system has been replaced with an ATM-9 and three tons of ammo. content.original: The Bowman first saw production in 2960 as Clan Hell's Horses started a crash program to build defensive BattleMechs following the fall of Tokasha MechWorks to Clan Ghost Bear in 2921. Now a rare sight on the battlefield, the Bowman began its life as an artillery platform mounting a pair of Arrow IV artillery systems. However, this configuration never met with success, due mostly to Clan biases against indirect warfare. Therefore, the Bowman was modified to its present "standard" configuration in 2973. Still unpopular with Clan warriors, the Bowman is primarily utilized by Clan Hell's Horses.

content.original: The primary long range firepower of the Brahma comes from the Light AC/5 built into the torso. This weapon has a slightly shorter range than a standard AC/5 but the weight saved allows the Brahma to carry a trio of ER Medium Lasers for close combat. The LAC/5 can also use special autocannon ammunition types captured from the AFFS. A Streak SRM-6 insures that every missile will inflict the maximum amount of damage possible. To destroy enemy infantry, the Brahma uses a single Flamer. Finally, the head-mounted anti-missile system prevented the Brahma from being overwhelmed by a massive rocket launcher salvo. The standard armor and chassis are quickly and easily produced by the Taurians, while the XL Engine pushes the 'Mech to a top speed of 86 km/h. To provide extra mobility the Brahma has a 90 meter jump capability. To protect the MechWarrior, the Brahma carries over twelve tons of armor and uses CASE to protect the ammunition. Finally, the Targeting Computer improves weapon accuracy and provides a nasty surprise for anyone foolish enough to dismiss the Brahma. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Brahma was designed after the Taurian Concordat was invaded during the Jihad. During that time, the Taurian Defense Force took heavy losses when they put their older machines up against the cutting edge technologies available to the Federated Suns. Though the Taurians were successful in driving the AFFS out of Taurian space and inflicted notable losses on the Federated Suns, the cost to the Concordat in men and matériel was just too high. With that realization uppermost in their minds, the TDF commissioned a new BattleMech that would force the Taurian industrial community to upgrade their factories. If the factory wasn't able to build a component the designers wanted, the TDF reallocated funds to add that production capability to the factory. Thus the Brahma serves not only as a BattleMech for combat, but as a technology driver as well. Though the designers originally wanted a 55 ton 'Mech that would complement the Griffin, Shadow Hawk, and Wolverine, they were unable to fit all the technology in a medium 'Mech chassis. The Brahma therefore displaces sixty tons.

content.original: The Corvis was one of the predecessors to the OmniMech, utilizing the same semi-modular ports as the Star League Mercury BattleMech. Clan technicians eventually expanded upon this design to create the Stormcrow, and with the development of that front-line OmniMech, all of the Clans save the Horses lost interest in the Corvis, which was often derided as too slow for its weight class. In fact, the Corvis' only saving grace is its use of jump jets, because they allow the medium-range 'Mech to be useful when on restricting terrain, such as urban environments. The Corvis was often deployed as support for conventional troops, such as combat vehicles and infantry, so it only seems natural that the Horses would want to keep producing it.

content.content: «Корвис» был одним из предшественников омнимехов, используя те же полумодульные слоты, что и боевой мех «Меркурий» Звёздной Лиги. Техники Кланов в конечном итоге расширили эту конструкцию, чтобы создать Stormcrow, и с разработкой этого передового омнимеха все кланы, кроме Лошадей, потеряли интерес к Corvis, который часто высмеивался как слишком медленный для своего весового класса. Фактически, единственным плюсом Corvis является использование прыжковых двигателей, поскольку они позволяют меху средней дальности быть полезным на сложной местности, например, в городских условиях. Corvis часто использовался для поддержки обычных войск, таких как боевая техника и пехота, поэтому кажется вполне естественным, что Лошади хотели продолжать его производство.

The Daikyu is also well protected with twelve tons of armor and CASE to protect against ammunition explosions.

content.original: The original Fire Moth, designated Dasher by the Inner Sphere, is a light 'Mech that is known for having great speed but weak armor, and it was found that the Dasher was not very effective at swarm tactics or raiding due to this deficiency. Because of this deficiency in the design the Dasher II entered service during the Word of Blake Jihad. Much heavier and sturdier than the original Dasher, the Dasher II has a top speed of 162 km/h that equals that of the original Dasher. The Dasher II's top speed allows it to close in to effectively use its firepower.

content.original: Described as a "Warhammer on steroids", the Defiance is visually similar to the original WHM-6R and carries a similar weapons array. Where it differs from the classic design is in the use of digitigrade instead of humanoid legs, and modern construction components such as an endo steel skeleton, light fusion engine, and triple strength myomers. Due in part to the high heat levels required by its specialized myomers, as well as weight constraints, the Defiance carries only twelve double heat sinks, forcing it to rely upon volley fire to avoid shutdown, much like the design upon which it was based.

content.original: Based on an old Star League design called the Sling, the Duan Gung likely shares its roots with the Koshi OmniMech, as the Sling shared many characteristics with both designs, and it is believed that the Sling was easily upgraded with OmniMech technology. The Duan Gung is a competent light fire support 'Mech, with a ground speed of 119 km/h and the ability to jump up to 180 meters, it is capable of keeping up with most other light 'Mechs. To save weight and allow the Duan Gung to carry as heavy an arsenal as possible, the 'Mech is built on a endo steel chassis and is powered by an 175 XL engine that weighs half as much as its standard fusion counterpart. To handle the heat from its weapons, the Duan Gung has 10 double heat sinks, which are more than adequate for the 'Mech's needs. Finally, for protection from enemy fire, the Duan Gung carries four tons of armor, providing more than enough protection for the 'Mech's intended role.

content.original: The Eisenfaust uses a single plasma rifle as its main weapon. Equipped with two tons of ammunition the rifle can inflict serious damage on any battlefield unit and can obliterate conventional infantry platoons. The Eisenfaust's slow top speed makes it difficult for the 'Mech to break contact and reload its plasma rifle magazine, therefore Defiance engineers installed a suite of lasers to provide the backup weapons the 'Mech needs to deal with determined opponents. Two medium pulse lasers and an ER small laser work to deal with close up threats, as well as deal with hostile battle armor. The ER large laser supports the plasma rifle at range, allowing the pilot to save the plasma rifle for a knockout punch. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original: The Eisenfaust was originally designed shortly after the Lyran Commonwealth began building 'Mechs. Based on their experience with the Commando and Ymir, the LCAF tried to build a medium class "siege engine" 'Mech. Though the trials looked promising, the battlefield performance of the early Eisenfaust was poor and the design was canceled. After the recovery of lostech and advanced SLDF technologies, Defiance Industries looked at the early Eisenfaust design again. The updated Eisenfaust entered production after simulations showed it could be an effective battlefield unit if equipped with updated technologies. In fact the Eisenfaust was one of the first designs to enter production after the start of the Jihad

content.original: The Eyleuka is a technological marvel of the late 3060s that owes everything to the Trinity Alliance, specifically the bond between the Magistracy of Canopus and Capellan Confederation. The Canopians benefited greatly, especially in military technology, but they wanted to prove that they could design a modern BattleMech without the Confederation's help. Five years after the commencement of R&D, the team from Detroit had little to show for their work; at the same time, the CCAF wanted a modern 'Mech for their commandos to use. The result of their collaboration is the Eyleuka.

content.original: The Eyleuka is a highly mobile medium 'Mech. Though it only has a top speed of 86 km/h, seven improved jump jets give it a maximum jumping distance of 210 meters. Nine and a half tons of stealth armor, powered by a Guardian ECM suite, give it decent protection especially at range, but also make it difficult to detect. A small cockpit makes piloting the 'Mech more difficult, while the compact gyro makes the gyroscope less vulnerable. The engine is a great deal more vulnerable, however, as the design incorporates an XL engine. The 'Mech's largest weapon is a MML-9 launcher, which gives the MechWarrior the flexibility to utilize long- and short-range missiles. While rather worryingly placed on either side of the cockpit, three tons of ammunition impart the additional flexibility to make use of special munitions. At long range, the Eyleuka has an ER large laser, but when it closes it can make use of a pair of ER medium lasers. A TAG can call direct deadly missiles or homing artillery Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Falconer was designed at the order of Hanse Davion to create a 'Mech that could tame the Jade Falcons and defeat a Clan OmniMech in one-on-one combat. The Falconer is powered by a 375 XL engine that propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. This speed is enhanced with greater mobility by fiv jump jets that allow the Falconer to jump the considerable distance of one hundred and fifty meters. The Falconer also saves weight to carry as many weapons as possible by using a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and carries eleven and a half tons of armor plating, which gives the Falconer a respectable amount of armor protection.

Машина оснащена двигателем XL 375, обеспечивающим максимальную скорость 86,4 км/ч. Высокая мобильность дополнительно повышается за счёт пяти прыжковых двигателей, позволяющих Falconer преодолевать по воздуху значительное расстояние в 150 метров. Для экономии массы и размещения максимально возможного количества вооружения в конструкции использовано шасси из более лёгкой эндостали, а наличие одиннадцати с половиной тонн брони обеспечивает меху достойный уровень защиты.

content.original: The Fennec 1CM is built on an endo steel chassis, clad in nine and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor to protect the 'Mech's advanced systems and 330 XL engine. MechWarriors piloting the 'Mech must be mindful of the significant heat produced by its weapons and engine, as the design has only 10 double heat sinks. One of the primary features of the 'Mech, a C3 master computer allows it to coordinate with other C3 lancemates. The 'Mech's long range weaponry consists of a pair of arm-mounted PPCs, which are backed up by a pair of medium pulse lasers for close combat. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Fire Scorpion is a quadrupedal BattleMech designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion scientists to be a totem 'Mech. It is visually similar to a scorpion, complete with a "tail" rising up from the rear of the BattleMech. The claw-like elements near the cockpit are actually armored guards, placed on either side of the head to keep ground troops from sniping at the cockpit. Scientists who designed it apparently believed in a quantity over quality approach, as the Fire Scorpion is rugged, cheap and primarily fielded by second-line forces that defend cities, the role in which it excels.

content.original: The Gallowglas was designed to counter the threat of the Clans. The 'Mech is produced by Blackwell Heavy Industries on Outreach and is built to be effective from its longest range to point-blank range. The 'Mech is built using an Endo Steel chassis to save weight and a 280 fusion engine for its durability. The Gallowglas is protected by a respectable twelve tons of armor, and the 'Mech uses eighteen double heat sinks to handle its heavy heat load.

content.original: The Garm is designed to operate as part of a fire support lance, providing long-range direct fire for other units, and as such, the Garm competes directly with the Valkyrie BattleMech. To make the Garm capable of carrying the weapons needed to carry out its intended mission, it is built on an endo steel chassis that weighs half as much as a standard chassis, while an 175 fusion engine allows it a maximum speed of 86.4 km/h. The mobility enjoyed by the Garm is enhanced with five Rawlings 80-beta jump jets that make the 'Mech capable of jumping up to 150 meters. The Garm does have relatively light armor for a 'Mech of its size, with only three and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor; this is because the Garm depends on its ability to engage an enemy at long range rather than closing to short ranges.

content.original: The Gravedigger GDR-1D carries an ER PPC, LB 5-X AC, and a Streak LRM-15 launcher. These weapons have complementary range profiles, and work well together; the PPC can breach armor and allow cluster munitions from the LB 5-X or missiles from the Streak launcher to exploit the gaps. This allows the Gravedigger to threaten 'Mechs much heavier than itself. In addition, the LB 5-X's cluster rounds are very effective against infantry, vehicles, and aerospace fighters. The 'Mech also uses an Angel ECM suite to spoil enemy electronics and a Clan-built active probe to find enemy units.[ Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Gravedigger was introduced by Odin Manufacturing in an effort to stave off bankruptcy. The company's plants sustained heavy damage in the Second Combine-Ghost Bear War, and the Gravedigger was produced to generate much needed capital. Built using many Inner Sphere components, the 'Mech was designed to be cheap to produce. When introduced, it initially used standard Inner Sphere weaponry, but after the massive infusion of money from sales to mercenary forces Odin created a new version with Clan-spec weaponry and additional electronics.

content.original: The Great Wyrm was one of the first unique Clan BattleMechs ever developed. Clan Mongoose scientists used the specifications for the Dragon as the basis for their new creation, and were able to update it to their liking in a little more than a year. Not only was it designed to Clan specifications, but the Mongoose creators reduced the Dragon's weight by 15 tons. The Great Wyrm first saw action in 2844 against Clan Star Adder, and soon found its way into the touman of every Clan. With the development of the OmniMech, however, the Great Wyrm was reduced to a solahma unit and production finally ceased in 2872.

content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Hachiwara was commissioned by the Silver Dragon Stables and designed by the Crosby BattleMech Research firm responsible for the creation of the No-Dachi. Using the No-Dachi as their inspiration, the Crosby engineers designed a 'Mech optimized for arena combat. The already high speed was increased by using a Supercharger, allowing the Hachiwara pilot to get in close to an opponent quickly. Twelve tons of armor protects the 'Mech. Harkening back to the samurai ideal, the Hachiwara uses a Vibroblade in place of the No-Dachi's Sword.

Harkening back to the samurai ideal, the Hachiwara uses a Vibroblade in place of the No-Dachi's Sword.

content.original: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. content.content: Являясь смесью популярного Thug эпохи Звездной Лиги и не пользующегося популярностью Charger, Hatamoto-Chi в стиле самураев был первым боевым мехом Синдиката Дракона, построенным после Наследных войн с использованием восстановленного лостеха. По поручению канреи Теодора Куриты провести обратную разработку образцов передовых боевых мехов СОЗЛ, предоставленных КомСтаром в 3035 году для будущего производства, Luthien Armor Works тайно соединила вооружение Thug с обликом злосчастного Charger. Хотя изначально компания не могла массово производить передовые шасси из эндостали, необходимые для Thug, появление ранних Hatamoto-Chi и их бесконечных вариаций, созданных на основе просторного корпуса Charger, привело к замешательству в объединенных вооруженных силах Федеративного Содружества во время войны 3039 года.

content.original: The original design, the RetroTech HawkWolf featured a number of primitive components. The primitive engine gave the -3F a top speed 10 km/h slower than its more modern replacement, and used eighteen tons of primitive armor. While this made the 3F as well-protected as the 4F, the 3F ran a little hotter, having just thirteen heat sinks; it also had lower ammunition endurance, as the LRMs were only able to draw on three tons of ammunition in total. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.92 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Named for a canine predator adapted to Randis IV, the HawkWolf is a unique BattleMech constructed by the Brotherhood of Randis that entered production in 3076. To help support their activities, the Brotherhood set aside resources to develop production facilities to build "RetroMechs", in order to both fill out its own forces and to sell as a means of generating further capital. Initially starting with RetroTech Firebees and Dervishes, their success led the Brotherhood to develop an entirely new design. Intended mainly for fire-support roles, the HawkWolf was generally assigned to the Brotherhood's "squires" as a means for its youngest warriors to gain experience and avoid placing the primitive design at threat against more advanced opponents in direct combat.

content.original: This Clan tech variant of the 'Mech makes it a general purpose role. The 'Mech has been fitted with some the newest technology of the time period. Based on the Clan version of the design, all the original missile launchers are removed, except for a single arm mounted LRM 10. The launcher retains only one ton of ammunition in the left arm with the weapon. Complementing the LRM launcher in right arm, the 'Mech has been given a Class 30 hyper-assault Gauss rifle with four tons of ammunition. The 'Mech been given a plasma cannon and four ER medium lasers round up the 'Mech weaponry in closer range fighting. To accommodate these new changes, the 'Mech engine has switched to an XL fusion engine and its armor protection has been slightly reduced. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: The Ha Otoko (Bladed Man in Japanese) is primarily a defensive, second-line BattleMech. Clan Diamond Shark first fielded the cheap 'Mech when they helped Clan Nova Cat evacuate from Clan space in 3060. Clan Jade Falcon merchants were the first to point out that the Ha Otoko name and oriental aspect and style of combat were meant to be sold to the Inner Sphere, being easily modified to accommodate similar Inner Sphere weaponry, in addition to the Oriental styling of the 'Mech's exterior. The Ha Otoko is protected by thirteen tons of armor.

content.original: Analysts believe that this variant is Clan Diamond Shark's attempt to use Inner Sphere equipment for themselves rather than an attempt to generate business. Powered by a light fusion engine, the Ha Otoko-HR has the survivability of a Clan extralight engine, without racking up the significant cost. The HR refit also uses Inner Sphere-produced heat sinks, and a small cockpit to provide enough room for the weapons loaded. The HR mounts a pair of LRM-20s but also includes a Mech Mortar/8 in each arm. These weapons may not be as effective as missile launchers, but their immunity to anti-missile systems could explain their presence. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: Somewhat of a departure from most Clan BattleMechs, the Hellstar is a long-running campaign workhorse rather than the quick-and-deadly striker usually used in Clan warfare. A continuation of the collaboration between Clan Hell's Horses and the Exiled Wolves on Arc-Royal during the Jihad which resulted in the Cygnus, a machine based on the earlier Annihilator, the Hellstar is more or less a Clan Awesome. Introduced in 3079, the Wolves-in-Exile and Hell's Horses maintained exclusive production of the effective 'Mech since, with the largest number outside the ranks of their toumans being the relatively few examples the newborn Republic of the Sphere salvaged from the battlefields of Operation SCOUR. Built on a weight-saving Endo Steel frame and 380-rated XL fusion engine, the Hellstar boasts impressive speed for its weight while carrying eighteen-and-a-half tons of standard armor, the maximum possible for its weight. The real key to the design's reputation is its unprecedented thirty Double Heat Sinks, which allow it to fire all its weapons continuously without the risk of heat buildup.

Introduced in 3079, the Wolves-in-Exile and Hell's Horses maintained exclusive production of the effective 'Mech since, with the largest number outside the ranks of their toumans being the relatively few examples the newborn Republic of the Sphere salvaged from the battlefields of Operation SCOUR. Built on a weight-saving Endo Steel frame and 380-rated XL fusion engine, the Hellstar boasts impressive speed for its weight while carrying eighteen-and-a-half tons of standard armor, the maximum possible for its weight. The real key to the design's reputation is its unprecedented thirty Double Heat Sinks, which allow it to fire all its weapons continuously without the risk of heat buildup.

content.original: An experimental field refit kit for the -1532 Jackal developed by Earthwerks, the -1579 retained the ER PPC and anti-missile system while switching to double heat sinks to free up weight for a few appliqué armor panels. The main difference was the replacement of the unloved Streak SRM-2 launcher and its attendant ammo with a PPC capacitor to boost the effectiveness of its sole offensive weapon, and an advanced Angel ECM suite to protect the design from enemy electronics. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: Developed by the Solaris VII-based Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, the Jackal was designed to give as equal of a performance as possible to a Clan 'Mech of equal weight. While intended for the battlefield rather than the arenas, the prototype's stellar run on Solaris attracted the attention of number of 'Mech manufacturers, most notably Earthwerks Incorporated of Keystone. While Earthwerks ultimately secured the main production rights to the design, VEST was allowed to maintain limited garage level production as well.

content.original: The Jupiter is a massive BattleMech that can reach 54 km/h at best speed, thanks to its XL engine. Nineteen and a half tons of armor provide protection that can be matched by few other 'Mechs. The Jupiter is armed for long range combat. The 'Mech mounts a pair of ER PPCs and two LRM-15 launchers, giving it excellent long range capabilities. These are backed up by four Ultra AC/5s which allow the 'Mech to put a large volume of fire downrange. Additionally, the ER PPCs allow the 'Mech to stay in combat when its ammunition-dependent weapons have been silenced due to a lack of ammunition in prolonged engagements. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22

Although not as versatile as the Turkina, it was developed from the most commonly available parts at the time, giving the Jupiter a rugged and easily repaired design that many other designs cannot match. Due to its durability, Jupiters have been spotted in many mercenary and House armies throughout the post-Jihad Inner Sphere

content.original: The first Clantech OmniMech produced by Odin Manufacturing for the Ghost Bear Dominion, the Karhu (Finnish for "Bear") earned the reputation as a fast cavalry 'Mech. Built on an Endo Steel based chassis, powered by a 325-rated XL engine and clad in ten and half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Karhu featured respectable speed and armor for its size while providing thirty tons of available pod space for equipment. Twelve Double Heat Sinks coped with most of the waste heat of its varied configurations.

content.original: The Lightray was designed by Martinson Armaments to be a heavy scout 'Mech. The Lightray is built on a lightweight endo steel chassis to help maximize the available weight for weapons and equipment, and features a gigantic 385 XL engine, the largest that can possibly be carried by a 'Mech its size. This engine allows the scout 'Mech to outpace most other medium designs with a top speed of 118 km/h, though it lacks the added maneuverability that could be provided by jump jets. The Lightray carries ten and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, giving the 'Mech a great deal of protection

content.original: The Lobo was originally conceived as an inexpensive companion to the Timber Wolf. Khan Vladimir Ward's Clan Wolf was never fond of the Linebacker, the brain child of Khans Natasha Kerensky and Phelan Ward, so Khan Ward directed his scientists to design something smaller. Despite that, Ward was not happy with his options until Clan Coyote developed the Advanced Tactical Missile launcher, which Ward quickly secured the technology and had it incorporated into the Lobo. With that inclusion, the 'Mech ceased to be cheap, however, as the inclusion of endo steel and an extralight engine was necessary to free up space for the desired launchers. Able to out-pace the Timber Wolf, the Lobo is more in line with Clan Wolf's shift to faster, hard-hitting 'Mechs.

content.original: The Arbalest 1 is a light 'Mech capable of engaging an enemy at long range, or being used as a light fire support platform. The 'Mech uses its twin Mk.46 Type II LRM-10 launchers to strike an enemy at long range. Should an opponent close, the Arbalest is capable of defending itself at short range with its pair of Series 2a Mk. 5 ER medium lasers. Finally, the head-mounted ECM suite disrupts enemy electronics and proved valuable when disrupting Blakist C3i networks. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The Balius Primary configuration has a Flamer hard-mounted in its head that is useful both against infantry and as a psychological weapon. The primary configuration mounts two ER Large Lasers. These are supplemented by a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers for close range work. Every configuration of the Balius mounts rear-facing weapons to counter the inability of a quad to torso-twist. The prime carries another pair of Medium Pulse Lasers for this job. Four extra double heat sinks keep heat levels in check. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: An advanced tech variant of the Beowulf introduced during the Jihad that has its weapon systems revised with the era's newest weaponry. The large pulse laser and one ER medium laser were dropped for a pair of medium variable speed pulse lasers in the left arm and a pair of ER small lasers, one standard small laser, and a 'Mech sword in the right arm. Triple Strength Myomer replaces the MASC to give a slightly slower, but less risky means of achieving higher speeds and deal heavier melee damage. To aid in reaching the heat levels needed for the TSM to activate, a pair of double heat sinks were removed. The Beowulf also features a C3 slave unit. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Blood Reaper was built around a pair of ATM-6 Launchers, one per torso, which provided it with flexible multirange firepower. At long range they were supported by a hard-hitting ER PPC in each arm, while a pair of Heavy Medium Lasers offered enhanced close-range punch. A three ton ammo bay for each ATM launcher allowed the MechWarrior to carry two tons of each of three of the ATM missile types, ensuring maximum tactical flexibility in the field. Sharing a similar reverse-canted leg, energy weapon arm and missile launcher torso layout as the iconic Timber Wolf, the Blood Reaper was built on an Endo Steel frame and uses an XL engine to save weight for a heavy weapon and armor load. Slower than most front-line OmniMechs, the Blood Reaper featured a 120 meter jump capacity to help overcome this. Eighteen Double Heat Sinks provided the design adequate endurance. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The primary long range firepower of the Brahma comes from the Light AC/5 built into the torso. This weapon has a slightly shorter range than a standard AC/5 but the weight saved allows the Brahma to carry a trio of ER Medium Lasers for close combat. The LAC/5 can also use special autocannon ammunition types captured from the AFFS. A Streak SRM-6 insures that every missile will inflict the maximum amount of damage possible. To destroy enemy infantry, the Brahma uses a single Flamer. Finally, the head-mounted anti-missile system prevented the Brahma from being overwhelmed by a massive rocket launcher salvo. The standard armor and chassis are quickly and easily produced by the Taurians, while the XL Engine pushes the 'Mech to a top speed of 86 km/h. To provide extra mobility the Brahma has a 90 meter jump capability. To protect the MechWarrior, the Brahma carries over twelve tons of armor and uses CASE to protect the ammunition. Finally, the Targeting Computer improves weapon accuracy and provides a nasty surprise for anyone foolish enough to dismiss the Brahma. Quirk: Variable Range Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Eisenfaust uses a single plasma rifle as its main weapon. Equipped with two tons of ammunition the rifle can inflict serious damage on any battlefield unit and can obliterate conventional infantry platoons. The Eisenfaust's slow top speed makes it difficult for the 'Mech to break contact and reload its plasma rifle magazine, therefore Defiance engineers installed a suite of lasers to provide the backup weapons the 'Mech needs to deal with determined opponents. Two medium pulse lasers and an ER small laser work to deal with close up threats, as well as deal with hostile battle armor. The ER large laser supports the plasma rifle at range, allowing the pilot to save the plasma rifle for a knockout punch. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.original: The Eyleuka is a highly mobile medium 'Mech. Though it only has a top speed of 86 km/h, seven improved jump jets give it a maximum jumping distance of 210 meters. Nine and a half tons of stealth armor, powered by a Guardian ECM suite, give it decent protection especially at range, but also make it difficult to detect. A small cockpit makes piloting the 'Mech more difficult, while the compact gyro makes the gyroscope less vulnerable. The engine is a great deal more vulnerable, however, as the design incorporates an XL engine. The 'Mech's largest weapon is a MML-9 launcher, which gives the MechWarrior the flexibility to utilize long- and short-range missiles. While rather worryingly placed on either side of the cockpit, three tons of ammunition impart the additional flexibility to make use of special munitions. At long range, the Eyleuka has an ER large laser, but when it closes it can make use of a pair of ER medium lasers. A TAG can call direct deadly missiles or homing artillery Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: This Clan tech variant of the 'Mech makes it a general purpose role. The 'Mech has been fitted with some the newest technology of the time period. Based on the Clan version of the design, all the original missile launchers are removed, except for a single arm mounted LRM 10. The launcher retains only one ton of ammunition in the left arm with the weapon. Complementing the LRM launcher in right arm, the 'Mech has been given a Class 30 hyper-assault Gauss rifle with four tons of ammunition. The 'Mech been given a plasma cannon and four ER medium lasers round up the 'Mech weaponry in closer range fighting. To accommodate these new changes, the 'Mech engine has switched to an XL fusion engine and its armor protection has been slightly reduced. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: Analysts believe that this variant is Clan Diamond Shark's attempt to use Inner Sphere equipment for themselves rather than an attempt to generate business. Powered by a light fusion engine, the Ha Otoko-HR has the survivability of a Clan extralight engine, without racking up the significant cost. The HR refit also uses Inner Sphere-produced heat sinks, and a small cockpit to provide enough room for the weapons loaded. The HR mounts a pair of LRM-20s but also includes a Mech Mortar/8 in each arm. These weapons may not be as effective as missile launchers, but their immunity to anti-missile systems could explain their presence. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: The Jupiter is a massive BattleMech that can reach 54 km/h at best speed, thanks to its XL engine. Nineteen and a half tons of armor provide protection that can be matched by few other 'Mechs. The Jupiter is armed for long range combat. The 'Mech mounts a pair of ER PPCs and two LRM-15 launchers, giving it excellent long range capabilities. These are backed up by four Ultra AC/5s which allow the 'Mech to put a large volume of fire downrange. Additionally, the ER PPCs allow the 'Mech to stay in combat when its ammunition-dependent weapons have been silenced due to a lack of ammunition in prolonged engagements. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.22

content.original: The Awesome is traditionally used in a vanguard role when penetrating enemy defenses. The Awesome's massive firepower also lends it to defensive actions, acting as a mobile turret when necessary. Because of its reliance on PPCs, the Awesome is able to act independently for extended periods of time. This trait is also useful in siege situations where the 'Mech can keep up a constant barrage, allowing it to win battles of attrition through bleeding an enemy dry. The only downsides to the Awesome is its low maneuverability and lack of rear-facing weaponry, making it vulnerable to being outflanked and surrounded by lighter 'Mechs, although good intelligence and a well-deployed screening force can mitigate this issue.

content.content: «Потрясающий» традиционно используется в роли авангарда при прорыве вражеской обороны. Массивная огневая мощь Awesome также позволяет использовать его в оборонительных действиях, при необходимости выступая в роли мобильной турели. Благодаря использованию PPC, Awesome способен действовать автономно в течение длительного времени. Эта особенность также полезна в осадных ситуациях, когда мехи могут вести постоянный обстрел, позволяя выигрывать битвы на истощение за счет обескровливания противника. Единственным недостатком Awesome является низкая маневренность и отсутствие заднего оружия, что делает его уязвимым для захода и обстрела в спину более легкими мехами, хотя хорошая разведка и хорошо развернутые силы прикрытия могут смягчить эту проблему.

content.original: Based on an old Star League design called the Sling, the Duan Gung likely shares its roots with the Koshi OmniMech, as the Sling shared many characteristics with both designs, and it is believed that the Sling was easily upgraded with OmniMech technology. The Duan Gung is a competent light fire support 'Mech, with a ground speed of 119 km/h and the ability to jump up to 180 meters, it is capable of keeping up with most other light 'Mechs. To save weight and allow the Duan Gung to carry as heavy an arsenal as possible, the 'Mech is built on a endo steel chassis and is powered by an 175 XL engine that weighs half as much as its standard fusion counterpart. To handle the heat from its weapons, the Duan Gung has 10 double heat sinks, which are more than adequate for the 'Mech's needs. Finally, for protection from enemy fire, the Duan Gung carries four tons of armor, providing more than enough protection for the 'Mech's intended role.

content.original: The original Gladiator used primitive technologies, so it only had a Large Laser and two Medium Lasers. In addition, it could only manage a top speed around 64 km/h. It was protected by sixteen and a half tons of Primitive Armor. The GLD-1R went out of production by 2488. During the Jihad, several companies began producing this primitive design of Gladiator as a part of the appearance of RetroTech on the battlefield, driven by the need for war materiel; companies which produced the primitive Gladiator during this era included Rastaban Agricultural Products, Metals of the Earth and Sword of the Prophet Enterprises although many of these manufacturing lines had closed down by 3079.

content.original: A melding of the popular Star League era Thug and the poorly regarded Charger, the samurai-themed Hatamoto-Chi was the first post–Succession Wars Draconis Combine BattleMech constructed utilizing recovered LosTech. Tasked by Kanrei Theodore Kurita to reverse engineer examples of the advanced Star League Defense Force BattleMechs provided by ComStar in 3035 for future production, Luthien Armor Works secretly mated the weaponry of the Thug to the form of the maligned Charger. While initially unable to mass produce the advanced Endo Steel chassis required to match the Thug, the appearance of the early Hatamoto-Chi and their endless variations born of the Charger's spacious torso sent the combined Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth into confusion during the War of 3039.

content.content: Являясь смесью популярного Thug эпохи Звездной Лиги и не пользующегося популярностью Charger, Hatamoto-Chi в стиле самураев был первым боевым мехом Синдиката Дракона, построенным после Наследных войн с использованием восстановленного лостеха. По поручению канреи Теодора Куриты провести обратную разработку образцов передовых боевых мехов СОЗЛ, предоставленных КомСтаром в 3035 году для будущего производства, Luthien Armor Works тайно соединила вооружение Thug с обликом злосчастного Charger. Хотя изначально компания не могла массово производить передовые шасси из эндостали, необходимые для Thug, появление ранних Hatamoto-Chi и их бесконечных вариаций, созданных на основе просторного корпуса Charger, привело к замешательству в объединенных вооруженных силах Федеративного Содружества во время войны 3039 года.

content.original: The Legionnaire was developed as the Federated Suns answer to the Lyran Blitzkrieg, and entered production during the Word of Blake Jihad. A lance of Legionnaires played an important role in the Third Battle of New Avalon, where they quickly assaulted the Blakist force's left flank as they were attempting to ford the Thames river, breaking their momentum and eventually forcing them off world. Capable of reaching 118 km/h, the Legionnaire is a fast flanker.

content.content: «Легионер» был разработан Федеративными Солнцами как ответ на лиранский «Блицкриг» и поступил в производство во время Джихада Слова Блейка. Копьё легионеров сыграло важную роль в Третьей битве за Новый Авалон, где они стремительно атаковали левый фланг блейкистов, пытавшихся переправиться через Темзу, сломив их натиск и в конечном итоге вытеснив с планеты. Развивая скорость до 118 км/ч, «Легионер» — быстрый фланговик.

content.original: A project to create an upgrade package for the Legionnaire, developed under the supervision of Sandra Hall-Pujanauski, this version carries an ER medium laser in each arm. The standard armor was replaced by Clan made reflective armor, and a Clan built RAC/5 was crammed into the right torso. To provide room for the pilot, the MUSE FIRE uses a torso-mounted cockpit, and the room freed in the 'Mech's head is used to store three tons of ammunition. This version doesn't carry the targeting computer of the standard version. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

It replaces the standard Awesome-10KM's Heavy PPCs with two Clan built ER PPCs. It also mounts an Improved C3 computer to share targeting data, and is equipped with an advanced Targeting Computer. The Guardian ECM and Snub Nosed PPC of the standard AWS-10KM remain, but to provide more protection this Awesome uses an Armored Engine, Armored Cockpit, and Armored Gyro. content.original: The late 3050s and early 3060s saw the Absorption of Clan Burrock by Clan Star Adder. After the proof of collusion with the Bandit Caste, most Burrocks were eager to be rid of the taint of corruption. The Star Adders read this as a desire to join a more powerful Clan, so they were surprised when many former Burrocks clung to that identity. In order to appeal to them, the Star Adder leadership authorized a new BattleMech to honor them. The Burrock is a fast heavy 'Mech with incredible short-range firepower. Though its XL engine leaves it somewhat vulnerable, the Burrock is protected by twelve and a half tons of armor.

content.original: Paying tribute to other highly successful Clan Wolf designs, the Blood Reaper is a symbolic and straightforward second-line BattleMech in heavy use in the post-Jihad Clan Wolf touman. Seeking to standardize his forces and weed out non-Wolf designs, Khan Vlad Ward ordered his scientists to develop a rugged yet symbolic 'Mech for warriors of Clan Wolf to rally around. A standard BattleMech in the mold of the successful Tundra Wolf, the Blood Reaper first entered service in 3079 and went on to form a large part of the Wolves' post-Jihad touman. Khan Ward overcame the stigma of a second-line machine with classic Clan posturing; by insisting that warriors truly worthy of the spirit of the Wolf would win even while being hobbled by such a design.

content.original: The Gurkha was developed by the Word of Blake in response to a request from Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais to keep the production lines on Terra running. To open up as much space as possible for weapons and equipment, the Gurkha is built on a lightweight endo steel chassis and is powered by a lightweight XL engine that gives it a top speed of 118.8 km/h. That, combined with the Gurkha's seven and a half tons of armor, make taking the 'Mech down a difficult proposition. Its only real deficiency is its lack of jump jets, which make maneuvering in limiting terrain difficult for the 'Mech. As the Word of Blake's opponents realized the power of this little 'Mech, Gurkhas quickly became targets to be eliminated quickly, as the C3i computer often means that an individual MechWarrior can rapidly find him or herself attacked by up to six extremely accurate 'Mechs.

content.original: The Afreet is a battle armor design created by Clan Ice Hellion. The Afreet was created when Khan Raina Montose ordered two other projects merged, resulting in a battlesuit that seems to fit in well with the Hellion belief in speed over all else. The primary feature of the Afreet is its ability to leap one hundred twenty meters at a time. This comes at a sacrifice to armor, as the Afreet is only able to stop a Clan ER Small Laser. It does, however, use Improved Sensors, a holdover from one of the suits it descended from. Following the Hellion invasion of the Inner Sphere, both Clan Jade Falcon and Clan Hell's Horses salvaged and produced their own versions. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Африт» — это боевая броня, разработанная кланом Ледяного Хеллиона. «Африт» был создан после того, как хан Райна Монтозе приказала объединить два других проекта, в результате чего получился боевой костюм, который, похоже, хорошо вписывается в веру Хеллионов в превосходство скорости над всем остальным. Главной особенностью «Африта» является его способность прыгать на сто двадцать метров за раз. Это достигается за счёт снижения брони, «Африт» способен выдержать огонь максимум одного малого ER-лазера. Однако он использует улучшенные сенсоры, унаследованные от одного из костюмов, от которого он произошёл. После вторжения Хеллионов во Внутреннюю Сферу, клан Нефритового Сокола и клан Адских Лошадей собрали и создали свои собственные версии. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The closest thing the Demon Series of battle armor has to a standard, front-line model, the Asura is a medium-weight design. Compared to the Clan Elemental the Asura is not as well armored, although its 280kg of advanced armor can withstand a hit from a Clan ER Medium Laser. The Asura does not have any enhancements to a standard trooper's ground speed but carries jump jets to leap ninety meters at a time, matching the Elemental in terms of speed, and its weaponry has a longer reach. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. A Jihad era variant, this variation of the design employs Protomech Myomer Booster and AP Gauss rifle.

content.content: «Кентавр» — один из лучших протомехов первого поколения, сочетающий в себе высокую скорость, приличную броню и разнообразное вооружение. Этот вариант, относящийся к эре Джихада, оснащен усилителем миомеров протомехов и винтовкой AP Gauss.

content.original: Judging by its aesthetics and nomenclature, the fifteen-ton Cherub OmniMech is meant to invoke the terrifying spirit and flexibility of the Word of Blake’s Celestial OmniMech series. Unlike the other units in this list, the Cherub is not a robotic unit but a proper—if unusually small—BattleMech intended for use by human MechWarriors. With a top running speed approaching 120 kilometers per hour and protected by about as much armor as its frame can handle, this OmniMech leaves only twenty percent of its tonnage open for weaponry. To make even this much room possible, however, the improved C3 package, a mainstay on the original Celestial Omnis, is absent here. Curiously, two of the three known variants attempt to work around this by mounting battle-armor grade weapons, backed up by packs of single-use rocket launchers.

content.original: The Clan Battle Armor is based on the Elemental suit, its visual aesthetic that shows that the Clan's contact with the Draconis Combine was already rubbing off on them. Though the design has a slow ground speed, the designers used the jump booster pioneered on the Gray Death Scout armor to rocket it up to one hundred twenty meters at a time. This necessitated a slight reduction in armor and a reworking of the weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Клановая боевая броня создана на основе костюма элементалей, внешний вид которого свидетельствует о том, что контакт Кланов с Синдикатом Дракона уже сказывался на них. Несмотря на низкую наземную скорость, разработчики использовали прыжковый ускоритель, впервые разработанный на броне Gray Death Scout, чтобы поднять его на высоту до ста двадцати метров. Это потребовало небольшого уменьшения толщины брони и переделки вооружения. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Корона» — это проект боевой брони, созданный кланом Звёздного Ужа после серии испытаний, определивших, какие кланы получат право на участие в операции «Возрождение». Идея заключалась в том, чтобы создать боекостюм с оружием, способным поражать мехи на расстоянии. Масса, необходимая для установки столь тяжёлого оружия, привела к снижению брони на 20% и удалению прыжкового ранца, несмотря на общее увеличение массы на 50%. Особенность: Устрашающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.935 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Djinn is the first known example of the so-called Demon Series of battle armor designs produced by Word of Blake for their Manei Domini. The Djinn has been carefully crafted to instill fear in its enemies. Its slim profile shows that it is obviously specially designed for Manei Domini troopers, since their use of cybernetic enhancements make up for the muscular bulk that "frail" Elementals and their Inner Sphere counterparts need to operate battle armor. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.889 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Джинн» — первый известный образец так называемой серии «Демон», разработанной Словом Блейка для своего Manei Domini. «Джинн» был тщательно спроектирован, чтобы вселять страх во врагов. Его тонкий профиль явно указывает на то, что он был разработан специально для бойцов Manei Domini, поскольку их кибернетические улучшения компенсируют мышечную массу, необходимую «хрупким» элементалям и их аналогам из Внутренней Сферы для использования боевой брони. Особенность: Fearsome Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.889 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Dragoon was conceived as a heavier, more versatile battlesuit for Wolf’s Dragoons’ Seventh Kommando. The Dragoon offers more protection and flexibility than common infiltration suits. This suit was originally designed to give combat engineers a degree of battlefield protection for high-risk intrusion operations, and to incorporate the ease of movement found in much lighter suits. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Драгун» был задуман как более тяжёлый и универсальный боевой костюм для Seventh Kommando Волчьих Драгун. «Драгун» обеспечивает большую защиту и гибкость, чем обычные инфильтрационные костюмы. Изначально этот костюм был разработан для обеспечения боевых инженеров необходимой защитой на поле боя во время высокорискованных операций по проникновению, а также для обеспечения лёгкости движений, присущей гораздо более лёгким костюмам. Особенность: Intuitive Controls Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.89 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

This suit was originally designed to give combat engineers a degree of battlefield protection for high-risk intrusion operations, and to incorporate the ease of movement found in much lighter suits. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Драгун» был задуман как более тяжёлый и универсальный боевой костюм для Seventh Kommando Волчьих Драгун. «Драгун» обеспечивает большую защиту и гибкость, чем обычные инфильтрационные костюмы. Изначально этот костюм был разработан для обеспечения боевых инженеров необходимой защитой на поле боя во время высокорискованных операций по проникновению, а также для обеспечения лёгкости движений, присущей гораздо более лёгким костюмам. Особенность: Intuitive Controls Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.89 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Reportedly developed in a mobile facility en route to the Inner Sphere, the Elemental II (X) is a prototype battle armor developed by Clan Hell's Horses to integrate the capabilities of the standard Elemental battlesuit (known to many in the Inner Sphere as "Toad " armor) with myomer-boosting technology. The goal of this experimental design was to enhance the Elemental as the Clans' "gold standard" in battle armor design, and produce a more effective general-purpose suit. Quirk: Experimental Design Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Elemental, являющаяся стандартом, по которому измеряется вся боевая броня, была впервые представлена в 2868 году кланом Волка в ходе испытания владения против Нова Котов. Это было чудо инженерной мысли Кланов, позволившее небольшой группе воинов в броне уничтожить большие мехи и выжить. Хотя боевая броня может использоваться и людьми нормального роста, их конструкция разработана специально для гигантских воинов-элементалей Кланов, и только они могут раскрыть их потенциал в полной мере. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Названный в честь демонического волка из германских мифов, «Фенрир» представлял собой скорее мобильную платформу огневой поддержки, чем традиционный боевой костюм. Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Golem is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Ghost Bear. Following their conflicts with first the Draconis Combine, then Clan Hell's Horses, the Bears decided they wanted something that could compete with the Kanazuchi and Gnome. The Golem is the result of that process and features enough armor to shrug off a Heavy Large Laser. In addition, this armor is fire resistant, so it is unaffected by Flamers and Inferno rounds. Though it cannot jump, the Golem is still speedier than the other assault-class designs. While that does not make this battlesuit fast, it does give it the ability to bring its strong weapons to bear on a target, even as it can withstand the punishment meted out by an enemy. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Голем» — это проект боевой брони, созданной кланом Призрачного Медведя. После конфликтов сначала с Синдикатом Дракона, а затем с кланом Адских Лошадей, Медведи решили, что им нужно что-то, что могло бы конкурировать с «Каназучи» и «Гномами». «Голем» — результат этого решения. Он обладает достаточной броней, чтобы не обращать внимания даже на тяжелый большой лазер. Кроме того, эта броня огнестойка, поэтому она не подвержена воздействию огнеметов и снарядов «Инферно». Хотя он не может прыгать, «Голем» всё ещё быстрее прочих штурмовых костюмов. Пусть это не значит, что эта броня очень быстрая, она может донести свое мощное оружие до цели, даже находясь под сильным огнём. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.96 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Gray Death Standard battle armor was developed by the technicians of the Gray Death Legion after the New Avalon Institute of Science sent them prototype battle armor suits, the progenitors of what eventually became the Inner Sphere Standard, for field testing. Using what was learned from these tests, the Legion decided to remove the suits' jump jets to make room for dedicated anti-infantry firepower, superior sensor systems, and reinforced myomer bundles to improve ground speed. While losing the ability to leap over obstacles, these changes made the suit easier to maintain and cheaper to build than the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Gray Death Standard была разработана техниками Gray Death Legion после того, как Институт науки Нового Авалона отправил им для полевых испытаний костюмы боевой брони, ставших предвестниками того, что впоследствии стало «Стандартом Внутренней Сферы». Используя результаты этих испытаний, Легион решил убрать прыжковые двигатели, чтобы освободить место для вооружения конкретно против пехоты, усовершенствованных сенсорных систем и усиленных пучков миомеров для повышения скорости движения. Несмотря на потерю способности перепрыгивать через препятствия, эти изменения сделали доспех более простым в обслуживании и более дешевым в производстве, чем «Стандарт Внутренней Сферы». Особенность: Intuitive Controls Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: This original prototype version of the Strike suit was unique for being a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technology. Built under the supervision of technician Brian Kinnison, this suit removed the improved sensors and modular weapon mount of the Gray Death Standard battlesuit. In their place are a Clan-spec detachable Advanced SRM-3 launcher with three shots mounted on the suit's body and a Light TAG system in the left arm that can spot for artillery units or units carrying Semi-Guided LRM. Both arms ended in Battle Claws. The reliance on Clan technology prevented the suit from reaching mass production, as not even Clan Diamond Shark was willing to sell enough components to justify such a move. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.908 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Unlike for the original Gray Death Strike design, Defiance Industries wasn't able to secure a source of the advanced Clan Improved SRM Launcher used on the prototype. As a result, Defiance used a single SRM-3 with two reloads. To make room for this the Gray Death Strike armor replaced the Battle Claws of the prototype with Basic Manipulators. The launcher can be jettisoned as well, allowing the unit to move slightly more quickly. The Light TAG system mounted in the arm allows armor that has jettisoned the SRM launcher to remain useful on the battlefield, designating enemy units for artillery and missile strikes. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Grenadier is a battle armor design created by the Hahm-Heinz Design Bureau. The firm has long had a relationship with General Motors' secondary plants on Talcott and Salem, so when the NAIS first started creating battle armor, Hahm-Heinz had access to prototypes that they could work from. The armor is where the Grenadier is lacking, having only enough to stop an Inner Sphere Large Pulse Laser, the same amount as the venerable Inner Sphere Standard. This armor, however, is standard stealth armor, so the Grenadier is a bit more difficult to target.
