content.original: The Jihad variant of this ancient Clan design features some advanced tech equipment in its redesign. The 'Mech's standard heat sinks and standard armor have been exchanged for double heat sinks and ferro-fibrous armor. The 'Mech's main weaponry consists of a pair of heavy medium lasers, one mounted in the right arm and the other in the right torso, with secondary weaponry consisting of a single ER flamer, mounted in the head. The 'Mech has been equipped with a Clan light TAG device to assist in the spotting role for artillery and missile fire support missions. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The Incubus II only has two torso-mounted ER Medium Pulse Lasers for offensive armament. A Laser AMS system was installed in the head to protect the pilot from missile attacks. The installation of more jump jets and the Partial Wing has reduced the available space for weaponry, but the Hell's Horses found an answer for that problem: They created several hand-held weapons systems that add additional firepower and provide commanders and pilots with some of the tactical flexibility of an OmniMech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Инкубус II» имеет всего два средних импульсных ER-лазера, установленных в торсах. Для защиты пилота от ракетных атак в голове была установлена ​​система лазерной защиты AMS. Установка прыжковых двигателей и частичного крыла сократила доступное пространство для вооружения, но Адские Лошади нашли решение этой проблемы: они создали несколько систем ручного оружия, которые добавляют огневой мощи и предоставляют командирам и пилотам некоторую тактическую гибкость омнимехов. Особенность: Точное оружие, носимое на руках Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

The installation of more jump jets and the Partial Wing has reduced the available space for weaponry, but the Hell's Horses found an answer for that problem: They created several hand-held weapons systems that add additional firepower and provide commanders and pilots with some of the tactical flexibility of an OmniMech.

content.content: «Инкубус II» имеет всего два средних импульсных ER-лазера, установленных в торсах. Для защиты пилота от ракетных атак в голове была установлена ​​система лазерной защиты AMS. Установка прыжковых двигателей и частичного крыла сократила доступное пространство для вооружения, но Адские Лошади нашли решение этой проблемы: они создали несколько систем ручного оружия, которые добавляют огневой мощи и предоставляют командирам и пилотам некоторую тактическую гибкость омнимехов.

content.original: The Ironhold Assault Battle Armor was developed by Clan Jade Falcon during the Jihad. The roots of the Ironhold go back to development of the Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle in 3069. After the success of that weapon, a new project codenamed Project Ferrum was started to develop a new suit of battle armor with the support of the Elemental Trinary of 3rd Falcon Talon Cluster. The Ironhold is noted for being more mobile than typical Clan Assault Armor, where it can employ its Jump Jets and give itself better tactical advantage over its opponents. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня «Айронхолд» была разработана кланом Нефритового Сокола во время Джихада. История «Айронхолда» восходит к разработке противопехотной винтовки Гаусса в 3069 году. После успеха этого оружия был запущен новый проект под кодовым названием «Феррум» по разработке нового боевого доспеха при поддержке тринария «Элемнталов» 3-го кластера Когтей Сокола. «Айронхолд» отличается большей мобильностью, чем типичная штурмовая клановая броня, что позволяет ему использовать прыжковые двигатели и получать большее тактическое преимущество над противниками. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.96 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Kage (translating to "shadow" in japanese) light battle armor was one of the first battle armor designs produced by the Draconis Combine after the Truce of Tukayyid. Built for reconnaissance and battlefield infiltration, development of the Kage was a joint operation between Internal Security Force scientists and Draconis Elite Strike Team advisers. Indeed the Kage was meant to provide an alternative to the much-respected DEST Infiltration Suit for missions in which DEST teams could expect heavy opposition, and since production started in 3056 the battle armor has virtually replaced the older Sneak Suit. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Лёгкая боевая броня «Каге» (что в переводе с японского означает «тень») была одним из первых образцов боевой брони, созданных Синдикатом Дракона после Туккаидского перемирия. Разработанная для разведки и проникновения на поле боя, «Каге» стала совместной операцией учёных Сил Внутренней Безопасности и советников Элитной ударной группы Дракона (DEST). «Каге» задумывался как альтернатива высоко ценимому Infiltration бронекостюму DEST для миссий, в которых отряды DEST могли ожидать серьёзного сопротивления, и с начала производства в 3056 году эта боевая броня фактически заменила устаревший Sneak Suit. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: A newer version of the Kanazuchi created to address some of the problems of the original. It replaces the right-arm laser with two Support PPCs, split between the left and right arm, and the SRM launchers with two single-tube Medium Range Missile launcher and eight reloads. The heavy claw and AP mounts are retained, as is its heavy armoring. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by Clan Cloud Cobra. Favouring a mix of firepower and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro-Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox Prime is armed with a LB/5X and an ER Large Laser. A Small Pulse Laser and a Streak SRM-4 round out the variant.

Отдавая предпочтение сочетанию огневой мощи и брони над скоростью, Kit Fox оснащен двигателем 180 XL и имеет смесь эндостали и ферроволокна, что обеспечивает ему 16 тонн пространства под вооружение. The Kit Fox Prime is armed with a LB/5X and an ER Large Laser. A Small Pulse Laser and a Streak SRM-4 round out the variant.

content.original: The Kobold is a battle armor design that was collaborated on by the Free Rasalhague Republic, ComStar, and the second Star League. Originaly a project for a battlesuit that could mimic the capabilities of the Draconis' Kage, later the concept of shifted somewhat to a light armor that can still hold its own in battle. The Kobold can only jump up to ninety meters at a time, but it does boast enough armor to stop a Medium Laser. This armor is of the basic stealth variety, making it more difficult to target far away. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.content: «Кобольд» — это проект боевой брони, разработанный совместно Свободной Республикой Расальхаг, КомСтаром и Второй Звёздной Лигой. Изначально это был проект боевого костюма, способного имитировать возможности «Каге» Синдиката, но позже концепция несколько сместилась в сторону лёгкой брони, способной пережить бой. «Кобольд» может прыгать только на девяносто метров за раз, но его брони достаточно, чтобы остановить средний лазер. Эта броня обладает базовым стелсом, что затрудняет прицеливание на большом расстоянии. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: This version of the Kobold was built by ComStar as a test platform for the Battle Armor C3i system. Though effective in combat, ComStar's engineers had to remove twenty percent of the armor used in the base suit and replace the existing weapon mounts with a single AP Weapon Mount. This unit is essentially a spotter for other friendly units, as its AP Weapon mount will only allow it to successfully engage conventional infantry. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.889 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Kopis battle armor was designed by StarCorps Industries as an assault unit. Slow but heavily armed, the Kopis can remain on the battlefield supporting friendly units for a long time. The advanced armor used by the Kopis designers allows it to stand up to most weaponry, shrugging off anything short of a PPC or AC/10 hit. The low top speed is mitigated through the use of VTOL transportation for offensive operations, while smart commanders use the Kopis as a defense unit for cities or other tight terrain. In those restricted environments the low top speed isn't a factor. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Kopis была разработана компанией StarCorps Industries как штурмовой юнит. Медленный, но хорошо вооружённый, Kopis может долгое время оставаться на поле боя, поддерживая дружественные юниты. Продвинутая броня, использованная конструкторами Kopis, позволяет ему противостоять большинству видов вооружения, за исключением попаданий из PPC или AC/10. Низкая максимальная скорость компенсируется использованием вертикального взлёта и посадки (VTOL) в наступательных операциях, в то время как опытные командиры используют Kopis в качестве оборонительного юнита в городах или других труднодоступных местах. В таких ограниченных условиях низкая максимальная скорость не имеет значения. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: With the success of the Mad Cat Mk II design Clan Diamond Shark developed the Mad Cat III as a medium 'Mech to accompany the heavy Mad Cat and assault Mad Cat II. Intended for sale to both Inner Sphere and Clan customers, it has been shunned by the Clans save for the Nova Cats and Exiled Wolves as '...an outrage against everything Nicholas Kerensky stood for and taught us.' However, it has proven popular with the Successor States. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: После успеха Mad Cat Mk II клан Алмазной Акулы разработал Mad Cat III как средний мех для сопровождения тяжёлого Mad Cat и штурмового Mad Cat II. Предназначавшийся как для продажи клиентам из Внутренней Сферы, так и для Кланов, он был отвергнут Кланами, за исключением Нова Котов и изгнанных Волков, как «...оскорбление всего, за что выступал и чему нас учил Николай Керенский». Тем не менее, мех оказался популярен в государствах-наследниках. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

Unfortunately the single ton of reloads carried was adequate only for Clan Trials, while the pair of ER Medium Lasers mounted in each arm made it an effective close-ranged combatant only as long as its minimal armor held out. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Introduced in 3078, the controversial and quirky Mangonel was a Clan Wolf-in-Exile heavy cavalry BattleMech built using Inner Sphere rather than Clan technology. content.original: The Mauler has had a lack of new variants since the Jihad. LAW's developmental experimentation in the late 3060s sought to perfect a new weapons suite focused on medium ranges while  improving the armor to suit an assault 'Mech. It did not fare well. As in a prior attempt to update the BattleMech most liked variant — 3062's MAL-3R — the Mauler's volatile CASE had to be discarded to accommodate new autocannon solutions, thereby undermining the quest for increased resilience. Increased armor mass required the use of a bulky endo-steel structure, reducing internal space, and allowing only a small cockpit. This aggregation of compromises eventually resulted in the flawed MAL-1KX, many of its shortcomings were never fixed, as the final production version that eventually became the MAL-1K was instead based on the MAL-1R.

content.original: Named for the door guards who serve to ward off evil spirits from a home, the Men Shen is the first OmniMech to come from the Capellan Confederation, it borrows heavily from the Raven BattleMech for its basic design concept. The 'Mech is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a vulnerable but light VOX 330 XL Engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h that is augmented by MASC system allowing the 'Mech to be pushed up to 129.6 km/h in short bursts. The Men Shen comes with eleven tons of armor, giving it a respectable amount of protection. The Men Shen carries on its base chassis a Beagle Active Probe allowing it to serve in a recon role regardless of its configuration. For weapons and equipment the Men Shen has seventeen tons of free pod space.

В своём базовом концепте, мех многое заимствует у Raven. Он построен на легком шасси из эндостали и приводится в действие уязвимым, но легким двигателем VOX 330 XL, который обеспечивает ему максимальную скорость 97,2 км/ч, которая дополняется системой MASC, позволяющей меху разгоняться до 129,6 км/ч короткими рывками. Men Shen поставляется с одиннадцатью тоннами брони, что обеспечивает ему внушительный уровень защиты. Men Shen несет на своем базовом шасси активный зонд Beagle, что позволяет ему выполнять разведывательную роль независимо от его конфигурации. Для оружия и оборудования Men Shen имеет семнадцать тонн свободного пространства.

content.original: With the destruction of many BattleMech factories in the Jihad, the Mjolnir was designed for the Lyran Commonwealth's export market. By selling the Mjolnir to any interested party, the Lyrans would gain much needed capital to rebuild their factories and restore their industrial might. To maximize profits, the designers focused on using existing successful 'Mech parts and components. Drawing from the Commando and Wolfhound designs, the Mjolnir entered production at Arc-Royal only a few months after being designed.

content.original: The Nighthawk Mk. XXI is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.884 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Nyx NX-80 has a pair of arm mounted ER medium lasers to provide it with moderate long ranged firepower. When the 'Mech closes in, it can bring its SRM-6 and ER small laser to bear. The waste heat from the weapons and other equipment is managed by 10 double heat sinks. The 'Mech utilizes a Beagle active probe as part of its role as a scout 'Mech. Its hull is protected by five tons of ferro-fibrous armor, so it can endure enemy fire long enough to fulfill its mission. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Nyx is a light BattleMech originally developed by the Word of Blake in the late Jihad. The Blakists' designs for the 'Mech and a prototype were captured by the Allied Coalition's Draconis Combine force on Quentin in 3077,[4] and were rushed off to the Draconis Combine's Diplan MechYards, where engineers did not have the resources to put the advanced design into production. After the liberation of Terra in 3079, the Combine would ask aide from the new Terran government to assist with development of the 'Mech. It would be jointly produced by both the Republic and Combine, prior to the very end of the Jihad. The design was conceived as a speedy recon 'Mech, with a 300 XL engine allowing it to reach 162 km/h.

content.original: The Nyx is a light BattleMech originally developed by the Word of Blake in the late Jihad. The Blakists' designs for the 'Mech and a prototype were captured by the Allied Coalition's Draconis Combine force on Quentin in 3077,[4] and were rushed off to the Draconis Combine's Diplan MechYards, where engineers did not have the resources to put the advanced design into production. After the liberation of Terra in 3079, the Combine would ask aide from the new Terran government to assist with development of the 'Mech. It would be jointly produced by both the Republic and Combine, prior to the very end of the Jihad. The design was conceived as a speedy recon 'Mech, with a 300 XL engine allowing it to reach 162 km/h.

They attempted to create a 'Mech similar to the Pack Hunter, but ER PPCs were sparse at the time, however the team got its break when the Nova Cats acquired a cache of heavy large lasers from Clan Diamond Shark in 3065. They had to rework the original concept of duplicating the Pack Hunter, which eventually became the Ocelot.

content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Пак Хантер» — первый новый проект, созданный кланом Волка-в-изгнании на Арк-Ройяле. Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей. Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The Pathfinder is a BattleMech designed by Bobby Louella of Zettle Metals Incorporated. Representing the lower end of the Lyran Commonwealth's production capability, the Pathfinder uses primitive armor, engines, and cockpits to allow Zettle to produce the 'Mechs more quickly and reduce the subsequent cost. As a result of this, the Pathfinder has been purchased in great numbers by the LCAF for their planetary militia units to augment their scouting capability while not requiring a huge investment.

Its genesis lies in the development of the Pikeman, a 'Mech that was in R&D when Kirc Cameron-Jones declared himself Captain-General of the Free Worlds League in 3069. With an eye to developing his military, he ordered Ronin to develop a 'Mech that could command a regiment and use artillery so that the commander would not be tempted to close with the enemy. Ronin was quickly able to convert their Pikeman to the necessary specifications, leading to production in late 3070. The variants of the 2C have seen greater production numbers and more widespread use, as their more general battlefield roles have surpassed the niche of the standard version.

content.original: The Pinion is part testbed, part leftovers. Developed by Clan Jade Falcon and introduced into service in 3065, the Pinion BattleMech is the second Clan 'Mech to be produced by Olivetti Weapons on Sudeten. The second-line BattleMech was designed as a patrol and guard duty 'Mech, so it has modest speed coupled with good maneuverability thanks to its jump jet range of 150 meters. Additionally, the Pinion is meant to test the effectiveness and drawbacks of heavy lasers, as early reports from Clan Star Adder indicated heavy lasers are unreliable and possibly damaging to the MechWarrior. In order to properly judge the effect of this new weapon, the Falcons decided to use garrison MechWarriors as guinea pigs. Their vitals were carefully tracked and medical evaluations were administered weekly as part of these tests.

content.original: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. The Purifier Terra uses a Modular Weapon Mount to provide a variety of weapons options. The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.prevOriginal: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. content.content: Основное отличие от стандартного костюма Purifier заключается в отсутствии адаптивной брони и её замене на стандартную клановую, идентичной той, что используется в костюме «Элементалов». Purifier Terra использует модульное оружейное крепление (MWM), предоставляющее широкий выбор оружия. Коалиция столкнулась с вариантами, оснащёнными клановым малым ER-лазером, малым импульсным лазером и бронебойной винтовкой Гаусса. Другие варианты использовали среднюю безоткатную винтовку. Кроме того, можно было нести любое снаряжение, помещающееся в 400-килограммовое MWM. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.872 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

This unit is however configured to be piloted by a MechWarrior. Its armament is divided equally between the left and right torso, each of which was equipped with an ER medium laser, a medium pulse laser and a pair of light machine guns. A single ton of ammunition for the light machine guns is placed in the central torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: The Revenant was originally a Word of Blake light drone 'Mech. The Revenant was primarily intended to engage light armor and infantry, a role that its weapon mix favored, but its ability to do so was hampered by a combination of mobility and armor more common to Succession Wars-era scout 'Mechs than the more advanced designs commonplace in the late thirty-first century.

content.original: First known to have been deployed in 3073, the Rogue Bear is a battle armor design produced by Clan Ghost Bear. Initially confused for the Golem, the Rogue Bear is a heavy battlesuit that was initially deployed with garrison units, especially those of the KungsArmé who were incorporated into the Ghost Bear touman. The Rogue Bear can jump up to sixty meters at a time. It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle. The battlesuit uses mostly standard components with no disposable weaponry. Quirk: Experimental Design Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

Первоначально ошибочно принятый за «Голема», «Бродячий Медведь» – тяжёлый боевой костюм, изначально использовавшийся вместе с гарнизонными юнитами, особенно с KungsArmé, входившими в состав тумена Призрачного Медведя. Rogue Bear может прыгать до 60 метров. Он защищён броней, достаточной, чтобы остановить выстрел из пушки Гаусса. Боевой костюм состоит в основном из стандартных компонентов и не имеет одноразового вооружения. content.original: Developed and commissioned New Hessen MechWorks during the Jihad, the 1A used primitive and obsolete components to produce a RetroTech success story. Mounting primitive armor, a 200 primitive engine, jump jets, and a standard chassis, the 1A carried weaponry that was modern if not cutting edge: a PPC for long range combat, supported by six medium lasers, two of which are rear-mounted, and a small laser. Fourteen single heat sinks required fire discipline from its MechWarrior. The top speed was a substandard 54 km/h. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83

content.original: The Rook NH-1B replaces the primitive technology systems of the NH-1A with their Succession Wars-era counterparts. Though it carries less armor than the original NH-1A, the armor is tougher and lighter. This allowed engineers to install a better engine that is larger and more efficient, allowing the NH-1B to reach a top speed of 64.8 km/h. It is also roomier, allowing the NH-1B to carry 20 single heat sinks, six more than the NH-1A. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The NH-1X, also knows as the Rook-X, upgrade kit was designed by Arica Vasthi and released by Hessen IndustrialWorks for customers who had purchased the original NH-1A. It keeps the same armor protection and speed as the NH-1A, but replaces the weaponry. An ER PPC with an experimental PPC capacitor provides long range firepower, supplemented by two ER medium lasers and a pair of medium lasers, and small laser has been replaced by a pair of ER small lasers. To help manage the increased heat, the Rook-X carries two more single heat sinks. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83

content.original: The NH-2 Rook upgrades almost every component of the original. The chassis, armor, and engine are all modern but affordable, as are the electronics. Two heat sinks were removed but the remaining twelve are upgraded to double heat sinks. The original PPC is upgraded to an ER PPC. The head-mounted small laser, the design's anti-infantry component, is now a Small Pulse Laser, far more effective at its task. The two rear-facing medium lasers were removed and the four remaining are more modern models. If the Rook NH-2 shines in any regard it is the Improved Jump Jets that allow it to jump over obstacles at the same speed as it can cover flat ground. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production. Quirk: Efficient Motive System Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Разработанный как быстрый пеший разведчик для юнитов бронепехоты, «Ротвейлер» выходит за рамки наземных скоростных возможностей обычной боевой брони. Облачённый в стелс-броню для экзокостюмов и оснащённый системой РЭБ, «Ротвейлер» представляет собой серьёзную цель. Однако эта скорость и уклончивость имеют свою цену: «Ротвейлер» легко вооружён. Каждый костюм оснащён малым лазером в качестве основного оружия и зажигательным игольником Firedrake в качестве запасного. Несмотря на невысокую огневую мощь, броня была признана приемлемой Лиранским Альянсом, и он был запущен в производство. Особенность: Efficient Motive System Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production.

content.original: The Salamander the design incorporates fire-based weapons; its primary armaments being a pair of Flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot short-range missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

Это делает «Саламандру» особенно эффективной против пехоты и боевой техники, хотя это не значит, что она менее устрашающа и для мехвоинов: мало кто захочет попасться на прицел «Саламандре». Особенность: Fire Demon Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Sarissa MN1-D is built on a primitive chassis, powered by a 240-rated primitive engine that is able to propel it at a max speed of 64.8 km/h. The design's main failing on the modern battlefield is its use of near-commercial grade armor, a mere 10 tons of primitive armor offering lackluster protection at best. Originally carrying a fairly simple weapons array, the Regulans' modern MN1-D model mounts a weapon loadout intended to handle a range of threats. Replacing the MN1-K's standard weaponry with a binary laser cannon gives the design significant punch for its size, supported by standard medium laser. To combat civil disorder, a machine gun with half a ton of ammunition is mounted alongside a small laser in the 'Mech's center torso. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82

content.original: One of the first primitive BattleMechs produced by the Free Worlds League, the Sarissa is one of many centuries-old Age of War designs reborn during the desperation of the Jihad. A contemporary of the Icarus and Mackie, the original MN1-K Sarissa, designed sometime shortly after 2470, was intended as a stopgap that could be readily manufactured in civilian IndustrialMech facilities to bolster the League's member state militias in the face of Lyran Commonwealth and Capellan Confederation newborn BattleMech forces. This philosophy would also make the Sarissa very appealing in 3080 as the Principality of Regulus suffered increasing losses during the Word of Blake Jihad, favoring even a primitive BattleMech over even more simple to build combat vehicles for propaganda purposes.

content.original: The Se'irim is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series, named for the satyr-like beings from Hebrew folklore. Used only in significant numbers by the elite Manei Domini, the Se'irim is the stealthy complement to the Asura. Where the latter serves as a main battlesuit the former specializes in ambush tactics. It carries 330kg of stealth armor, enough to stop a Medium Pulse Laser, which it uses along with its incredible ground speed get into cover and wait for the enemy's approach. Powered by a 280-rated XL Engine, the Sha Yu SYU-6B is clad in Stealth Armor with an onboard Guardian ECM Suite. Paired Snub Nose PPC’s and Medium Lasers give the SYU-6B a nasty punch. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.
content.content: Один из первых мехов, оснащённых стелс-бронёй, «Ша Ю» поступил в производство в 3063 году. 40-тонный мех «Ша Ю», или «Акула», разработан как снайперская и развед платформа для «Отрядов теней». Оснащённый двигателем XL280, Sha Yu SYU-6B оснащён стелс-бронёй и бортовым комплексом Guardian ECM. Спаренные Snub Nose PPC и средние лазеры позволяют вдарить весьма сильно. Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.

content.original: The Shedu is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series that is used exclusively by Manei Domini, one of the last of the Demons to be created by Precentor Vapula. Named for the half-bull, half-human demons of myth, the Shedu is an assault-class, quadrupedal battlesuit, a radical departure from the rest of the Demon line. The major advantage of the quad chassis is its speed, and Vapula used that to give the Shedu an excellent maximum ground speed for an assault-weight suit. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.904 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Шеду» — боевая броня из серии «Демон» Слова Блейка, используемая исключительно Маней Домини. Это один из последних «Демонов», созданных регентом Вапулой. Названный в честь мифических демонов-полубыков-полулюдей, «Шеду» — это четвероногий боевой костюм штурмового класса, радикально отличающийся от остальной линейки «Демонов». Главное преимущество квад шасси — скорость, и Вапула сделал акцент на ней, чтобы дать «Шеду» превосходную максимальную скорость передвижения по земле. Особенность: Fearsome Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.904 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The 8H is an improved version of the Shugenja which includes replacement of the XL Fusion Engine with a Light. The two Large Lasers are replaced with a pair of Light PPCs. A Guardian ECM Suite has been installed to added more protection from more sophisticated weaponry, such as Word of Blake C3i units. To protect from infantry attack, the 'Mech been given anti-infantry pods with a single A-Pod right leg, and a B-Pod to protect against battle armor attacks mounted on the left. Like its parent unit the 'Mech retains the ER PPC, MRM-30 Launcher and the C3 Master Computer. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Designed to be a heavy C3 command 'Mech the Shugenja is built around a chassis that supports a 300 XL engine which gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h allowing the Shugenja to keep up with most 'Mechs of its size while sacrificing durability for more free weight. The Shugenjas C3 computer allows it to act as a hub for friendly units equipped with C3 slave units to share targeting data.

content.original: The Spirit is one of the first Clan 'Mechs produced in the Inner Sphere. Though some components are imported from Clan space, the 245 XL engine is made in the Clan Jade Falcon Occupation Zone. The engine is only one of the weight-saving technologies the design makes use of, however, as the Spirit incorporates both an endo steel structure and six tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Spirit itself is a relatively fast recon 'Mech that can hold its own at both long and short ranges. In addition, it makes for a good training 'Mech, ensuring that it will have a place in the Falcon touman for a long time to come.

content.original: Debuting in 3072, the Sprite is one of the Society’s premier frontline ‘Ultraheavy’ ProtoMechs. Designed as a highly survivable, highly mobile fire support unit, the Sprite mates four LRM5 launchers to a rugged chassis fitted with five Extended Jump Jets and 3.25 tons of armor, over 20% of the unit’s mass. While not the most mobile unit on the ground, and a little light on ammunition, grouped Sprite formations have proved to be a lethal and stubborn foe to dislodge time and time again. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: Designed by Defiance Industries, the Storm Raider was intended to be an alternative to the Hollander light 'Mech. Unfortunately for Defiance, the Storm Raider was 50 years too late for the market, and the various prototypes were poorly received - so poorly received, in fact, that Defiance licensed all of the designs to Coventry Metal Works. Coventry Metal Works was manufacturing four different variants of the Storm Raider intended for use in urban defense roles or for small-scale surgical strikes, but the Storm Raider was a poor performer in both roles, outgunned by contemporaries and slower than most. Despite that, the Storm Raider proved an able fighter in the arenas at Solaris VII, where it became a fan favorite.

content.original: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Tai-sho carries a 255 fusion engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 54.0 km/h while also adding to the durability of the design. The 'Mech is protected with fifteen tons of Durallex ferro-fibrous armor and also has CASE in its right torso to protect the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion. To dissipate waste heat, the Tai-sho is equipped with thirteen double heat sinks.

In addition to four Jump Jets it is also equipped with a BattleMech HarJel System to repair hull breaches. Three Medium Pulse Lasers and a Large Pulse Laser provide energy weapon support. An SRM-6 and LRM-10 torpedo launcher increase the odds of breaching an enemy unit's armor. A C3 slave allows the Templar U to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The primary configuration of the Templar is intended to be able to engage an enemy effectively at any range. For effective long range hitting power, the Templar carries a powerful Gauss Rifle. If the Templar does close with an enemy, it can bring its highly accurate Large Pulse Laser, Medium Pulse Laser, and two ER Medium Lasers to bear on a target. For increased accuracy, the Gauss Rifle and all the lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer. The Templar Prime has a Streak SRM-4 launcher for seeking weak points in an enemy's armor.

content.original: The second of the Demon Series of battle armor to be spotted, the Tengu also appears to feature the most experimentation. Named after Japanese demons, the Tengu is unique for boasting both an enhanced ground speed and jump jets allowing it to leap sixty meters at a time in what some observers call "an overworked motive system arrangement." Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.898 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Тэнгу», второй из серии «Демон», замеченный в бою, также, похоже, отличается наибольшей экспериментальностью. Названный в честь японских демонов, «Тэнгу» уникален тем, что может похвастаться как повышенной скоростью передвижения по земле, так и прыжковыми двигателями, позволяющими ему совершать прыжки на 60 метров за раз, что некоторые наблюдатели называют «излишней двигательной системой»."

content.original: The Thunder Fox's principal weaponry includes a light Gauss rifle and a extended-range large laser. The rifle has been given only a ton of ammunition to consume. When the 'Mech is in close range, the Fox has a 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher and a extended-range small laser to rely on. The launcher only has one ton of ammunition, which is located in the right torso, along with the light Gauss rifle's ammunition. Protecting the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion, the right torso has been fitted with CASE to defend against such crippling damage. To make up for its 64 km/h speed the 'Mech can use its Jump Jets, which allow the 'Mech to jump 90 meters to prevent enemies from attacking it from behind, or to help it move in difficult terrain. The 'Mech's hull is protected by 9 tons of light ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Thunder Fox is a medium Quad BattleMech that was produced at the end of the Jihad, with thanks to an engineer named Lara Harman. Harman, a former Mitchell Vehicles designer, secretly - and principally - combined the Blue Flame Quad 'Mech's design specs with other Blakist designs to conceive the Thunder Fox. The design became popular with the newly formed Republic of the Sphere. It was later exported to the Draconis Combine and Lyran Commonwealth.

content.original: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Торнадо» — это легкая боевая броня, созданная КомСтаром в конце XXIX века для обеспечения дополнительной защиты юнитов специального назначения. Tornado основан на костюме Nighthawk от СОЗЛ, который, хотя КомСтар и приобрели несколько экземпляров, в то время не могли производить. Он включает в себя стелс-броню и адаптивную систему камуфляжа, которая имитирует эффект комбинированного камуфляжного/инфракрасного/электронного противодействия Sneak Suit, скрывая Tornado от всех типов датчиков. Броня также достаточно хороша, чтобы остановить огонь из стрелкового оружия и даже тяжелого оружия, такого как огнемет, и не дать ему повредить носителя. Особенность: Power Armor Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.8848 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The brainchild of Dr. Stephen Vance, Tortoise II Battle Armor was an assault-class quad battle armor developed by the Republic of the Sphere. It was a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies utilized by the Republic which was costly for StarCorps Industries of Terra to develop due to the unique design features Dr. Vance incorporated into it. Dr. Vance utilized wheels instead of rear legs to help the design carry its twin weapons modules onto the battlefield. Nicknamed the \"Wheelbarrow\", the original Tortoise prototype was a money pit. After a redesign and technology purchase from Arc-Royal MechWorks, the new Tortoise II proved to be successful despite its critics. Quirk: Experimental Design Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Детище доктора Стивена Вэнса, боевая броня Tortoise II представляла собой штурмовую квад боевую броню, разработанную Республикой Сферы. Она представляла собой гибрид технологий Внутренней Сферы и Кланов, использовавшихся Республикой, и была дорогостоящей для StarCorps Industries на Терре из-за уникальных конструктивных особенностей, заложенных доктором Вэнсом. Доктор использовал колеса вместо задних ног, чтобы конструкция могла перевозить сдвоенные орудийные модули на поле боя. Оригинальный прототип Tortoise, прозванный «Тачанкой», был настоящей денежной бездной. После модернизации и приобретения технологий у Arc-Royal MechWorks, новая Tortoise II оказалась успешной, несмотря на критику. Особенность: Experimental Design Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

Она представляла собой гибрид технологий Внутренней Сферы и Кланов, использовавшихся Республикой, и была дорогостоящей для StarCorps Industries на Терре из-за уникальных конструктивных особенностей, заложенных доктором Вэнсом. Доктор использовал колеса вместо задних ног, чтобы конструкция могла перевозить сдвоенные орудийные модули на поле боя. content.original: Kali Yama Weapons Industries began production on this variant in 3071 in an attempt to combine the best features of previous models, using the XL engine from the extinct 3C and jump jets from the 5J. The LRMs are replaced with four MML 5s, two mounted in the left arm and right torso, supplemented by four ER medium lasers on the right arm. Thirteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech relatively cool, though some heat management is required. It uses an Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Trinity is really three different battle armors, all initially constructed by the Capellan Confederation and therefore sharing the same base chassis. The Ying Long ("Shadow Dragon") uses the mimetic armor first created by Word of Blake for their Purifier, though how they acquired the technology is unknown. The Asterion and Theseus are functionally identical, but have different aesthetics.

content.content: «Троица» — это, на самом деле, три разных боевых брони, изначально созданных Конфедерацией Капеллы и использующих одну и ту же базовую платформу. «Йин Лонг» («Теневой Дракон») использует адаптивную броню, впервые созданную Словом Блейка для своего «Очистителя», хотя неизвестно, как они получили эту технологию. «Астерион» и «Тесей» функционально идентичны, но имеют разный внешний вид.

content.original: The Tundra Wolf was the first brand new Clan Wolf BattleMech fully developed and solely produced in the Inner Sphere. With losses mounting during the Word of Blake's Jihad, rather than a costly and complex OmniMech, Wolf technicians focused on producing a standard generalist design that could be readily manufactured and fill as many roles within their depleted touman as possible. While somewhat slow for a Clan-made 75-ton 'Mech, the Tundra Wolf made up for that with MASC, that allowed it to sprint in bursts and jump jets, enabling it to leap up to 120 meters at a time.

content.original: The Ursus II is a well-rounded 'Mech. Its long-range firepower includes an Artemis IV–guided LRM-10 launcher and an ER large laser. As the 'Mech closes in on its target, it can employ its close-range weaponry, which includes two medium pulse lasers, two ER small lasers, and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. Both missile launchers are allotted a single ton of ammunition, though both ammo bins are protected by CASE. To manage the 'Mech's potential heat issues, the Ursus II uses 13 double heat sinks. A pilot using the 'Mech must be careful not to overload their heat sinks, having to choose which systems to employ. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Ursus II is a Clan medium BattleMechb based on the Ghost Bears' second-line Ursus, the design had some considerable changes from the original. The XL Fusion Engine was downgraded to a 200-rated engine, to help lower costs. To make up for its loss in speed, the design was fitted with improved jump jets, which granted more tactical mobility. In its role as a bodyguard unit, the 'Mech employs an ECM suite. Its hull is protected by 10.5 tons of standard armor.

In its right arm is a single Plasma Cannon and a pair of AP Gauss Rifles. There are 2 tons of ammunition for the Cannon, while the AP Gs have been given a ton. The 'Mech has retained its ER Medium Lasers in the right torso. Its mobility was improved due to it receiving an XL Engine and six Jump Jets. content.original: The Ursus is a fusion between Clan and Inner Sphere technologies. The first Clan BattleMech designed and manufactured entirely and exclusively in the Inner Sphere, the Ursus uses Inner Sphere technology that has not been surpassed by that of the Clans where possible to maximize the efficiency of the factories Clan Ghost Bear captured during the Clan invasion. The rest of the parts are imported from Clan space. Though it took over seven years, Ghost Bear technicians made the Clan and Inner Sphere parts work together to create this second-line 'Mech.

content.original: The Ursus-PR was created by engineers from Clan Ghost Bear and the Free Rasalhague Republic. The standard weapons were removed and replaced by a pair of ProtoMech AC/8s, an ER Flamer, an Improved Heavy Medium Laser, and a trio of AP Gauss Rifles. The ammunition and gauss weapons are protected by CASE II, while the rest of the armor remains the same. The most interesting part of this refit isn't the weapons, but the Improved C3 Computer installed in the center torso. This allows a Star of Ursus-PRs to exchange targeting data. With its emphasis on anti-infantry weapons and short range combat, the 'Mech is apparently intended for anti-insurgency work. content.original: The Uziel is not a ground breaking BattleMech design, especially when compared with some of the new designs to come out of Hesperus II. It does, however, incorporate several newly developed weapon systems into an effective combat package. The Uziel carries a LB-2X Autocannon for hit and fade attacks which is backed up by a Large Pulse Laser at range and a bevy of ER lasers and a SRM-6 for close-range assault. Backed up with respectable speed and jump jets for maneuverability, the Uziel breaks no new ground but is a clean and effective design nonetheless.

Однако он включает в себя несколько недавно разработанных систем вооружения. Uziel несет автопушку LB-2X для атак типа «бей и беги», которая поддерживается большим импульсным лазером на расстоянии и множеством лазеров ER и SRM-6 для атаки с близкого расстояния. Подкрепленный приличной скоростью и прыжковыми двигателями для маневренности, Uziel не открывает ничего нового, но, тем не менее, это добротная и эффективная конструкция.

content.original: The Valiant was developed by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, one of the many weapon manufacturers on Solaris VII, at the behest of Irian BattleMechs Unlimited. Based on the Scarabus, the Valiant was conceived as a light skirmisher and first saw use during the Solaran resistance to the occupying Word of Blake in 3068. The two remaining prototypes were smuggled off world in 3070, when the design was picked up by Wakazashi Enterprises. Since the destruction of Luthien Armor Works, the heavy industry of the Draconis Combine was diversifying and expanding to keep the DCMS equipped, and the need for a ready-made BattleMech design overwhelmed the traditional Draconian dislike of hatchets. The 'Mech has received a tepid reception, even among the mercenaries that VEST has sold the design to.

content.original: Designed to work with the lightweight Wolfhound BattleMech, the Verfolger (German for 'Pursuer') and Wolfhound together are capable of taking out much larger BattleMechs. The Verfolger is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 325 XL engine that sacrifices durability for lighter weight and propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The 'Mech uses its saved weight to carry an impressive twelve and a half tons of armor that allows the Verfolger to stand up to fire from most enemy units that it would encounter.

Quirk: Void Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Despite the Wolf Trap no longer being produced, Luthien Armor Works authorized an upgrade program during the Jihad at their new plant on Abiy Adi. Though the Wolf Trap is unpopular, there were storehouses that abounded with the discarded 'Mech, giving the DCMS an upgraded machine in desperate times. The autocannon is replaced with a plasma rifle, while the missile launcher is upgraded to an MML 9. These changes give the -2 increased flexibility at the cost of range. It also upgrades the lasers to ER medium lasers and adds a third. In addition, three light machine guns are added and linked in a machine gun array. Finally, the heat sinks are upgraded to doubles and armor is redistributed. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Wolf Trap is a BattleMech that the Draconis Combine designed to be used as a long-range combat 'Mech. Originally called the Tora, Luthien Armor Works hastily rechristened it the Wolf Trap, the name Federated Commonwealth analysts had given it, to downplay its association with the Combine. The 'Mech is built on an endo steel chassis and protects any ammunition stores that it carries onboard with CASE that redirects the force of the explosion when an ammunition bin is hit by enemy fire. The 'Mech has a very respectable speed of 97.2 km/h, which it achieves through the use of a 270 XL engine.

This Wolf Trap variant is typically used by newer MechWarriors in less-prestigious units as a light cavalry unit. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: A second line Clan mech, the 45 ton Wyvern IIC is an upgrade of the SLDF Wyverns that survived the Exodus. Built using a cache of Wyverns, Clan Burrock upgraded every aspect of the original mech with Clan tech. Retaining the original 180-rated Fusion Core, the Wyvern IIC-2 is armed with a mix of weapons. A Heavy Large Laser and an ATM-9 make up the Mechs long range firepower, with a pair of Heavy Medium Lasers for medium range combat. A trio of LMG’s, an ER Flamer and a pair of Heavy Smalls give additional firepower at close range. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.content: Клановый мех второй линии, 45-тонная «Виверна IIC», представляет собой усовершенствованную версию Wyvern от СОЗЛ, пережившую Исход. Созданная из запасов из «Виверн», клан Баррока модернизировал каждый аспект оригинального меха, используя клановые технологии. Сохранив оригинальное 180-ое ядро, «Виверна IIC-2» вооружена комбинированным оружием. Тяжёлый большой лазер и ATM-9 обеспечивают дальнобойную огневую мощь меха, а пара тяжёлых средних лазеров — урон на средней дистанции. Трио лёгких пулемёта, ER-огнемёт и пара тяжёлых малых лазеров обеспечивают дополнительную огневую мощь вблизи. Особенность: Защищённые приводы Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.09

Тяжёлый большой лазер и ATM-9 обеспечивают дальнобойную огневую мощь меха, а пара тяжёлых средних лазеров — урон на средней дистанции. Трио лёгких пулемёта, ER-огнемёт и пара тяжёлых малых лазеров обеспечивают дополнительную огневую мощь вблизи.

content.original: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. Developed during the FedCom Civil War and built using the same engine and chassis as the ZEU-X, the -X2 took its weapons cues from the ZEU-9T model of Zeus; the -X2 carried an ER PPC as its main weapon, along with a smaller MRM 20 in place of the larger launcher on the -X, with just a single ton of ammunition. It was highly effective as a sniper 'Mech, with its high mobility giving it the ability to dictate the range of an engagement. Although it mounted a ton less armor, the -X2 carried eighteen double heat sinks, half again as many as the -X. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Изготовленный на заводе Defiance в Кванжон-ни, Zeus X стал одновременно образцом совершенства в области производственной инженерии и инновационной высокотехнологичной платформой. Разработанный во время Гражданской войны ФедСода и построенный с использованием того же двигателя и шасси, что и ZEU-X, -X2 позаимствовал своё вооружение у модели Zeus ZEU-9T; -X2 нёс ER PPC в качестве основного оружия, а также MRM 20 вместо более крупной установки на -X, с боезапасом всего в одну тонну. Он был очень эффективен в качестве снайперского меха, а его высокая мобильность давала ему возможность диктовать дистанцию боя. Несмотря на то, что он имел на тонну меньше брони, -X2 нёс восемнадцать двойных охладителей, что в два раза больше, чем -X. content.original: Created during the Age of War, the Vulture series of gunships are designed to wear targets down at range and provide direct fire support for allied units. A 30 ton gunship, the Vulture is usually built around some variation of a 100 rated engine, giving it a top speed of 120 km/h; with 4-5 tons of armour on each variant. Still in irregular production, the Vulture can be found in any number of variants across most of known space. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 120 15 Left 95 15 Right 95 15 Rear 75 15 Total 400 75 Quirk: Easy to Pilot

content.content: Созданная в Эпоху войн серия боевых вертолетов Vulture предназначена для уничтожения целей на большом расстоянии и оказания прямой огневой поддержки союзным юнитам. 30-тонный боевой вертолет Vulture обычно оснащается двигателем рейтинга 100, что позволяет ему развивать максимальную скорость 120 км/ч; каждая модификация имеет 4-5 тонн брони. Vulture по-прежнему производится нерегулярно, но его различные модификации можно встретить практически во всех известных уголках космоса. content.original: The Afreet is a battle armor design created by Clan Ice Hellion. The Afreet was created when Khan Raina Montose ordered two other projects merged, resulting in a battlesuit that seems to fit in well with the Hellion belief in speed over all else. The primary feature of the Afreet is its ability to leap one hundred twenty meters at a time. This comes at a sacrifice to armor, as the Afreet is only able to stop a Clan ER Small Laser. It does, however, use Improved Sensors, a holdover from one of the suits it descended from. Following the Hellion invasion of the Inner Sphere, both Clan Jade Falcon and Clan Hell's Horses salvaged and produced their own versions. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Африт» — это боевая броня, разработанная кланом Ледяного Хеллиона. «Африт» был создан после того, как хан Райна Монтозе приказала объединить два других проекта, в результате чего получился боевой костюм, который, похоже, хорошо вписывается в веру Хеллионов в превосходство скорости над всем остальным. Главной особенностью «Африта» является его способность прыгать на сто двадцать метров за раз. Это достигается за счёт снижения брони, «Африт» способен выдержать огонь максимум одного малого ER-лазера. Однако он использует улучшенные сенсоры, унаследованные от одного из костюмов, от которого он произошёл. После вторжения Хеллионов во Внутреннюю Сферу, клан Нефритового Сокола и клан Адских Лошадей собрали и создали свои собственные версии. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The closest thing the Demon Series of battle armor has to a standard, front-line model, the Asura is a medium-weight design. Compared to the Clan Elemental the Asura is not as well armored, although its 280kg of advanced armor can withstand a hit from a Clan ER Medium Laser. The Asura does not have any enhancements to a standard trooper's ground speed but carries jump jets to leap ninety meters at a time, matching the Elemental in terms of speed, and its weaponry has a longer reach. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Ближе всего к серии «Демон» находится боевая броня «Асура», модель среднего веса. По сравнению с клановым элементалом, «Асура» не так хорошо бронирован, хотя его 280 кг усовершенствованной брони способны выдержать попадание из среднего ER-лазера. «Асура» не быстрее своих аналогов, но оснащён прыжковыми двигателями, позволяющими совершать прыжки на девяносто метров, что сопоставимо с элементалом по скорости, а его оружие имеет большую дальность стрельбы. Особенность: Fearsome Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.872 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Black Hawk carries eight and a half tons of standard armor, a ton and a half less than the Nova, and uses an endo steel internal structure. The weight saved enables it to mount a pair of ER large lasers for direct fire support and four Streak SRM-4s for close range work. The Streak launchers were located in the 'Mech's arms, but the lasers were mounted in the left and right torso, while four tons of ammunition for the Streak launchers were split across the left and right torsos. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

Though not as heavily armored as some other ProtoMechs, the design's high speed prevents most opponents from getting a target lock. This variant adds an SRM-2 and more armor by replacing the engine with a smaller version. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96

content.content: Протомех Cecerops был разработан и построен кланом Духа Крови с использованием материалов, приобретенных у клана Снежного Ворона. Хотя он не так сильно бронирован, как некоторые другие протомехи, высокая скорость этой модели не позволяет большинству противников зафиксировать цель. Этот вариант оснащен SRM-2 и усиленной броней за счет замены двигателя на более компактную версию. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.96

content.original: The Clan Battle Armor is based on the Elemental suit, its visual aesthetic that shows that the Clan's contact with the Draconis Combine was already rubbing off on them. Though the design has a slow ground speed, the designers used the jump booster pioneered on the Gray Death Scout armor to rocket it up to one hundred twenty meters at a time. This necessitated a slight reduction in armor and a reworking of the weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Клановая боевая броня создана на основе костюма элементалей, внешний вид которого свидетельствует о том, что контакт Кланов с Синдикатом Дракона уже сказывался на них. Несмотря на низкую наземную скорость, разработчики использовали прыжковый ускоритель, впервые разработанный на броне Gray Death Scout, чтобы поднять его на высоту до ста двадцати метров. Это потребовало небольшого уменьшения толщины брони и переделки вооружения. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Corona is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Star Adder following the Trials to determine which Clans would take part in Operation REVIVAL. The idea was to build the battlesuit around a weapon that could threaten 'Mechs from a distance. The mass necessary to mount such a heavy weapon resulted in a twenty percent armor decrease and the removal of the jump pack, despite a fifty percent overall increase in mass. Quirk: Intimidating Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Корона» — это проект боевой брони, созданный кланом Звёздного Ужа после серии испытаний, определивших, какие кланы получат право на участие в операции «Возрождение». Идея заключалась в том, чтобы создать боекостюм с оружием, способным поражать мехи на расстоянии. Масса, необходимая для установки столь тяжёлого оружия, привела к снижению брони на 20% и удалению прыжкового ранца, несмотря на общее увеличение массы на 50%. Особенность: Устрашающий Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.935 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Djinn is the first known example of the so-called Demon Series of battle armor designs produced by Word of Blake for their Manei Domini. The Djinn has been carefully crafted to instill fear in its enemies. Its slim profile shows that it is obviously specially designed for Manei Domini troopers, since their use of cybernetic enhancements make up for the muscular bulk that "frail" Elementals and their Inner Sphere counterparts need to operate battle armor. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.889 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Джинн» — первый известный образец так называемой серии «Демон», разработанной Словом Блейка для своего Manei Domini. «Джинн» был тщательно спроектирован, чтобы вселять страх во врагов. Его тонкий профиль явно указывает на то, что он был разработан специально для бойцов Manei Domini, поскольку их кибернетические улучшения компенсируют мышечную массу, необходимую «хрупким» элементалям и их аналогам из Внутренней Сферы для использования боевой брони. Особенность: Fearsome Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.889 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Dragoon was conceived as a heavier, more versatile battlesuit for Wolf’s Dragoons’ Seventh Kommando. The Dragoon offers more protection and flexibility than common infiltration suits. This suit was originally designed to give combat engineers a degree of battlefield protection for high-risk intrusion operations, and to incorporate the ease of movement found in much lighter suits. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.89 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The standard against which all battle armor is measured, the Elemental battle armor was first introduced in 2868 by Clan Wolf in a Trial of Possession against the Nova Cats. It was a marvel of Clan engineering that allowed a small group of operators to take down large 'Mechs and survive the encounter. While it is possible for a normal-sized human to use the battle armor, this design is tailored for the Clans' giant Elemental warriors and only they can bring out its fullest potential. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Это было чудо инженерной мысли Кланов, позволившее небольшой группе воинов в броне уничтожить большие мехи и выжить. Хотя боевая броня может использоваться и людьми нормального роста, их конструкция разработана специально для гигантских воинов-элементалей Кланов, и только они могут раскрыть их потенциал в полной мере. content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Названный в честь демонического волка из германских мифов, «Фенрир» представлял собой скорее мобильную платформу огневой поддержки, чем традиционный боевой костюм. Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Golem is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Ghost Bear. Following their conflicts with first the Draconis Combine, then Clan Hell's Horses, the Bears decided they wanted something that could compete with the Kanazuchi and Gnome. The Golem is the result of that process and features enough armor to shrug off a Heavy Large Laser. In addition, this armor is fire resistant, so it is unaffected by Flamers and Inferno rounds. Though it cannot jump, the Golem is still speedier than the other assault-class designs. While that does not make this battlesuit fast, it does give it the ability to bring its strong weapons to bear on a target, even as it can withstand the punishment meted out by an enemy. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Golem is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Ghost Bear. Following their conflicts with first the Draconis Combine, then Clan Hell's Horses, the Bears decided they wanted something that could compete with the Kanazuchi and Gnome. The Golem is the result of that process and features enough armor to shrug off a Heavy Large Laser. In addition, this armor is fire resistant, so it is unaffected by Flamers and Inferno rounds. Though it cannot jump, the Golem is still speedier than the other assault-class designs. While that does not make this battlesuit fast, it does give it the ability to bring its strong weapons to bear on a target, even as it can withstand the punishment meted out by an enemy. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Gray Death Standard battle armor was developed by the technicians of the Gray Death Legion after the New Avalon Institute of Science sent them prototype battle armor suits, the progenitors of what eventually became the Inner Sphere Standard, for field testing. Using what was learned from these tests, the Legion decided to remove the suits' jump jets to make room for dedicated anti-infantry firepower, superior sensor systems, and reinforced myomer bundles to improve ground speed. While losing the ability to leap over obstacles, these changes made the suit easier to maintain and cheaper to build than the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Intuitive Controls Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Gray Death Standard была разработана техниками Gray Death Legion после того, как Институт науки Нового Авалона отправил им для полевых испытаний костюмы боевой брони, ставших предвестниками того, что впоследствии стало «Стандартом Внутренней Сферы». Используя результаты этих испытаний, Легион решил убрать прыжковые двигатели, чтобы освободить место для вооружения конкретно против пехоты, усовершенствованных сенсорных систем и усиленных пучков миомеров для повышения скорости движения. Несмотря на потерю способности перепрыгивать через препятствия, эти изменения сделали доспех более простым в обслуживании и более дешевым в производстве, чем «Стандарт Внутренней Сферы». Особенность: Intuitive Controls Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: This original prototype version of the Strike suit was unique for being a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technology. Built under the supervision of technician Brian Kinnison, this suit removed the improved sensors and modular weapon mount of the Gray Death Standard battlesuit. In their place are a Clan-spec detachable Advanced SRM-3 launcher with three shots mounted on the suit's body and a Light TAG system in the left arm that can spot for artillery units or units carrying Semi-Guided LRM. Both arms ended in Battle Claws. The reliance on Clan technology prevented the suit from reaching mass production, as not even Clan Diamond Shark was willing to sell enough components to justify such a move. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.908 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Unlike for the original Gray Death Strike design, Defiance Industries wasn't able to secure a source of the advanced Clan Improved SRM Launcher used on the prototype. As a result, Defiance used a single SRM-3 with two reloads. To make room for this the Gray Death Strike armor replaced the Battle Claws of the prototype with Basic Manipulators. The launcher can be jettisoned as well, allowing the unit to move slightly more quickly. The Light TAG system mounted in the arm allows armor that has jettisoned the SRM launcher to remain useful on the battlefield, designating enemy units for artillery and missile strikes. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

The size of the battlesuit precludes its ability to be transported on OmniMechs or perform anti-'Mech operations, though it does mount a battle claw. Its slow speed generally limits its use to defensive operations, though it has been known to travel by armored personnel carrier. content.original: The Jihad variant of this ancient Clan design features some advanced tech equipment in its redesign. The 'Mech's standard heat sinks and standard armor have been exchanged for double heat sinks and ferro-fibrous armor. The 'Mech's main weaponry consists of a pair of heavy medium lasers, one mounted in the right arm and the other in the right torso, with secondary weaponry consisting of a single ER flamer, mounted in the head. The 'Mech has been equipped with a Clan light TAG device to assist in the spotting role for artillery and missile fire support missions. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The Incubus II only has two torso-mounted ER Medium Pulse Lasers for offensive armament. A Laser AMS system was installed in the head to protect the pilot from missile attacks. The installation of more jump jets and the Partial Wing has reduced the available space for weaponry, but the Hell's Horses found an answer for that problem: They created several hand-held weapons systems that add additional firepower and provide commanders and pilots with some of the tactical flexibility of an OmniMech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Инкубус II» имеет всего два средних импульсных ER-лазера, установленных в торсах. Для защиты пилота от ракетных атак в голове была установлена ​​система лазерной защиты AMS. Установка прыжковых двигателей и частичного крыла сократила доступное пространство для вооружения, но Адские Лошади нашли решение этой проблемы: они создали несколько систем ручного оружия, которые добавляют огневой мощи и предоставляют командирам и пилотам некоторую тактическую гибкость омнимехов. Особенность: Точное оружие, носимое на руках Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Ironhold Assault Battle Armor was developed by Clan Jade Falcon during the Jihad. The roots of the Ironhold go back to development of the Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifle in 3069. After the success of that weapon, a new project codenamed Project Ferrum was started to develop a new suit of battle armor with the support of the Elemental Trinary of 3rd Falcon Talon Cluster. The Ironhold is noted for being more mobile than typical Clan Assault Armor, where it can employ its Jump Jets and give itself better tactical advantage over its opponents. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Штурмовая боевая броня «Айронхолд» была разработана кланом Нефритового Сокола во время Джихада. История «Айронхолда» восходит к разработке противопехотной винтовки Гаусса в 3069 году. После успеха этого оружия был запущен новый проект под кодовым названием «Феррум» по разработке нового боевого доспеха при поддержке тринария «Элемнталов» 3-го кластера Когтей Сокола. «Айронхолд» отличается большей мобильностью, чем типичная штурмовая клановая броня, что позволяет ему использовать прыжковые двигатели и получать большее тактическое преимущество над противниками. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.96 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Kage (translating to "shadow" in japanese) light battle armor was one of the first battle armor designs produced by the Draconis Combine after the Truce of Tukayyid. Built for reconnaissance and battlefield infiltration, development of the Kage was a joint operation between Internal Security Force scientists and Draconis Elite Strike Team advisers. Indeed the Kage was meant to provide an alternative to the much-respected DEST Infiltration Suit for missions in which DEST teams could expect heavy opposition, and since production started in 3056 the battle armor has virtually replaced the older Sneak Suit. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Лёгкая боевая броня «Каге» (что в переводе с японского означает «тень») была одним из первых образцов боевой брони, созданных Синдикатом Дракона после Туккаидского перемирия. Разработанная для разведки и проникновения на поле боя, «Каге» стала совместной операцией учёных Сил Внутренней Безопасности и советников Элитной ударной группы Дракона (DEST). «Каге» задумывался как альтернатива высоко ценимому Infiltration бронекостюму DEST для миссий, в которых отряды DEST могли ожидать серьёзного сопротивления, и с начала производства в 3056 году эта боевая броня фактически заменила устаревший Sneak Suit. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: A newer version of the Kanazuchi created to address some of the problems of the original. It replaces the right-arm laser with two Support PPCs, split between the left and right arm, and the SRM launchers with two single-tube Medium Range Missile launcher and eight reloads. The heavy claw and AP mounts are retained, as is its heavy armoring. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Kobold is a battle armor design that was collaborated on by the Free Rasalhague Republic, ComStar, and the second Star League. Originaly a project for a battlesuit that could mimic the capabilities of the Draconis' Kage, later the concept of shifted somewhat to a light armor that can still hold its own in battle. The Kobold can only jump up to ninety meters at a time, but it does boast enough armor to stop a Medium Laser. This armor is of the basic stealth variety, making it more difficult to target far away. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Кобольд» — это проект боевой брони, разработанный совместно Свободной Республикой Расальхаг, КомСтаром и Второй Звёздной Лигой. Изначально это был проект боевого костюма, способного имитировать возможности «Каге» Синдиката, но позже концепция несколько сместилась в сторону лёгкой брони, способной пережить бой. «Кобольд» может прыгать только на девяносто метров за раз, но его брони достаточно, чтобы остановить средний лазер. Эта броня обладает базовым стелсом, что затрудняет прицеливание на большом расстоянии. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.889 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.
