content.original: This version of the Kobold was built by ComStar as a test platform for the Battle Armor C3i system. Though effective in combat, ComStar's engineers had to remove twenty percent of the armor used in the base suit and replace the existing weapon mounts with a single AP Weapon Mount. This unit is essentially a spotter for other friendly units, as its AP Weapon mount will only allow it to successfully engage conventional infantry. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.889 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Kopis battle armor was designed by StarCorps Industries as an assault unit. Slow but heavily armed, the Kopis can remain on the battlefield supporting friendly units for a long time. The advanced armor used by the Kopis designers allows it to stand up to most weaponry, shrugging off anything short of a PPC or AC/10 hit. The low top speed is mitigated through the use of VTOL transportation for offensive operations, while smart commanders use the Kopis as a defense unit for cities or other tight terrain. In those restricted environments the low top speed isn't a factor. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Kopis была разработана компанией StarCorps Industries как штурмовой юнит. Медленный, но хорошо вооружённый, Kopis может долгое время оставаться на поле боя, поддерживая дружественные юниты. Продвинутая броня, использованная конструкторами Kopis, позволяет ему противостоять большинству видов вооружения, за исключением попаданий из PPC или AC/10. Низкая максимальная скорость компенсируется использованием вертикального взлёта и посадки (VTOL) в наступательных операциях, в то время как опытные командиры используют Kopis в качестве оборонительного юнита в городах или других труднодоступных местах. В таких ограниченных условиях низкая максимальная скорость не имеет значения. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: With the success of the Mad Cat Mk II design Clan Diamond Shark developed the Mad Cat III as a medium 'Mech to accompany the heavy Mad Cat and assault Mad Cat II. Intended for sale to both Inner Sphere and Clan customers, it has been shunned by the Clans save for the Nova Cats and Exiled Wolves as '...an outrage against everything Nicholas Kerensky stood for and taught us.' However, it has proven popular with the Successor States. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: После успеха Mad Cat Mk II клан Алмазной Акулы разработал Mad Cat III как средний мех для сопровождения тяжёлого Mad Cat и штурмового Mad Cat II. Предназначавшийся как для продажи клиентам из Внутренней Сферы, так и для Кланов, он был отвергнут Кланами, за исключением Нова Котов и изгнанных Волков, как «...оскорбление всего, за что выступал и чему нас учил Николай Керенский». Тем не менее, мех оказался популярен в государствах-наследниках. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Mangonel MNL-3L was literally built around the massive torso bay which contained its primary weapons, a pair of Light Gauss Rifles, which when combined with its high speed allowed the 'Mech to dance around its targets at range. Unfortunately the single ton of reloads carried was adequate only for Clan Trials, while the pair of ER Medium Lasers mounted in each arm made it an effective close-ranged combatant only as long as its minimal armor held out. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: This Dark Age-era variant was created by the Capellan Confederation. It uses a light fusion engine to reduce vulnerability to engine destruction, and carries a Gauss Rifle in each arm. These are supported by a single torso mounted ER PPC. A Guardian ECM Suite powers the Stealth Armor that encases this design. It retains the ability to jump 90 meters at a time. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Этот вариант времён Тёмного века, был создан Конфедерацией Капеллы. Он использует лёгкий термоядерный двигатель, снижающий шанс его уничтожения и оснащён пушкой Гаусса в каждой руке. Их поддерживает одна ER PPC в торсе. Комплекс РЭБ «Страж» питает стелс-броню, в которую облачён этот вариант. Сохранена способность прыгать на 90 метров за раз. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.18 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The newest of the Word of Blake's Demon Series of battle armor is the Nephilim. Named for a group of half-angels from the bible who dwelt with mortals, the name may hint at the unit's intended close relationship with the Celestial series. Like the Celestial series, the Nephilim employs modular and/or detachable weapon mounts to give it a flexibility few other Demon series suits possess. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.904 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

Названная в честь группы полуангелов из Библии, живших среди смертных, может намекать на предполагаемую тесную связь с серией «Целестиал». Как и в серии Celestial, «Нефилимы» используют модульные и/или съёмные крепления для оружия, что обеспечивает им гибкость, которой обладают немногие другие костюмы серии «Демон». content.original: The Nighthawk Mk. XXI is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.884 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

The 'Mech utilizes a Beagle active probe as part of its role as a scout 'Mech. Its hull is protected by five tons of ferro-fibrous armor, so it can endure enemy fire long enough to fulfill its mission. content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Пак Хантер» — первый новый проект, созданный кланом Волка-в-изгнании на Арк-Ройяле. Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей. Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

The Purifier Adaptive is revolutionary in that it uses mimetic, color-shifting armor. The Mimetic Armor makes the Purifier Adaptive much more difficult to target, especially when it is motionless. The drawback comes in the amount of armor it carries. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.868 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. The Purifier Terra uses a Modular Weapon Mount to provide a variety of weapons options. The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.prevOriginal: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. content.content: Основное отличие от стандартного костюма Purifier заключается в отсутствии адаптивной брони и её замене на стандартную клановую, идентичной той, что используется в костюме «Элементалов». Purifier Terra использует модульное оружейное крепление (MWM), предоставляющее широкий выбор оружия. Коалиция столкнулась с вариантами, оснащёнными клановым малым ER-лазером, малым импульсным лазером и бронебойной винтовкой Гаусса. Другие варианты использовали среднюю безоткатную винтовку. Кроме того, можно было нести любое снаряжение, помещающееся в 400-килограммовое MWM. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.872 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
content.content: Основное отличие от стандартного костюма Purifier заключается в отсутствии адаптивной брони и её замене на стандартную клановую, идентичной той, что используется в костюме «Элементалов». Purifier Terra использует модульное оружейное крепление (MWM), предоставляющее широкий выбор оружия. Коалиция столкнулась с вариантами, оснащёнными клановым малым ER-лазером, малым импульсным лазером и бронебойной винтовкой Гаусса. Другие варианты использовали среднюю безоткатную винтовку. Кроме того, можно было нести любое снаряжение, помещающееся в 400-килограммовое MWM. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.872 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

A fan favorite during its time in the arenas, designed to ambush its prey from close range. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The 1A is the original Revenant used by Word of Blake, with most of them controlled by a drone remote operating system. This unit is however configured to be piloted by a MechWarrior. Its armament is divided equally between the left and right torso, each of which was equipped with an ER medium laser, a medium pulse laser and a pair of light machine guns. A single ton of ammunition for the light machine guns is placed in the central torso. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: First known to have been deployed in 3073, the Rogue Bear is a battle armor design produced by Clan Ghost Bear. Initially confused for the Golem, the Rogue Bear is a heavy battlesuit that was initially deployed with garrison units, especially those of the KungsArmé who were incorporated into the Ghost Bear touman. The Rogue Bear can jump up to sixty meters at a time. It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle. The battlesuit uses mostly standard components with no disposable weaponry. Quirk: Experimental Design Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.935 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня Rogue Bear, разработанная кланом Призрачного Медведя, впервые появившаяся в 3073 году. Первоначально ошибочно принятый за «Голема», «Бродячий Медведь» – тяжёлый боевой костюм, изначально использовавшийся вместе с гарнизонными юнитами, особенно с KungsArmé, входившими в состав тумена Призрачного Медведя. Rogue Bear может прыгать до 60 метров. Он защищён броней, достаточной, чтобы остановить выстрел из пушки Гаусса. Боевой костюм состоит в основном из стандартных компонентов и не имеет одноразового вооружения. Особенность: Experimental Design Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.935 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Developed and commissioned New Hessen MechWorks during the Jihad, the 1A used primitive and obsolete components to produce a RetroTech success story. Mounting primitive armor, a 200 primitive engine, jump jets, and a standard chassis, the 1A carried weaponry that was modern if not cutting edge: a PPC for long range combat, supported by six medium lasers, two of which are rear-mounted, and a small laser. Fourteen single heat sinks required fire discipline from its MechWarrior. The top speed was a substandard 54 km/h. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83

content.original: The Rook NH-1B replaces the primitive technology systems of the NH-1A with their Succession Wars-era counterparts. Though it carries less armor than the original NH-1A, the armor is tougher and lighter. This allowed engineers to install a better engine that is larger and more efficient, allowing the NH-1B to reach a top speed of 64.8 km/h. It is also roomier, allowing the NH-1B to carry 20 single heat sinks, six more than the NH-1A. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The NH-1X, also knows as the Rook-X, upgrade kit was designed by Arica Vasthi and released by Hessen IndustrialWorks for customers who had purchased the original NH-1A. It keeps the same armor protection and speed as the NH-1A, but replaces the weaponry. An ER PPC with an experimental PPC capacitor provides long range firepower, supplemented by two ER medium lasers and a pair of medium lasers, and small laser has been replaced by a pair of ER small lasers. To help manage the increased heat, the Rook-X carries two more single heat sinks. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.83

content.original: The NH-2 Rook upgrades almost every component of the original. The chassis, armor, and engine are all modern but affordable, as are the electronics. Two heat sinks were removed but the remaining twelve are upgraded to double heat sinks. The original PPC is upgraded to an ER PPC. The head-mounted small laser, the design's anti-infantry component, is now a Small Pulse Laser, far more effective at its task. The two rear-facing medium lasers were removed and the four remaining are more modern models. If the Rook NH-2 shines in any regard it is the Improved Jump Jets that allow it to jump over obstacles at the same speed as it can cover flat ground. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production. Quirk: Efficient Motive System Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Разработанный как быстрый пеший разведчик для юнитов бронепехоты, «Ротвейлер» выходит за рамки наземных скоростных возможностей обычной боевой брони. Облачённый в стелс-броню для экзокостюмов и оснащённый системой РЭБ, «Ротвейлер» представляет собой серьёзную цель. Однако эта скорость и уклончивость имеют свою цену: «Ротвейлер» легко вооружён. Каждый костюм оснащён малым лазером в качестве основного оружия и зажигательным игольником Firedrake в качестве запасного. Несмотря на невысокую огневую мощь, броня была признана приемлемой Лиранским Альянсом, и он был запущен в производство. Особенность: Efficient Motive System Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Sarissa MN1-D is built on a primitive chassis, powered by a 240-rated primitive engine that is able to propel it at a max speed of 64.8 km/h. The design's main failing on the modern battlefield is its use of near-commercial grade armor, a mere 10 tons of primitive armor offering lackluster protection at best. Originally carrying a fairly simple weapons array, the Regulans' modern MN1-D model mounts a weapon loadout intended to handle a range of threats. Replacing the MN1-K's standard weaponry with a binary laser cannon gives the design significant punch for its size, supported by standard medium laser. To combat civil disorder, a machine gun with half a ton of ammunition is mounted alongside a small laser in the 'Mech's center torso. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.82

content.original: The Se'irim is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series, named for the satyr-like beings from Hebrew folklore. Used only in significant numbers by the elite Manei Domini, the Se'irim is the stealthy complement to the Asura. Where the latter serves as a main battlesuit the former specializes in ambush tactics. It carries 330kg of stealth armor, enough to stop a Medium Pulse Laser, which it uses along with its incredible ground speed get into cover and wait for the enemy's approach. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.872 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Се'ирим» — боевая броня из серии «Демон» Слова Блейка, названная в честь сатироподобных существ из еврейского фольклора. Используемая в значительных количествах одной лишь элитой Маней Домини, «Се'ирим» служил скрытным дополнением к «Асуре». Если последний служит основным боевым костюмом, то «Се'ирим» специализируется на засадных атаках. Он несёт 330 кг стелс-брони, достаточной для защиты от среднего импульсного лазера. Благодаря этому, а также невероятной скорости передвижения, он может укрыться и ждать приближения противника. Особенность: Fearsome Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.872 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.content: Один из первых мехов, оснащённых стелс-бронёй, «Ша Ю» поступил в производство в 3063 году. 40-тонный мех «Ша Ю», или «Акула», разработан как снайперская и развед платформа для «Отрядов теней». Оснащённый двигателем XL280, Sha Yu SYU-6B оснащён стелс-бронёй и бортовым комплексом Guardian ECM. Спаренные Snub Nose PPC и средние лазеры позволяют вдарить весьма сильно. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Shedu is a battle armor design in the Word of Blake's Demon Series that is used exclusively by Manei Domini, one of the last of the Demons to be created by Precentor Vapula. Named for the half-bull, half-human demons of myth, the Shedu is an assault-class, quadrupedal battlesuit, a radical departure from the rest of the Demon line. The major advantage of the quad chassis is its speed, and Vapula used that to give the Shedu an excellent maximum ground speed for an assault-weight suit. Quirk: Fearsome Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.904 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Шеду» — боевая броня из серии «Демон» Слова Блейка, используемая исключительно Маней Домини. Это один из последних «Демонов», созданных регентом Вапулой. Названный в честь мифических демонов-полубыков-полулюдей, «Шеду» — это четвероногий боевой костюм штурмового класса, радикально отличающийся от остальной линейки «Демонов». Главное преимущество квад шасси — скорость, и Вапула сделал акцент на ней, чтобы дать «Шеду» превосходную максимальную скорость передвижения по земле. Особенность: Fearsome Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.904 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The 8H is an improved version of the Shugenja which includes replacement of the XL Fusion Engine with a Light. The two Large Lasers are replaced with a pair of Light PPCs. A Guardian ECM Suite has been installed to added more protection from more sophisticated weaponry, such as Word of Blake C3i units. To protect from infantry attack, the 'Mech been given anti-infantry pods with a single A-Pod right leg, and a B-Pod to protect against battle armor attacks mounted on the left. Like its parent unit the 'Mech retains the ER PPC, MRM-30 Launcher and the C3 Master Computer. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The second variant of the Sphinx was produced by Clan Nova Cat in preparation for the last thrust against the Blakists. The design drops all its ER Mediums Lasers and a single Double Heat Sink for the following modifications: In place of the ER Medium Lasers, a series of 10 ER Small Lasers are split up between the side torsos. Also, both ER Large Lasers are moved to the Center Torso, and MASC has been added. To help with more precise strikes, a Targeting Computer is added. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17

content.original: Debuting in 3072, the Sprite is one of the Society’s premier frontline ‘Ultraheavy’ ProtoMechs. Designed as a highly survivable, highly mobile fire support unit, the Sprite mates four LRM5 launchers to a rugged chassis fitted with five Extended Jump Jets and 3.25 tons of armor, over 20% of the unit’s mass. While not the most mobile unit on the ground, and a little light on ammunition, grouped Sprite formations have proved to be a lethal and stubborn foe to dislodge time and time again. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: Taking something of an alternate approach to the same battlefield niche, the Sprite 2 trades it’s quartet of LRM launchers for a single ‘Mech-scale ERLL. While it lacks the raw offensive power of the 1, it is able to deal highly concentrated damage, and turns the Sprite into a mobile, hardy, and lethal sniping platform. Both patterns operate with great synergy, the 2 punching holes in armor for the 1’s launchers to exploit, much to the chagrin of forces facing the Society in combat. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

content.original: A stark departure from the standard design doctrine of the Sprite, the 3 mounts a pair of the new Fusillade launcher systems, backed by a pair of Medium Chemical Lasers. While limited in it’s main punch and entirely dependent on ammunition, the sheer versatility in available munition types for the Fusillade system allow it a great degree of battlefield versatility, from dealing heavy direct damage to disabling and overheating hostile vehicles and BattleMechs. Quirk: Resilient Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99

Principally geared toward usage of energy weapons, it includes; paired Heavy Medium & Medium Pulse Lasers, Heavy Small Lasers, and a Streak SRM 4 Launcher. Also, to enhance its infighting abilities, it's been given eight Improved Jump Jets. Two additional Double Heat Sinks have been added to help the 'Mech to cope with the additional heat. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: The STM-M3 is the original Defiance Industries design. The 'Mech was designed as a close quarters melee machine and premiered in Solaris VII's arena matches and as such its weapons configuration was modified on a customer by customer basis. The 'Mech was later seen in action on the battlefield after the crash of the HPG Network of 3132. The -M3 was armed with a single left arm mounted UAC/5, while its right arm permanently grasps its signature mace. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.original: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Thunder Fox's principal weaponry includes a light Gauss rifle and a extended-range large laser. The rifle has been given only a ton of ammunition to consume. When the 'Mech is in close range, the Fox has a 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher and a extended-range small laser to rely on. The launcher only has one ton of ammunition, which is located in the right torso, along with the light Gauss rifle's ammunition. Protecting the 'Mech from an ammunition explosion, the right torso has been fitted with CASE to defend against such crippling damage. To make up for its 64 km/h speed the 'Mech can use its Jump Jets, which allow the 'Mech to jump 90 meters to prevent enemies from attacking it from behind, or to help it move in difficult terrain. The 'Mech's hull is protected by 9 tons of light ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Торнадо» — это легкая боевая броня, созданная КомСтаром в конце XXIX века для обеспечения дополнительной защиты юнитов специального назначения. Tornado основан на костюме Nighthawk от СОЗЛ, который, хотя КомСтар и приобрели несколько экземпляров, в то время не могли производить. Он включает в себя стелс-броню и адаптивную систему камуфляжа, которая имитирует эффект комбинированного камуфляжного/инфракрасного/электронного противодействия Sneak Suit, скрывая Tornado от всех типов датчиков. Броня также достаточно хороша, чтобы остановить огонь из стрелкового оружия и даже тяжелого оружия, такого как огнемет, и не дать ему повредить носителя. Особенность: Power Armor Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.8848 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The brainchild of Dr. Stephen Vance, Tortoise II Battle Armor was an assault-class quad battle armor developed by the Republic of the Sphere. It was a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies utilized by the Republic which was costly for StarCorps Industries of Terra to develop due to the unique design features Dr. Vance incorporated into it. Dr. Vance utilized wheels instead of rear legs to help the design carry its twin weapons modules onto the battlefield. Nicknamed the \"Wheelbarrow\", the original Tortoise prototype was a money pit. After a redesign and technology purchase from Arc-Royal MechWorks, the new Tortoise II proved to be successful despite its critics. Quirk: Experimental Design Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Детище доктора Стивена Вэнса, боевая броня Tortoise II представляла собой штурмовую квад боевую броню, разработанную Республикой Сферы. Она представляла собой гибрид технологий Внутренней Сферы и Кланов, использовавшихся Республикой, и была дорогостоящей для StarCorps Industries на Терре из-за уникальных конструктивных особенностей, заложенных доктором Вэнсом. Доктор использовал колеса вместо задних ног, чтобы конструкция могла перевозить сдвоенные орудийные модули на поле боя. Оригинальный прототип Tortoise, прозванный «Тачанкой», был настоящей денежной бездной. После модернизации и приобретения технологий у Arc-Royal MechWorks, новая Tortoise II оказалась успешной, несмотря на критику. Особенность: Experimental Design Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Kali Yama Weapons Industries began production on this variant in 3071 in an attempt to combine the best features of previous models, using the XL engine from the extinct 3C and jump jets from the 5J. The LRMs are replaced with four MML 5s, two mounted in the left arm and right torso, supplemented by four ER medium lasers on the right arm. Thirteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech relatively cool, though some heat management is required. It uses an Endo Steel chassis. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

This Undine version replaces the UMU with standard Elementals JJs, while retaining its signature LRM/T launcher. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Боевая броня «Ундина» была создана кланом Скорпиона-голиафа в качестве боевой модификации оригинальных «водных элементалей» — подводных экзоскелетов, вдохновивших клан Волка на создание боевой брони элементалов. В версии «Ундины» UMU (подводная двигательная система) заменена на стандартные прыжковые двигатели элементалей, при этом сохраняется фирменная пусковая установка LRM/T. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Ursus II is a well-rounded 'Mech. Its long-range firepower includes an Artemis IV–guided LRM-10 launcher and an ER large laser. As the 'Mech closes in on its target, it can employ its close-range weaponry, which includes two medium pulse lasers, two ER small lasers, and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. Both missile launchers are allotted a single ton of ammunition, though both ammo bins are protected by CASE. To manage the 'Mech's potential heat issues, the Ursus II uses 13 double heat sinks. content.original: The Ursus-PR was created by engineers from Clan Ghost Bear and the Free Rasalhague Republic. The standard weapons were removed and replaced by a pair of ProtoMech AC/8s, an ER Flamer, an Improved Heavy Medium Laser, and a trio of AP Gauss Rifles. The ammunition and gauss weapons are protected by CASE II, while the rest of the armor remains the same. The most interesting part of this refit isn't the weapons, but the Improved C3 Computer installed in the center torso. This allows a Star of Ursus-PRs to exchange targeting data. With its emphasis on anti-infantry weapons and short range combat, the 'Mech is apparently intended for anti-insurgency work. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Despite the Wolf Trap no longer being produced, Luthien Armor Works authorized an upgrade program during the Jihad at their new plant on Abiy Adi. Though the Wolf Trap is unpopular, there were storehouses that abounded with the discarded 'Mech, giving the DCMS an upgraded machine in desperate times. The autocannon is replaced with a plasma rifle, while the missile launcher is upgraded to an MML 9. These changes give the -2 increased flexibility at the cost of range. It also upgrades the lasers to ER medium lasers and adds a third. In addition, three light machine guns are added and linked in a machine gun array. Finally, the heat sinks are upgraded to doubles and armor is redistributed. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

Созданная из запасов из «Виверн», клан Баррока модернизировал каждый аспект оригинального меха, используя клановые технологии. Сохранив оригинальное 180-ое ядро, «Виверна IIC-2» вооружена комбинированным оружием. Тяжёлый большой лазер и ATM-9 обеспечивают дальнобойную огневую мощь меха, а пара тяжёлых средних лазеров — урон на средней дистанции. Трио лёгких пулемёта, ER-огнемёт и пара тяжёлых малых лазеров обеспечивают дополнительную огневую мощь вблизи. Особенность: Защищённые приводы Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.09

content.original: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. Developed during the FedCom Civil War and built using the same engine and chassis as the ZEU-X, the -X2 took its weapons cues from the ZEU-9T model of Zeus; the -X2 carried an ER PPC as its main weapon, along with a smaller MRM 20 in place of the larger launcher on the -X, with just a single ton of ammunition. It was highly effective as a sniper 'Mech, with its high mobility giving it the ability to dictate the range of an engagement. Although it mounted a ton less armor, the -X2 carried eighteen double heat sinks, half again as many as the -X. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.content: Изготовленный на заводе Defiance в Кванжон-ни, Zeus X стал одновременно образцом совершенства в области производственной инженерии и инновационной высокотехнологичной платформой. Разработанный во время Гражданской войны ФедСода и построенный с использованием того же двигателя и шасси, что и ZEU-X, -X2 позаимствовал своё вооружение у модели Zeus ZEU-9T; -X2 нёс ER PPC в качестве основного оружия, а также MRM 20 вместо более крупной установки на -X, с боезапасом всего в одну тонну. Он был очень эффективен в качестве снайперского меха, а его высокая мобильность давала ему возможность диктовать дистанцию боя. Несмотря на то, что он имел на тонну меньше брони, -X2 нёс восемнадцать двойных охладителей, что в два раза больше, чем -X. Изначально разработанная для быстрой перевозки тяжёлой бронетехники в условиях боя, эта конструкция с тех пор породила множество подражателей и клонов, и практически в каждом развитом мире Внутренней Сферы и Периферии есть хотя бы один «Игорь» или его клон. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the 'Mech effective at any range. The 'Mech has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 km/h and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability. content.original: Precentor Dantalion of the 49th Shadow Division equipped his personal 'Mech with some experimental equipment. A Small Cockpit allows a Laser AMS to be mounted in the head, while a Heavy-Duty Gyro and Light Engine make the 'Mech harder to kill. Protection was upgraded as well, using Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor. Finally, a Guardian ECM Suiteprotects against enemy electronics. Offensively, Dantalion's custom Albatross uses an ER PPC with PPC Capacitor in the left arm, balanced by a Large VSP Laser in the right. For close combat, the left and right torso each get an ER Medium Laser and Medium Pulse Laser, and the right torso mounts a single ER Small Laser. In addition, the 'Mech is equipped with Triple Strength Myomer, making it a deadly foe in melee combat.

content.original: This experimental variant was a custom refit of the Fa Shih by Ceres Metals in 3078. Under the supervision of Ogden Isray, four Fa Shih suits were fitted with Clan-technology myomer boosters. This not only increased their ground speed to 32.4 km/h but improved their strength as well, allowing the armored soldiers to tear through more 'Mech armor with their manipulators. This came at a cost though as the anti-personnel mount and 150 kg of armor had to be removed, meaning the suit can only withstand two bursts from a Machine Gun. Only four of these suits were built due to the limited number of myomer boosters the Capellans were able to acquire. Quirk: Inspiring Appearance Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.908 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Gray Death Scout is a radical take on battle armor, almost taking the "battle" out of battle armor. When the New Avalon Institute of Science sent prototypes of its Inner Sphere Standard to the Gray Death Legion, the mercenaries were duly impressed with many of its features. They also had a number of criticisms, sending a long list of improvements back to NAIS while Legion technicians went about with their own tinkering. By late 3051 the Legion had created two distinct suits from the original prototype: a Gray Death Standard similar in form and function of the Inner Sphere Standard, and a light "scout armor" suit. By stripping off more than half of the prototype's armor and its integrated weaponry, the technicians were able to improve the Scout's jumping and sensor capabilities, creating a suit suitable for deep reconnaissance missions.

content.original: In 3076 Fox Infantry Systems rebuilt the Gray Death Legion scout armor to be used by the Willow Wisps, a group of female gladiators who compete on the Magistracy of Canopus world of Hardcore. The standard armor has been replaced by 240kg of Improved Stealth armor which, while providing the same level of protection, made them nearly impossible to hit. The suit was also redesigned using new composite joint systems to make them even more flexible than the original. In addition, the Active Probes were removed from all but one suit and replaced by a Clan Micro Pulse Laser. Quirk: Information Gatherer Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.906 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.908 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.908 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Mauler has had a lack of new variants since the Jihad. LAW's developmental experimentation in the late 3060s sought to perfect a new weapons suite focused on medium ranges while  improving the armor to suit an assault 'Mech. It did not fare well. As in a prior attempt to update the BattleMech most liked variant — 3062's MAL-3R — the Mauler's volatile CASE had to be discarded to accommodate new autocannon solutions, thereby undermining the quest for increased resilience. Increased armor mass required the use of a bulky endo-steel structure, reducing internal space, and allowing only a small cockpit. This aggregation of compromises eventually resulted in the flawed MAL-1KX, many of its shortcomings were never fixed, as the final production version that eventually became the MAL-1K was instead based on the MAL-1R.

content.original: A light field artillery, experimental BattleMech, the Pandarus, named for a famous archer from the mythical battle of Troy on ancient Terra, is an Extended LRM Missile boat. Originally a Kali Yama design team proposal for an OmniMech missile boat capable of carrying both common and Experimental Technology missile systems, ultimately the high cost of building an all new design with all new OmniPods proved too high, with the design team forced to scale back their project to a non-Omni ELRM-equipped prototype built on a mothballed Orion chassis.

content.original: Intended more for dueling than battlefield combat use, the design hosts a number of medium- and short-range weapons. The Slagmaiden's primary weapon is its Clan heavy large laser, which is mounted in its right arm. To help mitigate the significant heat buildup from the laser, techs have installed a laser insulator with the weapon. The 'Mech's short range weaponry includes a pair of ER flamers found in its right arm, while a pair of Streak SRM-2s are mounted in each side torso, with the ammunition protected by CASE II in the left torso. The Slagmaiden's other signature feature is the large shield found on its left arm; while the shield is active, the 'Mech is unable to use its torso-mounted weapons as well as slowing the 'Mech down by 11 km/h. However, this is offset by the 'Mechs's supercharger, which pushes the 'Mech's speed to 108 km/h. Techs also applied 10.5 tons of standard armor to the hull to protect the 'Mech's fragile composite internal structure from harm. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

The 'Mech's short range weaponry includes a pair of ER flamers found in its right arm, while a pair of Streak SRM-2s are mounted in each side torso, with the ammunition protected by CASE II in the left torso. The Slagmaiden's other signature feature is the large shield found on its left arm; while the shield is active, the 'Mech is unable to use its torso-mounted weapons as well as slowing the 'Mech down by 11 km/h. However, this is offset by the 'Mechs's supercharger, which pushes the 'Mech's speed to 108 km/h. Techs also applied 10.5 tons of standard armor to the hull to protect the 'Mech's fragile composite internal structure from harm. Особенность: Прочный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.07 Лимит приводов рук: Right Lower

content.original: Like many Solaris VII arena 'Mechs, the Spatha is designed as a brawler, but relies upon finesse rather than brute strength like most. A hand-tooled 360-rated XXL engine trades durability for tremendous weight savings but the Spatha only has to fear autocannon or gauss rifle fire on its fragile engine thanks to its eleven tons of advanced reflective armor and Laser AMS negating its opponents' energy and missile weaponry. The Spatha's thirteen double heat sinks are barely up the task of cooling its advanced power plant and its own energy weapons, actually an intentional choice given the Spatha is equipped with Triple Strength Myomer to boost its speed and dramatically boost the effectiveness of its sword.

The stealth armor ensures it takes minimal return fire and the Support PPC guarantees the Void is useful on most battlefields. content.original: The Wolf Trap is a BattleMech that the Draconis Combine designed to be used as a long-range combat 'Mech. Originally called the Tora, Luthien Armor Works hastily rechristened it the Wolf Trap, the name Federated Commonwealth analysts had given it, to downplay its association with the Combine. The 'Mech is built on an endo steel chassis and protects any ammunition stores that it carries onboard with CASE that redirects the force of the explosion when an ammunition bin is hit by enemy fire. The 'Mech has a very respectable speed of 97.2 km/h, which it achieves through the use of a 270 XL engine.

content.original: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. Upgraded with experimental systems after the Widow's return to Arc-Royal, when they faced off against the Opacus Venatori in 3071, Stacy's 'Mech featured improved defensive protection due to a Blue Shield Particle Field Damper and extra one and half tons of armor. This required modification of the weapons array, while the Heavy PPC was retained and even enhanced by a BL-AM-WC Actuator Enhancement System, the LB-X Autocannon had to be swapped for a left-arm mounted LB-X AC/10, and the medium pulse lasers replaced with extended range models. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: This experimental variant was a custom refit of the Fa Shih by Ceres Metals in 3078. Under the supervision of Ogden Isray, four Fa Shih suits were fitted with Clan-technology myomer boosters. This not only increased their ground speed to 32.4 km/h but improved their strength as well, allowing the armored soldiers to tear through more 'Mech armor with their manipulators. This came at a cost though as the anti-personnel mount and 150 kg of armor had to be removed, meaning the suit can only withstand two bursts from a Machine Gun. Only four of these suits were built due to the limited number of myomer boosters the Capellans were able to acquire. Quirk: Inspiring Appearance Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.908 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.908 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. content.original: Intended more for dueling than battlefield combat use, the design hosts a number of medium- and short-range weapons. The Slagmaiden's primary weapon is its Clan heavy large laser, which is mounted in its right arm. To help mitigate the significant heat buildup from the laser, techs have installed a laser insulator with the weapon. The 'Mech's short range weaponry includes a pair of ER flamers found in its right arm, while a pair of Streak SRM-2s are mounted in each side torso, with the ammunition protected by CASE II in the left torso. The Slagmaiden's other signature feature is the large shield found on its left arm; while the shield is active, the 'Mech is unable to use its torso-mounted weapons as well as slowing the 'Mech down by 11 km/h. However, this is offset by the 'Mechs's supercharger, which pushes the 'Mech's speed to 108 km/h. Techs also applied 10.5 tons of standard armor to the hull to protect the 'Mech's fragile composite internal structure from harm. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. Upgraded with experimental systems after the Widow's return to Arc-Royal, when they faced off against the Opacus Venatori in 3071, Stacy's 'Mech featured improved defensive protection due to a Blue Shield Particle Field Damper and extra one and half tons of armor. This required modification of the weapons array, while the Heavy PPC was retained and even enhanced by a BL-AM-WC Actuator Enhancement System, the LB-X Autocannon had to be swapped for a left-arm mounted LB-X AC/10, and the medium pulse lasers replaced with extended range models. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Developed in 3075 under Hideki Kurosawa, the NDA-3X is Experimental Tech variant of the No-Dachi. The 'Mech employs mix of Clan and Inner Sphere experimental equipment. The 3X does not use Triple Strength Myomers, instead utilizing a Supercharger, which gives it a burst of speed up to 100 km/h. Its sword is exchanged for a Large Vibroblade. For its ranged weapons, the MRMs have been removed for pair of Clan Artemis IV-guided LRM-15 launchers with six tons of ammo. It also replaces its ER PPC with a Clan version. For close-up combat, the 'Mech's SRM launchers have been removed in favor of upgrading the medium laser to a Clan ER model and adding a rear-firing Clan ER Small Laser in the torso. Its heat management been improved by replacing its original heat sinks with fifteen Clan Double Heat Sinks. The armor protection has been enhanced by Clan Ferro-fibrous Armor and an experimental Armored Cockpit. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter.

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. content.original: Clan Diamond Shark began fielding a variant armed with the newest in Gauss rifle technology in 3069. While some intelligence suggests that the Star Adders were the original developers of this variant, Variant 5 has been seen commonly with the Diamond Sharks and sold to other Inner Sphere Clans such the Ghost Bears. In later years some have been reported with Inner Sphere units as well. It mounts two HAG 20s and four AP Gauss Rifles. The resemblance to the original is uncanny, though the HAGs must make the best of four tons of ammunition between them. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2

Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

The light weapons array is because Jiemin's 'mech mounts a larger 315-rated XL engine and extra Jump Jets to match to dramatically increase its ground speed and jump distance even with the addition of a weight saving Endo Steel frame and Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Built by Meridian Manufacturing, the Arbiter is nothing more than a light WorkMech crafted to look like a large and impressive Heavy Battlemech. Despite its unremarkable nature, Meridian has been extremely successful in selling the design in battalion sized lots with a six-month back order. The reason for this is their keen understanding of pirate psychology. Despite its thin armor and limited weaponry, the Arbiter is an intimidating sight that will quickly encourage most pirates to find an easier looking target. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.73 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Персей» является продуктом программы, начатой ​​Центральным координационным и командным управлением Лиги, для создания омнимеха собственного производства Лиги Свободных Миров, от концепции до производства. Perseus во многом похож на почтенный Orion, основной продукт вооружённых сил Лиги Свободных Миров, оба в целом напоминают старый дизайн визуально, достаточно, чтобы техники ЛСМ прозвали его «Омни-Орионом», и развертывание Perseus в основном осуществлялось в передовых частях, которые имели большие концентрации его предшественника, заменяя старые Orion по принципу один к одному. Созданный на лёгком шасси из эндостали, Perseus оснащён двигателем Hermes 300 XL, что помогает ещё больше снизить вес и даёт меху максимальную скорость 64,8 км/ч. Усовершенствованная структура и двигатель значительно экономят вес оружия и оборудования. «Персей» защищён четырнадцатью тоннами брони Valiant Lamellor, что обеспечивает ему среднюю броневую защиту для меха такого размера. Кроме того, в шасси установлены 12 двойных охладителей. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The Quasit was an Industrial Mech armed with military-grade weapons, created in 2517 by Concordat Telecom and the TransStellar Company. Initially, the design was sold to unsuspecting settlements in the Periphery as a BattleMech, but once the new owners had the Quasit face a proper BattleMech, the truth was revealed by its limitations. After a brief setback, once the CTT decided to sell it as a MilitiaMech to support militia troops, the design worked well in this role.

content.original: Built by Meridian Manufacturing, the Arbiter is nothing more than a light WorkMech crafted to look like a large and impressive Heavy Battlemech. Despite its unremarkable nature, Meridian has been extremely successful in selling the design in battalion sized lots with a six-month back order. The reason for this is their keen understanding of pirate psychology. Despite its thin armor and limited weaponry, the Arbiter is an intimidating sight that will quickly encourage most pirates to find an easier looking target. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.73 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Perseus is the product of a program begun by the League Central Coordination and Command to create an OmniMech completely indigenous to the Free Worlds League from concept to production. The Perseus shares much with the venerable Orion, a staple of Free Worlds League Military, both broadly resembling the older design visually and using a number of the same components. This similarity prompted more than a few FWLM technicians to nickname the new design the Omni-Orion and the deployment of Perseus has largely been to front-line units that fielded large concentrations of its progenitor, replacing older Orions on a one-for-one basis. Built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis, the Perseus is powered by a Hermes 300 XL engine helping save even more weight and giving the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The advanced structure and engine save a great deal of weight for weapons and equipment. The Perseus is protected by fourteen tons of Valiant Lamellor armor, giving it around average armor protection for a 'Mech of its size. It also has twelve double heat sinks that are fixed on the chassis. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Персей» является продуктом программы, начатой ​​Центральным координационным и командным управлением Лиги, для создания омнимеха собственного производства Лиги Свободных Миров, от концепции до производства. Perseus во многом похож на почтенный Orion, основной продукт вооружённых сил Лиги Свободных Миров, оба в целом напоминают старый дизайн визуально, достаточно, чтобы техники ЛСМ прозвали его «Омни-Орионом», и развертывание Perseus в основном осуществлялось в передовых частях, которые имели большие концентрации его предшественника, заменяя старые Orion по принципу один к одному. Созданный на лёгком шасси из эндостали, Perseus оснащён двигателем Hermes 300 XL, что помогает ещё больше снизить вес и даёт меху максимальную скорость 64,8 км/ч. Усовершенствованная структура и двигатель значительно экономят вес оружия и оборудования. «Персей» защищён четырнадцатью тоннами брони Valiant Lamellor, что обеспечивает ему среднюю броневую защиту для меха такого размера. Кроме того, в шасси установлены 12 двойных охладителей. Особенность: Противовоздушное наведение Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.06 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.prevOriginal: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective armor the Mech carries by utilizing Light Ferro-Fibrous armor and dropping one heat sink. While updating the design the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
content.content: Модель Falconer FLC-10R призвана устранить главный недостаток версии FLC-8R — уязвимость к критам установленной на ней пушки Гаусса, приводящим к катастрофическим последствиям. Для этого конструкторы увеличили эффективную бронезащиту, применив легкую ферроволоконную броню и отказавшись от одного радиатора. В ходе модернизации все лазеры также были заменены на модели увеличенной дальности. Особенность: Стабильный Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.11 Лимит приводов рук: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Falconer was designed at the order of Hanse Davion to create a 'Mech that could tame the Jade Falcons and defeat a Clan OmniMech in one-on-one combat. The Falconer is powered by a 375 XL engine that propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. This speed is enhanced with greater mobility by fiv jump jets that allow the Falconer to jump the considerable distance of one hundred and fifty meters. The Falconer also saves weight to carry as many weapons as possible by using a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and carries eleven and a half tons of armor plating, which gives the Falconer a respectable amount of armor protection.

content.content: Falconer был разработан по приказу Ханса Дэвиона с целью создания меха, способного обуздать Нефритовых Соколов и одолеть клановый омнимех в поединке один на один. Машина оснащена двигателем XL 375, обеспечивающим максимальную скорость 86,4 км/ч. Высокая мобильность дополнительно повышается за счёт пяти прыжковых двигателей, позволяющих Falconer преодолевать по воздуху значительное расстояние в 150 метров. Для экономии массы и размещения максимально возможного количества вооружения в конструкции использовано шасси из более лёгкой эндостали, а наличие одиннадцати с половиной тонн брони обеспечивает меху достойный уровень защиты.
